sections.title: Cities and World
lines: Fixed Ashland, London and Miami tiles vanishing when the camera looks east or west. The view test read the camera direction mirrored.
Fixed the white boxes around the player on foot in Ashland, London and Miami. A second grey walker was drawn on top of the Driv3r figure.
Changed the Ashland text under Take A Ride. It no longer says there is no traffic or cops: both are there.
Fixed floating boxes, plates and prop sprites over Ashland. The converter no longer writes 25 objects the disc game never draws. Needs Ashland made again by the setup.

sections.title: Driver 1 and Gran Turismo
lines: Changed the Driver 1 movies (intro and cutscenes) to show in full colour, as one filtered picture through the Psynapse renderer instead of squeezed into the PlayStation's 15 bit video memory. The banding is gone, sound, timing and skipping are as before. A movie frame of the intro was checked in a hidden run (about 245 levels a channel, 32 before) and the game hashes stayed equal.
Added reDriver: Extended, the Driver 1 port: the recovered Driver 1 code now builds as a native 64-bit program that runs inside the main project.
Added starting Driver 1 from your own US PlayStation disc to its front end menu. The installer checks that it is the right disc and refuses other discs with a clear text.
Added a data override folder for Driver 1: mods can replace Driver 1 files by dropping them in a folder, without touching the disc.
Added widescreen and window shape options for Driver 1 (4:3, auto, 16:9) and a smooth frame rate option. The original picture stays the default.
Added far view, cheats and PGXP options for Driver 1, with a switch between the original look (Classic) and Extended in the launcher Options.

Added the distance haze to the Driver 1 far view: far buildings and ground fade toward the sky colour. PGXP draws the world with exact polygon corners and perspective correct textures. Both are off in Classic.
Changed the Driver 1 keyboard and controller to the layout of the original PC Driver 1, with menu and pause schemes.
Fixed the Driver 1 loading screens and the Controls page, which showed noise, a doubled picture or only a thin strip.
Fixed the Driver 1 picture in a mission, which showed only the ceiling because the frame was drawn in the wrong video memory page.
Fixed the freeze after Restart from the pause menu in Driver 1 Take A Ride.
Changed the Driver 1 installer to unpack the disc into ordinary files, so the game no longer needs a copy of the disc image.

sections.title: Graphics and Lighting
lines: Made the game run a few percent faster by default: the new Grass Quality row (Options > Graphics > Effects: Off, Low, High) and the new Reflection Quality row (Options > Graphics > Reflections: Low, High) start on Low. Low grass draws every second blade clump and only half as far, Low reflections draw the reflection picture at half the size and update it half as often. In the test scenes the speed is about 5 to 11 percent higher (rush hour drive 791 to 842 fps) and the pictures are nearly the same (0.1 to 6 percent of the pixels change, only on the lawn). High brings back the old look and cost. A saved Grass off stays off, a saved reflection strength stays as it is. All 21 languages have the new texts (machine translated). Automatic tests only (tick hash equal, 188 of 188 scenes; the menu rows were not looked at on screen).
Changed the High and Max graphics presets to also set grass and reflections to High. The default stays Low.

sections.title: Menus and Interface
lines: I replaced the reDriver 2: Extended logo and program icon with the new one, and took the logo credit out of the credits and the third party notices. Not checked: how the new icon looks in the exe, launcher and installer; the setup translations (menu text 578) still hold the old credit line but the installer text no longer shows it.
I put the logo credit to Gector Nathan back into the credits and the third party notices, because the new logo is based on his design.
I updated the reDriver 2: Extended logo and program icon to the newest version. Not checked: how the icon looks in the exe, launcher and installer.
I fixed the new reDriver 2: Extended logo, which had a doubled EX in the first copy. Not checked: how the icon looks in the exe, launcher and installer.

sections.title: Multiplayer and Controllers
lines: Made the controller lines of the log land in log.txt (they were hidden in the developer log), added the device ids and a Steam Deck flag to the pad summary, and added an ini switch [pad] deckhid=auto|off|on for the Steam Deck pad driver. This is for finding why the sticks stay dead on a Deck;

Added an ini switch [pad] rawinput=auto|off|on and a log line that names the Steam Desktop layout when no controller is visible. Turned the detail log (log_dev.txt) on by default for the categories that write per event, capped at 40 MB, so bug reports hold more.

sections.title: Discord Bot
lines: Brought the Discord bot back, with a staff panel and a player panel (account help, recovery, requests and bug reports) and moderation.

sections.title: Modding and Tools for Modders
lines: Switched the selected mod on in mods.ini before Studio starts the game with Test in game.
Opened the car editor inside Studio: Edit on a car row or + Add shows the Car Creator form under a Back bar and puts the car into the selected mod.
Added a Repaint button to car rows in Studio: open the picture folder, put a changed picture back (old one kept as .orig.png) and make 4 colour variants of a base picture.

Added Sounds and Radio pages to Studio: Edit on a sound row lists the exact file names the game looks for (menu music, weather, engine sets) and puts your file in under the right name; a radio station row lists its folders and adds songs.

Added a Translate grid to Studio: Edit on a language row shows every English line with its translation, you type the translation in place, lines that lose a %d or %s are refused, Save keeps remarks and the other lines of the file.

Added a Skins page to Studio: Edit on a texture row lists the pictures of the folder (city pages, taxi textures), opens the folder and puts a changed picture back under the same name, keeping the old one as .orig.

Made + Add in Studio offer a car, a translation, sounds, a radio station or a taxi skin. A translation is made from the English texts of your game folder and a taxi skin from its original taxi pictures, so there is something to change at once.
Made the car editor inside Studio dark like the rest of the window (fields, labels, preview, performance panel, message list). The stand-alone Car Creator keeps its own colours.
Added a Switch on / off button to the mod page of Studio and to the Mod menu. It writes the mod's line in config mods.ini and keeps the mod selected.

Added Rename and Delete to the mod page of Studio. Rename changes the folder, the name in mod.json and the line in mods.ini; Delete asks first and moves the mod to the Recycle Bin. The game's own packs cannot be renamed or deleted.
Added a Details page to Studio (name, version, author, description and needed mods of mod.json; other keys stay) and made the menu bar and the drop down menus dark.
Added a Check page to Studio: the Check menu or a click on the problem count lists every finding of the mod with its file, line and what to do, and opens the file.
Added to Studio: Move up / down in the load order (menu or Ctrl and the arrows, saved in mods.ini), What it changes, Check all mods and Game log pages.
Added drag and drop to Studio: drop a mod zip to install it, a mod folder to copy it into the mods folder, or a 3D model (.obj) to open the car editor with the model filled in.
Added an Options page to Studio: every option of the game's tweaks.ini with its range, a find field, values checked before they are saved, and the remarks and other lines of the file kept.
Added a HUD colours page to Studio: ten colours with swatches, the Windows colour dialog, and back to the game's colour; hud theme.ini keeps its other lines.

Added Engine set from recordings to the Sounds page of Studio: pick a folder with idle.wav and rev.wav, Studio makes the looped set and adds the car and the set to carsounds sounds.txt without losing the other lines.
Added a text file editor to Studio (Mod menu, Edit a text file; Edit station.txt on a radio row): save, then the mod is checked and the problem count shows at once. UTF-8 files stay UTF-8.

Added a Mission page to Studio: Edit on a mission row can read what it does, turn it into text, build the text into the mission again (a word the builder does not know is named) and edit the text. Also fixed that the one line errors of install and pack could be lost in the window.

Added a City textures page to Studio: pick a city, take its textures out of your disc image as pictures (a name filter, ROAD by default), repaint them, and put the changed ones back as the TIM files of the mod. The pictures stay in the game's work folder, not in the mod.
Edit on a city changes row (edits file of the level editor) in Studio opens the file in the text editor, with the check after a save.
Added File, Choose game folder to Studio for a program that does not sit in the tools folder of the game. The folder is remembered in studio.ini next to the program.

Added keyboard shortcuts to Studio, shown on the right of the menu items: F5 Test in game, F7 Check, F2 Rename, Ctrl+N New mod, Ctrl+I Install, Ctrl+G game folder, Ctrl+E Share, Ctrl+P Options. A shortcut does nothing while a page or the car editor is open.

Added Test with only this mod (F6) to Studio: the game starts with only that mod and the mods it needs switched on. Your own mods.ini is put back when the game closes, or at the next start of Studio if it was cut short.

Added previews to Studio: the picture of the selected file shows next to the list on the Repaint and Skins pages (transparency shown), and the Sounds page has Play and Stop for the file in a slot (wav, mp3, wma). The buttons of the Sounds page moved to two rows.

Added backups to Studio: before it saves the text editor, the options, the HUD colours, a translation or the details it keeps a copy of the old file (the newest ten of each) in the game's cache folder, and Mod, Restore a backup puts one back.
Added license, tags, website and a preview picture (preview.png) to the details of a mod in Studio. The mod checks now know these three keys of mod.json.
Added Help, Guides to Studio: the modding guides are listed and read inside the window. Added Tools, Game log (problems only): the log lines about mods, errors and warnings.

Added File, Install from a web address to Studio: paste the address of a mod zip, Studio downloads it (http or https, up to 200 MB) and installs it like a zip from your disk. The download was tried against a local test server.

Added Insert an example to the text editor of Studio: a working line of the radio clock, a programme block, special programming, a weather climate, a tyre compound, HUD colours or options, put in at the caret.
Studio now stops the window at a smallest size where the pages still fit, and shows the game folder in use in the title.
A button under the mouse in Studio now lights up, so it is clear what reacts to a click.
Studio now shows a short welcome with the first steps when the mods folder is empty (or asks for the game folder when none was found).
Added hints to Studio: while the mouse is over a button, or a menu item is selected, the status line at the bottom says in one line what it does. Every button and menu item has one.

Fixed a danger in Studio: a mod folder whose name has letters outside the PC's Windows code page (for example Cyrillic or Chinese) showed as question marks, and a question mark is a wildcard in a delete. Studio now refuses to delete, rename, move, switch, pack or back up such a mod and says to rename the folder in Explorer.

Added Export mod list and Import mod list to the Studio File menu. The list is one small text file with every mod in its load order, its switch, version and website. Importing it on another PC sets the order and the switches of the mods that are there and names the missing ones with where to get them. The old mods.ini is kept as mods.ini.import_bak.

Adds Lua 5.4 scripting for mods, first step. A mod can ship scripts\main.lua that watches mission start, complete, failed, level loaded and the tick, and writes to the log. Scripts run in a sandbox with a time and memory limit and cannot change the game yet. 8 unit checks pass.

Adds commands to Lua scripting. A script can now give cash and clear a player's felony with cmd.give_cash and cmd.clear_felony. Each command is checked, applied two ticks later and saved in the replay file, so a replay plays the same changes with no script installed. Replay files get a new layout 6; older games ignore the extra bytes. Tried with a recorded replay and a play back without the mod: same commands at the same ticks.

Adds two more Lua script commands: cmd.set_felony sets a player's felony (0 to 4096) and cmd.set_weather forces a weather preset by name, like medium-rain, at once or blended over game minutes. Both are checked, applied two ticks later and saved in the replay. Tried with a recorded replay played back without the mod: same commands at the same ticks.

Adds three Lua script events and one more command. Scripts now hear player_wasted (a player starts dying), car_enter and car_exit, and can call cmd.spawn_car(player, modelSlot) to park a loaded car in front of a player. The command is checked, applied two ticks later and saved in the replay. Tried with a recorded replay played back without the mod: same command at the same tick (52), and the car appeared. The events were Busted has no event of its own yet.

Adds two things to reDriver Studio. The City textures page can now take out whole texture pages as PNG, TGA and TIM pictures, and has a switch for the night textures. Car rows in a mod have an Export OBJ button that writes the car as an OBJ model with its pictures for a 3D program. The page export was run for real on Havana from the disc and looked right. Cars made from the disc hold a binary model and cannot be exported yet.

Adds three jobs to the City textures page of reDriver Studio, and to rdcontent as commands. City as OBJ writes the objects of a city (buildings and props, no roads or ground, no textures) as one OBJ model, optionally only near a point. Overhead map draws the same objects from above as one picture. Level information shows what the level file holds. Run for real on Havana from the disc: 1 million triangles, a 122 MB OBJ, and a map that shows the city and airport.

Adds a Disc pictures button to the City textures page of reDriver Studio, and rdinspect d2images. It takes the loading screens, splash screens and front end backgrounds out of the Driver 2 disc as PNG pictures. Loading and splash screens look right. The front end backgrounds come as a sheet of their 256 by 256 pages, not joined, and the skies as grey pictures because their palettes are not in the sky files. Run on the real disc, looked at.

Adds the four Driver 1 cities (Frisco, LA, Miami, New York) to the City textures page of reDriver Studio. Their textures can be taken out as pictures, whole pages, an OBJ and an overhead map the same way as the Driver 2 cities, from the level files in the game folder (no disc needed). Texture pages, single textures and the map were run for real on Frisco and worked. Putting changed pictures back writes the same folder layout as for Driver 2, but NOT checked that the game loads them for a Driver 1 city.

Makes putting city textures back easier. A changed picture can now be any size and any 24 bit colour picture: it is scaled to its texture and 16 colours are chosen for it, in reDriver Studio and with rdinspect texpack --fit. Before, the picture had to be exactly the size of the texture. A 1024 by 644 picture was run through it on a real Frisco texture and came out as a TIM.

Adds a check for Lua scripts to the mod check of reDriver Studio and reDriver_ModTools. A script in scripts/main.lua is read with the same Lua as the game: a syntax error comes with its line, a name the script may not use (print, os, io, require ...) and a function or event the game does not have are named before the game runs it. Adds the guide MODDING_howto_scripts.txt. The names of the script functions and events are now one list shared by the game, the check and a unit test. Tested with unit tests and the Studio selftest.

Adds a player_busted event and saves to Lua scripts. A script hears when the police box a player in, or catch a player on foot. A script can keep numbers, true or false and short texts between games with save.set and save.get (up to 64 values, in a small file in the player's profile). Unit tests pass, and a script that counted its runs kept the count over two real game starts. The busted event was

Adds a script editor to reDriver Studio. The scripts of a mod show in its item list as Script rows with an Edit button that opens the text editor. + Add has A script, which makes scripts/main.lua with a few working lines and opens it. The Example button gives seven pieces that work (log a mission, cash for a finished mission, no heat after a wasted, hear a bust, a car in front of the player, rain after a minute, count the runs). Saving a script says the first problem with its line, or that it is clean. A test checks that every example passes the check. Selftest 228 checks and the smoke run (13 pages) pass.

Adds cmd.message to Lua scripts: a script can put a text of up to 64 plain characters on the message line of a player for 1 to 15 seconds (the line that says BUSTED). The text is saved in the replay file as small commands, so a replay without the mod shows the same message at the same moment. Run for real: a script message was shown at tick 52 while recording, and the replay without the mod showed it at tick 52 again. Unit tests pass. The Studio Example button has a message example.

Adds cmd.teleport and game.position to Lua scripts. A script can read where a player is and move the player's car to another place of the city. The car stands still at the new place until the ground there is loaded, then drives on, so it no longer falls through the world. A place outside the map or in water is refused (or the car is put back). Run for real: a jump of 140 metres worked and the car drove on, a jump into water was refused, and the replay played without the mod made the same jump at the same tick. A player on foot is not moved.

Fixes the Studio script editor staying over the mod page after a click on another mod (the page now closes, and unsaved text asks first). Adds 6 script examples to the Example button and a whole 'road trip' script that pays cash every 500 m, keeps the best trip in the profile and sends a busted car back to the start. The smoke run now clicks another mod on every page. I could not make the stuck editor happen again in 8 real click runs, so the fix is a safety net, NOT proven on the original fault. The new examples pass the script check;

Adds syntax colours and name completion to the Lua script editor of Studio. Keywords, strings, comments, numbers and the game's own names get colours. A list opens while typing after game. cmd. save., inside game.on(" for the event names, and for words the script already uses, with the arguments of each function; Up/Down, Tab or Enter, Esc, Ctrl+Space. Enter keeps the indent and end goes back. The editor is now a rich edit box (code font). Tried by hand in the real window: colours, the list, Tab, undo, indent. A light Windows theme, big files over 200 KB (no colours there).
Changes the icon of reDriver Studio to the new Studio logo (the exe, the task bar and the window). The icon in Explorer and the task bar may need a moment to refresh.

Fixes the Studio logo not showing in the title bar and task bar (the window had no icon set). Adds a 'career streak' whole script to the script Example button: clean and fast missions pay more, a streak gives a reward car and light rain, a bust or failed mission ends it and a failed mission puts the car back at the start. It passes the script check;

Speeds up the Studio script editor: only the letters whose colour changed are set again, not the whole file on every key. Adds a one line tip for the function under the caret, a live check that names the line of a mistake while you type, and a Test in game button that saves and starts the game with only this mod on. Looked at in the real window (tip, live check, button); NOT timed against a big file,

Adds five read functions to Lua scripts: game.player_count(), game.cash(player), game.felony(player), game.mission() and game.city(). A script can now look at the game, not only react to it. Run in the real game: the values came back right (1 player, cash 1900, no heat, city 0); the mission number of a free ride shows 50.
Stops mod scripts from loading in an online room, so every machine plays the same rules. A line in the log says so. The game builds;

Adds rules to Lua scripts: the game asks a script at the moment of a decision and uses its answer. The first rule is rules.mission_pay(pay, mission), the pay of a finished mission. The game pays its own amount and the difference goes as a recorded cash order, so a replay pays the same; with no script nothing changes. Tried by hand: a test script added 777 and the order was applied after mission 1. The mod check, the Studio editor (colours, completion, a new example) and the guide know the rules. A replay of a scripted mission, two players, a pack script.

Adds the rule rules.felony_gain(points, offence) to Lua scripts: a script changes the heat points of one offence (scare people, speeding, red light, hitting a car or cop ...). The game adds its own points as always and the difference goes as a recorded order (new command AddFelony, range checked), so a replay without the script gets the same heat. With no script nothing changes (one gated line in NoteFelony). Tried by hand in a Chicago free ride: a test script tripled the points, the log shows the question and the order. The mod check, the Studio editor and the guide know it. A replay, a mission with a felony, tick hash tests.

Adds the rule rules.job_pay(pay, 0, player) to Lua scripts: a script changes the pay of every job and fare (taxi, delivery, getaway and the others, weather bonus included). It sits at the one place all job pay passes (PayBonus_Apply), so no job file changed. The game pays its own amount and the difference goes as a recorded cash order. Tried by a scripted game run through the console command paybonus pay: the rule was asked with 100 and the wallet went up by 100 plus the 25 of the script.
Fixed the Studio ini writers losing output on files whose lines end in LF only. Checked by the Studio tests,
Added a --page switch to Studio that takes pictures of the details, rename, mission and city pages.
Fixed the mod path of the Studio car editor: a lost backslash put the car in the wrong folder.

Adds a large Lua scripting library for modders. New reads: speed, heading, in a car or on foot, car model and damage, fuel, police cars, traffic and parked cars, time of day, weather, stats counters, car and mission names, plus distance, bearing and ahead helpers. New orders that a replay plays back too: repair, boost, stop, fuel, damage, police level, and cmd.set / game.get for 26 game values (police speed and power, damage factor, traffic, fares, god mode and more). Six more rules scripts can answer: race prize, stunt pay, package pay, contract pay, speed trap fine and wreck fine. Six new events: cash, heat, damage, police cars, time of day and weather changed. Tried only by automatic tests and a headless game run with a test script; the new rules, boost and stop were

Extends the Lua library for modders. Scripts can now scan the world: game.car(id) gives type, place, heading, speed, model and cop flag of any car, game.near_cars counts cars around a place, game.peds counts pedestrians. 17 more game values can be changed or read with cmd.set and game.get (how much each offence adds to the heat, traffic behaviour switches, spawn distances, rain). Eight more rules scripts can answer: the garage repair price, the plate shop, selling a car, the car shop price, the bomb job pay, pick list pay, shared CB job pay and traffic stop fines. Tried by automatic tests and a headless game run for the scan and the game values; the new rules were

Adds three more orders to the Lua library: cmd.launch throws the player's car up, cmd.spawn_car_at parks a car of a loaded model at any place near the player, cmd.remove_car sends a civilian car away (never a car a player sits in). Also game.altitude (height above the road) and game.ground (height of the ground at a place). All orders go into the replay. Tried by automatic tests and a headless game run: the car went up, a car appeared at the place, and a removed car's slot got a new car. How high 100 percent throws is not measured.

Adds the world of races, events and finds to the Lua library. Scripts can read whether a race or a tag or derby event runs, its state and values, the stunt score of a player, the hidden packages (how many, where, taken), the stunt ramps and the fuel stations. New orders: cmd.start_event starts a tag or derby event, cmd.stop_event ends it, cmd.add_package puts one more package on the map; all go into the replay. Tried by automatic tests and a headless game run for the reads and add_package; starting an event needs two players and was

Lets Lua scripts put text on the screen with hud.text (slot, place, colour, optional seconds) and remove it with hud.clear. It is only a picture, so it is not in a replay. Adds the car_impact event: a script hears when the car of a player is hit and how hard. The mod check and the Studio editor know the new names. Tried by automatic tests and a headless game run (the calls were accepted, a place outside the screen was refused, nothing crashed). The text was not looked at on screen, and no impact happened in the test run.

Adds a large wave to the Lua library for modders. 112 more game values can be changed or read by name with cmd.set and game.get (the police and their smarts, traffic and pedestrian spawning, the weather mix, light and glow, reflections, the sound mix, camera and screen options, fares and fuel), listed by game.var_names and game.var_range. game.info gives 21 numbers of the world and game.player_info 34 numbers of a player (gear, revs, place, speed, each damage zone, steering, and more). New helpers: clamp, lerp, sign, angle and sine functions, a whole number square root, in_circle, in_box, cash_text and time_text. New: cmd.set_cash, hud.centre and hud.right for screen text, and rules.mode_prize. A setting a script changed goes back to the player's own at the next level load. Tried by automatic tests and a headless game run that read all 155 values, the info lists and set a few; the effect of most settings was

Adds a second large wave to the Lua library. Timers: game.after, game.every, game.cancel, game.once and game.seconds, so a script can wait or repeat without counting ticks. 40 more game values for cmd.set and game.get (195 in all: input, menu, music, graphics and style options), numbers of any car in the world with game.car_info, orders for any car id (boost, stop, launch, damage, repair), the pedestrians (a list and a count near a place), the weather preset names, save.has, save.keys and save.clear, random_range and chance, orders for all players at once (give_cash_all, message_all, repair_all, clear_felony_all), and seven more events (car flipped, grass, handbrake, gear, lights, players and mission changed). Tried by automatic tests and a headless game run that fired the timers, read all 195 values and the car, pedestrian and weather lists, and sent the orders; the effect of most of it was

Adds a third, much larger wave to the Lua library for modders, built on name tables of the game's own data. Scripts can read the handling table of any car model (91 numbers: mass, power, traction, suspension, wheel places, collision points, centre of gravity, lights) and change it with cmd.set_model; read more than 100 numbers of any car (rotation matrices, each wheel, body state, and the civilian and police driver state), 28 numbers of any pedestrian, the header of the loaded mission (34 numbers), 22 more numbers of a player, and the game's limits; and write to cars (cmd.set_car) and pedestrians (cmd.set_ped). 41 more game values for cmd.set and game.get (the camera views, traffic avoidance and all the steering wheel settings), and lists of the names for stats, stunts and event values. Every order goes into the replay; a changed car handling number goes back to the game's own at the next script reset. Tried by automatic tests and a headless game run that read every name of every table and changed a car model's mass, a car's damage, fuel and cash; the effect on driving was

Adds a fourth wave to the Lua library. The 27 weather presets are open: scripts read and edit 34 numbers of each (rain, fog, wind, cloud, temperature and the light), 918 values, and the weather of the running tick is readable (48 numbers: rain, snow, fog, visibility, wind, temperatures, wetness, ice, grip and the light). Scripts can read the whole road map (every straight, curve and junction), the ground type at a place, and the pads of the players (16 buttons held and pressed, both sticks). The rules of four Take a Ride jobs (bomb, speed traps, stunts, pick list; 49 numbers by the keys of their economy files) can be read and changed, and the stats names now include every job kind and best time. Every change goes into the replay; changed weather numbers and job rules go back at the next script reset. Tried by automatic tests and a headless game run that read all 918 weather values, the road tables, the pads and the rules and changed a preset number and three job rules; the effect in play was

Adds the day clock, the mission timer and sound to the Lua library. Scripts can read the day clock (time of day, day length, speed, light share, moon), jump it with cmd.set_time, stop or speed up the sky with cmd.set_day_speed, and hear a new hour with the hour_changed event. They can read and set the timer of a mission, see which car slots have a car loaded, and play any sample of the game's sound banks with sound.play and sound.play_at (audio only, not in a replay). The day length and start hour are game values for cmd.set. The mod check and the Studio editor know the new sound table. Tried by automatic tests and a headless game run: the clock was read, set to 23:59:50 and the hour events fired, sounds started, out of range sounds were refused; what the sounds and the time jump look like in play was

Adds a helper library to the Lua scripts, written in Lua on top of the game functions: 135 functions for numbers and units (metres, km/h, mph, degrees), lists and texts, questions about the world (nearest car, pedestrian, player, package, ramp and fuel station), orders for all players at once, shortcuts (reward, fine, wanted level, nitro, teleport to a player, spawn cars around, remove traffic, weather and time shortcuts, god mode), text on the screen (bars, values, flashing text, lists), kept values (counters, toggles, lists) and watchers that call a function when a value changes. game.api_version and game.api list what exists. Scripts can also read the planned route of a traffic car, the free roamer driver and the light trails of any car (125 more car numbers, 269 in all). Tried by automatic tests and a headless game run that used most of the library; the look of the screen text and the effects in play were

Adds to the Lua library: input (cmd.press, cmd.stick, cmd.drive hold buttons and sticks for a number of ticks and go into the replay), cmd.spawn_cop and cmd.spawn_ped, cmd.camera_view, cmd.enter_car and cmd.leave_car (they press the game's own buttons), the models of car slots and of the level, the targets of the loaded mission, and civ_car_target. Driver 1 gets scripts too: scripts\main.lua in the program folder reads and writes the 1727 named globals of the game (d1.get, d1.set), raw memory, a frame event and timers; tried in the Driver 1 program without a disc (the names and the wiring) and in a unit test; Tried by looking at the game: the screen text (the screen is 320 x 240 units), and 22 orders in play (boost, stop, launch, teleport, cash, damage, repair, fuel, spawn, remove, traffic, clock, weather, rule, package, handling, input, steering, cops, pedestrians, camera, leave and enter a car) all did what they say.

Lets Lua scripts add HUD elements that look like the game's own: hud.plate (like the message line), hud.topbar, hud.panel (title row, the three stripes, lines), hud.cb (the CB radio panel), hud.pill, hud.meter, hud.stat and hud.element for all of them, anchored to any side or corner of the screen. They use the colours, edges and fonts of the HUD theme chosen in the options. Looked at in the game: all seven kinds drew in the walnut theme with the right fonts and stripes; the other themes were
Added Lua HUD elements inside each player's view of a split screen game, and checked them in the Driver, 70s and PS1 themes. Driver 1 scripts now run with a real disc in the headless scenario host.

Added Lua reads of the old game code by name: game.legacy (camera, road map header and counts, 47 names), game.sound_channel (the 24 mixer voices) and game.mission_thread (the mission script threads), with Studio hints and docs. Checked headless that they return numbers.

Added Lua API wave 4: the 27 weather presets (34 numbers each, readable and editable), the weather of this tick, the road map (straights, curves, junctions), the pads, the ground, the rules of four Take a Ride jobs and more stat names.

Added Lua reads of the cops' felony table (game.felony_rule: 12 offences, delays and heat) and the cop tuning numbers (triggers, cut off distance, difficulty) in game.legacy. Checked headless that they run; values in a mission

Changed Studio so the car editor opens inside its window from Tools > New car from a 3D model, and removed the menu items that started the old Car Creator and Mod Tools programs. The mod tools zip now carries reDriver_Studio.exe (with the Car Creator inside, self test run on the copy) instead of a separate Car Creator exe.

Fixed the Car Creator wheel problems: a model whose wheels are not named wheel_fl wheel_fr wheel_rl wheel_rr, whose nose is not on +Z or whose size is in centimetres or millimetres is now fitted with the part finder of the F6 model wizard. It finds the wheels by name or by their round shape, turns and moves the car, and switches the Model units. A note in the message list says what it did. Checked with a turned, centimetre model with plain object names.

Changed the game package so reDriver_Studio.exe replaces reDriver_CarCreator.exe in the bin folder (the Car Creator is inside Studio). Old Car Creator shortcuts are moved to Studio on an update, Studio finds the game one folder above bin, and the guides and the launcher text name Studio. A real install and update.

Rebuilt the Studio car editor as native Studio pages: rows for the model, the car and every field of the performance sheet, a preview, the performance numbers and the message list, in the dark theme with the status line and hints. It no longer embeds the old Car Creator window. Drives the same car code as before (self test 111 checks) and a smoke run clicks Build and Copy.
Fixed Studio: choosing + New mod while the script editor or another page with its own controls was open left that page on screen over the new mod form. The smoke run now checks it.

Added right click menus to Studio. Each menu shows what fits where you click, then a base set. On a mod (in the list or on its page): its pages (Details, Options, HUD colours, City textures, Edit a text file, What it changes), Check, Test, Test with only this mod, Share, switch on or off, move, rename, delete, new car, open the mod folder, copy its path. On the car editor: a row (edit, choose a file or folder, pick a choice, copy and paste the value), the 3D view (view, wireframe, spin, reset), the messages (copy, go to the field) and Build, Copy into mod, Quick test. In every text box: Undo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, Select all (the text editor adds Insert an example). The base set is Back, Check, Test, Share, Open mods folder and the guide. The menus are dark like the menu bar and chosen items have a mark; the car page choice list now shows its mark too. The smoke run opens every menu and checks it has items, but nobody clicked through them.

Added a Game assets page to Studio (Tools > Game assets). It reads the GAME_DATA folder of your game and lists its files (about 16000: cars, levels, textures, HUD and icons, sounds, missions, maps and data, demos and the content packs) by type, with a search box. It shows a picture (PNG and TGA), the start of a text file or plays a WAV sound, and Add to mod copies the file to the same place inside your mod, so the game uses it instead of the original; Add all shown copies everything the search shows. Other game folders next to yours that have a GAME_DATA folder are listed too, and you can pick one. The disc images are not listed. Checked in a screenshot of the page on the real game folder and by 18 self test checks; the files inside the level files (models, textures) are not listed yet.

Extended the Game assets page of Studio. It now lists what is inside the level files (the texture pages as pictures, the text files and the tables), shows the car name of a car file (and its kind, cities and where it was made from) and finds cars by name, previews OBJ models in 3D, and saves a copy of a file, of a file inside a level, or of everything shown, into a folder you choose with the same folders as in the game. About 27000 entries now. Checked in screenshots on the real game folder and by 266 self test checks. Still missing: the models inside the level files and of the original disc cars (the game stores them in its own binary form), JPG pictures, MP3 sounds.

Studio can now show the original game cars in 3D. The Game assets page decodes the model that the game keeps in its own binary form (the Driver 2, Driver 1 and Gran Turismo cars, 1600 files) into a flat shaded preview of the body, and Save a copy... saves a car as an OBJ (in metres, y up, front +z, ground at 0) that you can open in a 3D program or use for a new car. Body only: no wheels, no pictures yet. Checked in screenshots of three cars and by 2 self test checks on a tiny made car. Still missing: the models inside the level files (buildings, props, the city as OBJ).

Added the models inside the levels to the Game assets page of Studio. A new type, Level models, lists every model of every level (about 6800: buildings, props, fences, ground tiles) with its type number and polygon count, shows it in 3D, and saves it as an OBJ (centred, in metres, lowest point at 0). Each level also has city.obj, the whole city as one OBJ (a big file: tens of MB). The models are read the first time you open the type (about a second). Geometry only, no pictures yet. Checked in screenshots on your real game folder and by 8 self test checks on a small made level.

Added Make a car from it... to the Game assets page of Studio. It sends the 3D model of the file you picked (the body of an original game car, an OBJ file, or a model of a level) to the car editor of the mod you chose, ready to turn into a new car. The cars decoded from the game now come with their four wheels (drums at the right places, named wheel_fl, wheel_fr, wheel_rl and wheel_rr), in the frame the car importer expects, so the car editor finds them and has no error. Also added City textures... for a level: it opens the City textures page of the mod for that city. Checked in a screenshot of an original police car in the car editor; the City textures button is not run.

Made the level texture pages in the Game assets page of Studio colourful. A page was a grey picture; it now shows with the palettes the level keeps for it, and the arrows on the picture step through the other palettes of the level (1 / 30 ...). A page uses several palettes at once in the game, so one palette colours only some of its textures right; the City textures page still gives the finished textures. Checked in a screenshot of a Chicago page and by 5 self test checks.

The Game assets page of Studio now shows JPG, BMP and GIF pictures (the car photos and the like) and plays MP3 and WMA sounds, next to the PNG and TGA pictures and WAV sounds it had. A JPG car photo shows in a screenshot, and an MP3 starts (the button turns to Stop); OGG and FLAC sounds are listed but not played.

Added textures to the game cars in Studio's Game assets page: the preview shows a disc car with its pictures, Make a car from it... writes the model, its MTL and one PNG per material into a folder that the car editor uses as its Texture PNG folder, and Driver 1 and Gran Turismo cars get their pages the same way.

Fixed textures not showing in the 3D view of the car editor in Studio. A texture bigger than 2048 on a side (a 4K car texture) and a PNG saved as 16 bit or interlaced were skipped and the car stayed flat; they now show (big ones are made smaller for the view). Pictures that the model's MTL file names (map_Kd) show too, and the message list tells you that the build still wants the pictures as <material>.png in a texture folder. Checked in a screenshot with a 4096 x 4096 texture and by 2 new self test checks.

Show the wheels of a game car in Studio the way the game draws them: a dark tyre drum with the rim picture of the car's wheel set on the outer side (the city design of the Driver 2 / Driver 1 wheel packs, a Gran Turismo design or the design the car package brings), at the wheelSize radius and the CLEANWHEEL width, and the wheel objects named for the side they are on.

Added Add to mod for the texture pages inside the level files of the Game assets page of Studio. A page becomes the TIM picture files the game loads as texture overrides, one per texture with its own 16 colours: <mod>\DRIVER2\LEVELS\<CITY>\PAGE_<n> for the day pages and NPAGE_<n> for the night pages, named as the game builds them. Add, Add all shown and two right click menu entries do one page, the shown pages or every page of the level, and the status line names the folder and how many files were written. Checked by 24 self test checks on a made level, 2 more on a real level package, the Studio smoke run and the car editor smoke.

Added the sound banks of Driver 2 to reDriver Studio: the Game assets page lists every sample of VOICES2.BLK in the Sounds category with rate, length and loop, plays one, saves it as WAV and adds an engine sound (rev, idle, horn) to a mod in the car sound set form. Right click entries and hints added. Only a made up bank in the self test, not the real VOICES2.BLK.

Added OGG and FLAC to the Game assets page of reDriver Studio: Play and Stop, and an info line with length, rate and channels. OGG is decoded with stb_vorbis 1.25 (public domain, listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES), FLAC with Windows Media Foundation. Only made up test files in the self test, no real OGG or FLAC file and no listening.

Added the Driver 1 folder (reDriver: Extended) as a second source of the Game assets page in reDriver Studio: File menu entry and right click entry Driver 1 folder..., remembered between runs, its files show where they come from, sorted into the same categories, .d1c cars preview, Add to mod refuses them and says why. Only a made up folder in the self test, no real Driver 1 folder.

Added the missions of the game to the Game assets page of reDriver Studio: a summary (name, city, time, objectives, cars) above the mission text, and the buttons Open as text, Add mission to mod and Edit (Edit adds it and opens the Mission page), also in the right click menu. rdcontent mission info prints the same summary. No click through of the window, the real MISSIONS.BLK only through rdcontent.

sections.title: Install and Setup
lines: Raised the city file version to 2 because the Driver 1 cities changed, so an update rebuilds the city files for players who have them from discs (or fetches the ready-made data when it is published).

Made the disc install in the launcher easier to get discs into: drop a disc file or a whole folder on the window, pick .mdf, .mds, .ccd, .zip and .7z files too, and a help line under the rows says how to make an image of your own disc (ImgBurn or CDBurnerXP). A folder, a .chd or a missing image now gets a plain answer. Only automatic tests and a headless Driver 2 install ran.

Removed the game data download from the launcher: Install now always makes the game from your own discs, and only the files no disc can give (radio, music, packs) are downloaded. The package has no separate disc installer file, the installer is inside the launcher.

sections.title: Driving and Cars
lines: Fixed a way car textures could show another car's colours: all car pages are now checked against the stored pictures every frame (before only two), more palettes per frame, and when a car page is freed every car buffer is built again, so no car keeps a stale material. I could not reproduce the garbled car, so this closes the holes I found in the code, it is not a confirmed cure.

Fixed a 32 bit overflow in the scenery collision reach test: an object or event model 65536 units away squared to 0 and counted as touching the car. Same class as the State Street wall. Tested by the tick hash (no scenario moves),

Added a safety net against invisible walls: a collision box that is too far from the car to touch it is ignored and named in the log, and when the car loses most of its speed in a few ticks one [wall] line in logs\log.txt names what it hit (object, pack, mission). Tested with the old overflow put back and with sweeps of all four cities and the Chase the Witness route,

Fixed the chased car (and traffic) changing colours or showing garbled texture patches after about 28 borrowed cars were loaded or after a mission restart. The palette row number of a borrowed car was cut to a byte, so rows 256 and up wrote into the pedestrian row and the first car page.

sections.title: Graphics and Lighting
lines: Made level textures follow changes faster: 64 level pages are checked per frame instead of 2, so a page that the game rewrites (lamps, editor edits, streamed pieces) no longer keeps its old picture for seconds on a big level. The dusk texture check passes.

sections.title: Sound and Music
lines: Added native voices for the Driver 1 story movies: the setup can convert the movies of a French, German, Italian or Brazilian Portuguese Driver 1 disc as the voices of that language, and the movies play them when the game language has them, else the English ones. Made on your own machine from your own disc, nothing new in the menu (the game language decides). Only the automatic tests ran, the movies were not watched in the game. Driver 2 has no other language voices on any disc found, so nothing changes there.

sections.title: Menus and Interface
lines: Fixed the out of memory message and a log line that still said the game is a 32 bit program. The other languages show the new English text until they are translated again.

I remade the options of the REDRIVER2 launcher as the gear Options of its page: fullscreen, perspective texturing, Z-buffer, texture filtering, widescreen overlays, fast loading screens, Chicago bridges, field of view and game language. They are written into the game's own config.ini key by key, so the rest of your file stays. Tested with fake files in the unit test, Keyboard and controller mapping are not remade yet.
Changed the picture of the reDriver: Extended (Driver 1) page in the launcher to the new artwork.
I shortened the help texts of three options (Far Glass Darken, Lamp Lens Glow, Soft Exhaust Smoke) so each fits on one line of the options menu, and translated them into all languages.

sections.title: Multiplayer and Controllers
lines: Added a Linux package for running a community server node in your own region. A guided program checks the machine, the connection and the ports, makes the node key, shows a short code to send for approval, installs a locked down service and waits with a live status line until the node is approved and online. It can also check, update (signed) and remove the node. Tested on this PC against a local master only.

I added a node chooser to Host on a server. When the master lists community nodes, the screen has a Node row: Auto (nearest with free capacity) by default, or a list of all nodes with region, rooms and the ping to each one, nearest first. The ping is measured with the game's own packet, three samples, the smallest wins, and again every time the screen opens. A full node makes Auto ask the next one. The privacy line (the volunteer host can see your IP address, name and chat) stays on the screen. Without a node list the screen works as before. Texts in 21 languages are machine translated.

Gave every online player their own input delay. A far player gets the longer delay its connection needs (up to 14 ticks), a near player keeps 3 ticks and is no longer pulled up by the worst connection of the room. The start value comes from the round trip measured in the lobby, so a 150 ms or 250 ms player can drive from the first second (before: 5 seconds standing still, or never). The delay goes up at once when inputs come late and down only after clean 2 second windows, never below 3 ticks or what the ping needs, so it no longer hunts at 60 ms. Cars of other players are still the real cars on every machine: no ghosts, hits stay hits. Network protocol 12: old versions cannot join (needs the update). Tested by the feel test (8 profiles, same hashes on every machine) and the online unit tests,

Made the extra wait before an online player's input delay may go down fade again. After a bad moment the delay used to stay locked for 20 to 80 seconds for the whole round; now every 30 seconds without late inputs halves it back to 10 seconds. The delay still goes up at once and no longer hunts at 60 ms. Tested by a unit test of the windows and the feel test (no hunting at 60 ms, 150 ms and jitter),

Keeps a used stick of a gamepad working while a key of the same player is held, so a Steam Input layer that holds a key no longer kills both sticks (ini [pad] keystick=0 gives the old rule back). The log gets one [pad] summary line with every joystick device and its axes a few seconds after the start.

Made the built-in controller of a Steam Deck always player 1, even when a wheel or another pad is found first. The game finds the Deck pad by its name or Valve id, and the Steam virtual gamepad only when it runs on a Deck. Other pads come after it. New row Options > Controls > Built-In Controller First (ini [pad] builtin = auto | off).

Added a controller log for bug reports. Logs\log.txt now has a block for every controller that connects: name, GUID, the mapping SDL uses, SDL version, buttons and axes, whether Steam Input or a Steam Deck was found, the window size and scale. The first press of every button and stick adds a line with the game action it does. The README says how to send it. Checked by an automatic test with a virtual controller,

sections.title: Level Editor
lines: Fixed the editor deleting far away objects together with the one picked: a deleted lamp or barrier no longer takes identical objects that stand 65,536 units away with it, and a restore no longer brings back foreign ones. A new delete saves the map cell in the edits file; old edits stay as they were.

sections.title: Modding and Tools for Modders
lines: I added a box view to hunt invisible walls. It draws the collision boxes the game builds round your car, on foot or in the free camera, in colours by where they come from (level objects, barriers, editor boxes, cars, people), puts a hatch on the ones that lie on the road and shows the ones with nothing drawn behind them in red with a pole. A box your car touches turns white and the one that stops the car pulses. Keys 4 (cycle), 5 (dump the list to logs\collboxes_dump.txt) and 6 (picture mode), or the console word collboxes. Test builds only, the normal game does not have it.

sections.title: Install and Setup
lines: Changed the update so the launcher only rebuilds the city files when the way they are made really changed. Before, every update with another build number rebuilt them, and an install without the game discs got the message to run Disc Install again, even for a small update. Now the install keeps a level builder version number next to the built levels, and the launcher compares it with the one of the new version. An install that already has its city files and no number yet keeps them and just takes the number. The message is shorter and says what to do: this version changes the city files, insert your game discs to rebuild them (all 20 languages, machine translated). The unit tests and the upgrade gate (1305 to 1306) ran.

Changed updates so a shipped text file you edited is merged with the new version instead of being kept whole or replaced. This covers the level edit files (edits_*.txt of a pack), carsheet.ini and the car name lists. The launcher keeps the last shipped copy of each as a base, and the result is the new file plus your changes. When both changed the same line, your line wins and the new file is saved next to it as <name>.new, and the update log says so. Your own file is saved to updates/merge_backup first. The first update with this rule has no base yet, so it keeps your file and saves the new one as .new. config.ini is not merged. Checked with the upgrade gate (five files, two with a conflict, one with 90000 lines, byte for byte) and unit tests.

Added a guard to the launcher for the 64 bit game. The signed update list now says which processor type and which Windows version a build needs. A launcher on 32 bit Windows, or on Windows 7, 8 or 8.1, does not offer or install an update it cannot run: nothing is downloaded or changed, the game stays on the last version that runs on this PC, and the launcher says why in plain words (20 languages). Play keeps working. The launcher is now version 0.1.1: an older launcher that does not know the rule updates itself first, so the guard is in place before a 64 bit build reaches anybody. The release tool refuses to publish a 64 bit only list without a deliberate flag, without that launcher version, or with a 64 bit launcher exe. Only the unit tests ran, with the machine faked as 32 bit Windows 10 and 64 bit Windows 7.

Added a silent download of the city files to the launcher. When an update changes how the city files are made and your install has no game discs, the launcher no longer only asks you to insert them: while the public game data is on, it downloads the base data file by itself, installs it in place the same way the installer does, and stores the new version number. It only does this when the signed data list says its city files are made by the same version as the update. The window shows the progress and says when it is done. If the download is not possible, not verified, or fails, you get the disc message as before, and nothing is changed. Your saves, settings and mods are not touched. The public data goes private at 0.5.0, so this stops then. Only unit tests with a local server and a stand-in for the installer ran.

Added two buttons to the launcher Options window, next to Account: Mod Tools and Server Hosting. Mod Tools downloads the tools for making mods as one zip file, Server Hosting downloads the files to host an online server on Linux or as a TrueNAS app. Both save to your Downloads folder, check the download against a signed list first, and say plainly when nothing is published yet. Only the automatic tests ran, with fixtures and a local test server, not the real server.

I added three more games to the launcher: reDriver: Extended (unofficial), REDRIVER (soapy version) and REDRIVER2 (soapy version). Arrows at the sides of the picture switch between the four games, each with its own picture, version line and button; the last game is remembered. Each extra game installs into its own folder next to the launcher (REDRIVER, REDRIVER2, reDriver - Extended) from a signed list on the server: the package and the data of your region are checked and unpacked by the launcher, no setup program and no Java. Until the server has the files the page says Not available yet. Tested with fixtures only,

I added an Online Services light to the top right of the launcher on the reDriver 2: Extended page. It checks the room list server, the file server, the account server and the room servers in the background with the game's own messages, and shows green when all answer, yellow when some do and red when none do. Hover it to see each service. Tested against fake servers and the real account server of the unit tests,

Held the extra game pages of the launcher back for now: they are not in the arrow order or the dots, and nothing of them can install, download or open Options. The launcher shows two pages for now. Tested by the unit tests and the layout test (21 languages, 4 scales),

I moved the Sign in / Sign up chip of the launcher so it shows only on the reDriver 2: Extended page. The other pages have no account chip and no What is new link, and their gear opens the Options of that game only. Tested by the layout test,

I built our own C disc installer for REDRIVER (the Driver 1 Windows CD) and REDRIVER2 (Driver 2 disc 1): the launcher opens the same Disc Install card as the main game with one disc row, and the setup program makes the game folder from your own disc (no Java, no old setup.exe). Tested on the real discs with the engine alone (PC disc 12 s, Driver 2 disc 3 s) and in the layout test, The REDRIVER2 movies are not converted yet. Both pages are held back for now.

Gave the install of reDriver: Extended (unofficial) in the launcher the same progress card as the main game: four steps (download the program files, download the game data, install the program files, install the game data), one bar with one percent, the Cancel link, the error line when a download or check fails, and a second try goes on from the part files that are already there. The lump flow itself is unchanged (RDLUMP01 lumps, sha256 pinned by the signed list). Tested with the flow and layout unit tests (new card views),

Fixed the launcher install missing the five attract demos and the sample objects of the level editor. The update list treated them as the player's own files and left them out, so a launcher install had less than the zip. Both are listed now.

Fixed the update from 0.4.0 builds: the old launcher on players' PCs refused the new update list because it named the attract demos and the level editor sample objects, files it treats as the player's own. Those files are left out of the update list until build 1308, so every launcher can take the update in place. Tried with the real 0.4.0 launcher against a local server and by an automatic upgrade check,

Added the Driver 1 PlayStation disc installer of reDriver: Extended: the setup checks the US disc by its boot file and the five overlay hashes, keeps the raw 2352 image, the boot file, a cue sheet and version.ini in the game folder's DISC, and the launcher page reDriver: Extended (id redriver-d1, folder reDriver - Extended, exe reDriver_extended.exe) has one disc row with its own check; the main game's Driver 1 row still wants the other US dump. Tried on the real US disc (one read-only run, the copied image byte identical) and by automatic checks, The launcher card in a real window and the game program.

sections.title: Performance and Stability
lines: Made the game a 64 bit program. It can use more than 4 GB of memory, so big cities and bonus cities have room, and the old 2 GB limit is gone. The simulation is the same bit for bit as the 32 bit game: the tick hash of 188 test scenarios is equal, the pictures of the smoke set are equal, the online room test with two 64 bit games ran with equal hashes. Needs 64 bit Windows 10 or 11. The update replaces the game and its DLLs in place. No player play, no in place update from a 32 bit install yet (needs the signing key).

sections.title: Driving and Cars
lines: Changed the police back to near the original: the original respawn time and cop strength, and a Patrol Cars option (default Few) for how many patrol cars drive around.
Changed police backup cars to appear out of view, a distance away that depends on your speed, and wait while their nose is in a wall.
Changed the siren of your own car (the horn of a car with a siren) to flash the cop lights on the street.
Added Options > People & Traffic > Traffic Cars to choose Extended or Vanilla and each car pack.
Stopped the traffic clean-up from removing the car you just got out of, it stays at the gas pump while you fill up.
Fixed the game freezing when you try to open Customize while on foot.
Changed mods to apply to Driver 2 cars borrowed from other cities: car models, cosmetics and denting.
Fixed police cars from other cities driving as civilian traffic, they are labelled Police now.
Fixed a crash in the customizer when deleting, adding or duplicating a light or exhaust item.

Added a Visible row and a Make editable lamp row for every built-in lamp in the customizer (headlight, indicators, brake and reverse lights), the editable copy has its own position, colour, size and behaviour.
Changed traffic stops to work per player, a patrol car of any player can stop a driver.
Changed the start car you chose, and its saved look, to apply to the driving game modes too (Getaway, Gate Race, Checkpoint, Trailblazer, Survival, Capture the Flag).
Fixed restarts: the fuel tanks refill when the level loads.
Fixed restarts keeping the old traffic stops: the stop and its generator reset at level load, and so do the stop timers, so patrol cars come at the same time as in a fresh start.
Fixed restarts keeping the old CB radio timers and offers.
Fixed restarts keeping the old police state (backup cars, bust hold, offence window, cool-down).
Fixed restarts keeping the old fare passenger generator.
Fixed restarts keeping the old GPS routes and flow fields, the GPS no longer keeps the route of the game before.
Fixed restarts keeping the old auto-drive request, warm-up, waypoints and settings.
Changed the police chase road following to exact whole number distances (it was one unit off on some machines).
Changed the road snap of jobs, game modes and cops to whole numbers, and fixed a short curve picking the wrong direction.
Changed street race distances, rival progress and the prize to whole numbers, a prize that was one dollar short on some builds is exact now.
Changed the GPS arrow and the nearest road point to whole numbers, the aim point can differ by one unit from before.

Changed the traffic avoidance (safe speed behind a car and at crossings, aim vectors, the junction box rule, and later its settings) to whole numbers, cars in a jam can take another but equally valid path now.
Fixed job pay always going to the wallet of player 1, it goes to the player who did the job.
Fixed the traffic stop fine and the mission maker time bonus going to the wrong player.
Added an option in the car sheet settings, off by default, that lets a car with a performance sheet use its sheet numbers for its full throttle push, cars without a sheet drive as before.
Fixed the speed estimate of rear heavy rear wheel drive cars, they no longer launch too slowly on paper, and front and all wheel drive follow their own traction limits.
Changed the car pool, the car picker and the traffic menu to read one shared car catalog.
Added 0 to 60 mph, top speed and class to the Car tab of the customizer and to the car picker of the multiplayer lobby, for cars that have a sheet (in all languages).
Removed the unused chrome reflection map of cars and its three switches, the pictures stay the same.
Removed the old software car drawing, the graphics card now draws every car, and removed the GPU Cars option and its texts.
Changed the game to use a real random number generator, the cop speech and sound draws no longer touch the numbers of the simulation.
Changed old replays from before the new random numbers to be refused with a message on the screen and a log line.
Added My Cars to the customizer, a list of your saved cars per profile.
Fixed the My Cars list staying open when the customizer closes.
Fixed a restart in the middle of a race or job not giving back a fresh job state, only your career stays.
Fixed pedestrians keeping their attention rolls from the game before after a restart.
Added console commands for car, weather and timescale.
Fixed the console teleport and spawn putting the car below the road.
Fixed the unlit Gran Turismo cars (the 180SX) being flat white at night, they now take a quarter of the ambient level.
Fixed the Gran Turismo cars in the cars folder being loaded at start, which used up the texture space and broke the car textures; they are optional cars again and never traffic.

Changed the ambient traffic: cars now appear farther ahead of you and in smaller groups, a car in view is no longer removed, and there is a limit of 1000 cars and 500 pedestrians in the city (config keys ambientCarLimit and ambientPedLimit).

Changed the 39 Driver 2 cars into car files (with a writer that reads them from the discs and a check that compares them), and put the tank, sound set and effects inside the car files. The old way of reading those cars from the disc image and its switches are gone.
Added one naming scheme for the cars in the customizer and the pickers, with a carNames setting (the car name first and the game in brackets).
Added a scan of the Driver 2 discs for cars that never made it into the game, it found none.
Fixed the wheels of cars not turning in Watch A Demo.

Changed the game to read car files (.car) directly, one file per car, a damaged one is logged and skipped. A mod car in the old form is turned into a car file with the convert command, and the package cache is .carbin.
Changed car files that are packages (model, textures, engine sound and wheel designs) to work in the game.
Changed a car file to carry its own performance sheet, the cop, taxi, pin, sound and label data, and the convert tool packs the old sheet file into it.

Changed the original cars to take their handling numbers from the sheet inside their car file by default (setting sheetPins), the numbers are the same so nothing changes in the game, and the old table in the code is only used for a car without a sheet.
Changed the customizer to save the car lights and exhausts in your profile, they win over the car file and the mods.

Added an unfinished flag for cars. Flagged cars stay out of the lists unless showUnfinishedCars is 1, and the pink Driver 1 civilian car is flagged. The Credits car 5 and the Los Angeles car 2 are no longer flagged and keep their high detail model.
Fixed red and white noise on the start car after Esc > Restart, the car buffers are built again.
Changed the police to never more than 3 patrol cars in the whole level and none in the background traffic.
Fixed a restart late in a game not starting like a fresh start, the cop path search kept its old queue.
Changed the driving maths to whole numbers (cop chases, traffic, taxi fares, the GPS arrow, fuel and money), so the game plays the same on every PC. A few things can differ by one unit.
Added a setting physicssubsteps (1 to 4, default 1) that runs the player car physics in finer steps for very fast cars.
Added real paint pictures for car packages, a car can now bring up to four paints for the customizer.
Added a Car Realism row to the pause menu (Real, Scaled, Capped). Replays made with other car sheets or another realism setting are flagged.

Added an experimental Gran Turismo driving option (sheetPhysics in config.ini, with carsheet.ini on): real brakes with ABS, tyre grip, engine revs from the car sheet and drive wheels that follow the car layout. It is off by default and still being tuned, so Gran Turismo cars drive like Driver 2 cars in 0.4.0.
Changed fast sheet cars so crash damage grows with the speed squared above about 70 km/h (sheet physics only, off by default).
Changed the car to car hit limit so a fast sheet car hitting another car at 300 km/h is no softer than one at 100 km/h (sheet cars only).
Changed the police so they keep up with a fast sheet car above 150 km/h (sheet cars only).
Fixed tyre marks going missing, the corner numbers were too small and dropped every mark in some places.
Fixed the rev needle dropping to zero and the engine sound going wrong when a car goes faster than its gearbox covers.
Fixed saved replays losing the last few seconds of the pad recording.
Changed tyre marks to stay on the road for a whole in-game day instead of a couple of seconds. skidMarkMinutes and skidMarkMax in config.ini set how long and how many.

Gran Turismo cars with the real driving physics turn like the normal cars again at city speeds (full steering up to 45 mph, more tyre grip), settle after a turn instead of floating, and slow down when you lift off the gas.
Fixed Gran Turismo cars with the real driving physics not steering above 75 mph. They keep the full steering lock up to 75 mph and at least half of it up to top speed.
Fixed the car body missing in the customizer, the garage and My Cars.

Fixed the cars in the Driver 1 cities floating on their wheels. The city levels carry their own car data (wheel places, collision points, denting), but the game stopped reading the level before it got to that data and used the Driver 2 Rio cars' numbers instead.
Changed the Car Realism row of the Gameplay options to say 'Needs sheet physics (experimental)' while the sheet physics option is off, because it did nothing then. Tested with picture evidence.
Fixed the paint swatches of a car package in the customizer, they were all white, now they show the paint colour. Tested In-Game: Functioning
Changed the pedestrian defaults: up to 150 pedestrians (was 100), grouped closer to you, never closer than 12 cells, and they appear ahead of a moving player too.
Fixed the pedestrian limit: it is a hard cap now. A lowered limit takes the surplus away, farthest first and never one in sight closer than 30 cells.

Added a ragdoll for the Driv3r pedestrians: a hit pedestrian starts from the car speed, folds onto the hood, slides up the windscreen, tumbles over the roof and lands behind the car. Draw only, the simulation is unchanged.

Fixed cars that came out with white bodies after a few hundred streamed cars. The cause was in the car texture registry: the image and the palette rows of a car page stayed alive after the car was given up, until another car landed on exactly that page, and the 4095 rows of the palette texture ran out. They go back at once now. The picture batch made all 1530 cars of the catalog in one run with 0 white (before: white from about car 240, 766 white at car 1025).
Raised the bodies of the Driver 1 cars so they sit as high over the wheels as the Driver 2 cars.
Added a camber setting to the wheel position page of the customizer to tilt the wheels, for looks only.
Made Gran Turismo cars reach the top speed of their car sheet and still drive like Driver 2, with up to 6 gears. New option GT Car Top Speed (Sheet or Driver 2).
Added towed trailers: the Semi Truck with Trailer pulls a real trailer that swings in turns, folds up when reversing and can jack-knife.
Made the trailer of the Semi Truck with Trailer hit buildings, walls, lamp posts and barriers like the cab does.
Moved the rear camera views of the Semi Truck with Trailer back behind the whole trailer, so they no longer sit inside it.
Added a Versions tab to the car customizer that lists the race, livery and trim versions of your car and puts one on in place.

Made the Paint tab of the car customizer show all eight paint slots of the engine, not only the first six. No car shows more paints than before. Going beyond six paints per car file needs a new .car format.
Raised the number of paints a car can have from 5 to 19 behind the base, and the Paint tab shows them in a grid.
Fixed the wheels of the semi truck and its trailer, which now sit on the tyres under the box and the cab sits on its wheels. The setup has to be run again.
Made the wheels of the converted Gran Turismo 2 cars a little smaller so the tyres no longer poke through the fenders. The setup has to be run again.
Fixed a black wedge on the bonnet of many converted Gran Turismo 2 cars.
Removed the tyre pictures from the sides of the semi trailer box, only the round wheels show now. The setup has to be run again.
Fixed the Gran Turismo top speed and gears getting lost on a restart.
Raised the body of the converted Gran Turismo cars over their wheels, like the Driver 1 cars, so the tyres no longer clip through the fenders. The setup has to be run again.
Fixed the car families: a family is one model of one generation, and the Gran Turismo 1 and 2 cars of that generation are one family, for example the Supra A80 and A70.
Fixed the gears of the Gran Turismo cars: the car no longer sits in 4th gear, the tachometer, the sound and the HUD follow its real gearbox, up to 6 gears.

Changed the cockpit view to a simple 3D cabin built from your car body, with seats, dash, pillars and a rear window, where you turn your head left, right and back. (experimental, off by default, not finished)
Added a 3D instrument cluster to the cockpit view: speedometer, tachometer, gear, fuel bar and lamps, glowing at night. (experimental, off by default, not finished)
Added a steering wheel to the cockpit view that turns with your steering, with two hands on the rim. (experimental, off by default, not finished)
Changed the customizer to save your cars only when you leave it, and a car with versions comes back in the version you put on last.
Added a version line to the multiplayer car picker: Left and Right go through the trims, race and livery versions of the car.
Added step by step undo (Ctrl+Z) to the car customizer, and the right stick button goes through the camera views on a pad.
Moved the headlight and brake light glow of the converted Gran Turismo cars up onto the real lamps, away from the bumper. The setup has to be run again.

Gave the pop-up headlight lids a body. They were thin plates, like little eyelids. Now every open lid is a small box: side faces in the colour of the car, a dark inside, and the lamp glass on the front of it, lit at night. The 75 percent rule for the light and the J key work as before. Pictures of the 180SX, RX-7, Corvette, NSX and Eunos Roadster looked at (closed, half, open, front and three-quarter). Cars with no glass polygon on the disc (RX-7 FD, GT1 cars) show a dark front.

Fixed Ctrl+S and Enter in the car effects editor of the customizer: the key press was cleared every frame, so neither ever worked. Unsaved lamp and exhaust edits are now saved with the Saved message when you leave the tab.

Added right-hand drive to the cockpit view (carfx line cockpitrhd 1: eye, seats, wheel and dials mirror to the other side), outside mirrors on both doors that show when you look to a side, and a carfx line cockpitclass 0..7 so a wizard car can say it is a convertible, bus or truck. Pictures looked at (sedan, forward and left, left-hand and right-hand). Not done: GT1 dashes, mirror in split screen. (experimental, off by default, not finished)

Made the car files the truth and the index files only a cache of them: a stale index line can no longer override a car that carries its own flags. Added rdcontent car index, which writes the index from the files. 9 s).

Made the Courier game keep a package that is still on the road when time is up: the carrier gets the share of the pay for the way he drove, with a message in all languages. The CB package timers now run in real seconds at 25 Hz PAL too; at 30 Hz the game state is unchanged. Checked by automatic tests,

Made the semi trailer's hit box its real size (2.9 x 3.3 x 13.8 m) instead of a car sized box, so it now meets buildings, walls and lamp posts where it really is. The trailer can also hit pedestrians now, it never could before. Checked by test runs and pictures on a scratch install: the trailer backing into a wall and into a lamp post, and into pedestrians.
Fixed scrolling the Versions tab of the car customizer with the mouse wheel throwing the list back to the top when a version is put on the car.

Fixed the car list in the customizer: the standard sedan of every city (Chicago, Havana, Las Vegas, Rio) is a row again. Its texture pages were never loaded, so 4 of the 39 Driver 2 cars were missing. Checked by automatic tests,

Car prices in the customizer now show in US dollars at 1978 prices (the Gran Turismo cars carried yen, converted and scaled back to the 1978 dollar), with a dollar sign, even for cars newer than 1978.

Cars that had no price now get one worked out from similar cars (class, power and age), and every car gets its own small spread with a sticker style ending, so the prices are no longer the same handful of numbers.

Marked the cockpit camera as experimental in the camera views list and switched it off by default, so the camera button no longer lands in it unless you turn it on in Options. The view itself stays in the game.

Rebuilt the exhaust pipe: a round tube with a bright rolled lip, a flat rim and a dark opening, shaped for the style (tail pipe, side exit, stack, hidden stub). Added nine exhaust types (rear single, rear dual, side mount, dual side mount, tall stack, quad rear, hidden stock, rear corner right, rear corner left) that work out the place of the pipes from the car model, and a stock stub under the rear bumper for every car without an effects file (Driver 1, Driver 2). Names are translated in all languages by hand. Checked by automatic tests and pictures,

Made the semi truck, the trailer and other heavy vehicles weigh what they are in a crash. Weight now comes from the size of the collision box (bus about 4 sedans, flatbed 12, the semi tractor 8, tractor with trailer 24). A heavy vehicle pushes cars along: at 60 km/h the semi into a stopped sedan keeps 98 percent of its speed (before: 21 percent), and a sedan that hits the stopped semi stops and the semi does not move. A heavy vehicle keeps 30 percent of a wall response: it stops at a building and does not bounce back, takes less damage from small cars, and snaps lamp posts and drives on. Normal cars and vans are exactly as before. Checked by automatic tests and pictures,

Changed the Lights and Exhaust tabs of the customizer so every light and the exhaust pipe are normal entries of the list: the built-in ones can be moved, resized, recoloured, switched off, copied and deleted like the ones you add, a pair of headlights or brake lights stays a pair, and Reset to original brings the car back as it came. Opening the tab and leaving it with no change writes nothing. Only the automatic checks and pictures ran.

Fixed the exhaust pipe editor: the smoke of a pipe you add now starts at the pipe (it started too high, about 85 units on the test car), a positive tilt lifts the pipe tip (it pushed it down), and a positive turn swings the tip outward on both sides of a pair (a pair turned the same way before). Looked at pictures from behind and from the side and ran the automatic checks, The old exhaust pipe check was stale after the new stock stub and is updated.
