Added all 621 Gran Turismo 2 cars as performance sheets, with the tyre block taken from the size and compound tables and a 30 car comparison. Tyre grip, load sensitivity and peak slip now come from the record curves for GT1 and GT2 the same way, and drive types 3 and 4 count as rear drive.
Left the two street Eunos Cosmo models out of the Gran Turismo cars, because their pop-up lamps float above the hood and the car does not look right.
Fixed flat coloured shapes (lane stripes, kerb marks) in the Driver 1 cities, they are no longer drawn as textured quads with a random page.
Fixed the lane directions of the Driver 1 cities, one way streets and 3 lane streets were mirrored, and 8 pieces in Los Angeles cut the north south streets.
Changed the world scale to be a setting of the city file, with a check that a Driver 1 lane fits the engine lane.
Gave the Driver 1 cities their own daytime sky colour and light, San Francisco paler, Los Angeles warm, Miami pastel, New York grey and cool.
Gave the Driver 1 cities the English police sirens and phrases and took away the Rio sound zones and tunnels.
Fixed 88 Gran Turismo cars that could not get past 51 km/h, their gear ratios were missing and are estimated now.
Fixed the Driver 1 cars that rode too high on their wheels, and the wrong colours on the credits_5 car.
Added the Driver 1 movies and a first version of the in-game cutscenes to the Driver 1 missions. The setup does not convert the Driver 1 movies yet, and the pickup scene is only like the original.

Fixed the Driver 1 import finding no movies before the missions on the v1.0 disc dump. The movie tables and the start table of the executable are now found by their shape, not by a fixed address, so both disc dumps give the same 44 missions with 36 movies.

Fixed the imported Driver 1 missions: the police missions (Survival, Getaway and others) now bring the cops, and a start inside a building moves to the nearest road. The target cars of the chase missions still only drive a short way and stop. Tested In-Game: Functioning

Fixed the police of the imported Driver 1 missions again: while you are wanted the cops know where you are, so the patrol car goes after you instead of vanishing, and backup cars come from out of sight (up to 5). Tested In-Game: Functioning
Changed the Driver 1 Survival missions (all eight): the police now send 8 cars, one every 2 seconds from the start, and fill up to 8 again when cars are lost. Tested In-Game: Functioning
Gave the imported Trail Blazer missions a longer clock because the 16 places are taken in order and 2:00 was too hard. Gave the imported Getaway and Pursuit missions more police cars.

Changed the police of the imported Getaway, Pursuit and Survival missions: the first car comes at once and one more every 2 seconds, and the wait before the first felony is gone. Shortened the Trail Blazer clocks.
Changed the police cars of the imported Getaway, Pursuit and Survival missions to come up on a street behind you with a clear line to you, so they no longer get stuck behind a house.
Added a wheel position editor to the Wheels tab of the car customizer: move the axles, the track width or single wheels, for Driver 2, Driver 1 and Gran Turismo cars. It is saved with the car.
Fixed the Gran Turismo 2 cars the setup makes from your disc: wheels, tyre sizes and body height now follow the disc, and trophy and licence entries are no longer listed as cars.
Fixed the Gran Turismo 2 car names, engine sounds and wheel designs, which came from the wrong files of the disc. The cars have to be made again with the setup.
Changed the Gran Turismo car names to Maker Model Grade in plain letters, and cars with the same name show their year.
Made the Gran Turismo 2 cars switch to their night look with the time of day, with lit lamps and windows at night.
Fixed the wheels of Gran Turismo 1 and 2 cars: front and rear wheels had swapped places, so many cars had the wheels out of their arches.

Fixed the tail lights, brake lights and head lights of the Gran Turismo cars sitting above the roof, so no glow showed and the wet road strips had nothing to follow. The setup now puts the lamps on the body. The cars need the setup run again.
Fitted the wheels of the Driver 1 cars to their wheel arches.
Made the tail lamps of the Driver 1 PC cars red instead of blue.
Linked the Gran Turismo 1 engine sounds to the real cars, so each car plays the engine of its own disc entry. The setup has to be run again.

Added the car facts of the Gran Turismo 1 disc to every Gran Turismo 1 car file: price, engine size, power, torque, redline, length, drive, engine type, turbo, the real paint names and the engine and exhaust sound. The Gran Turismo step of the setup has to run again. Nothing in the game shows it yet.
Changed the pop-up headlights of the Gran Turismo 1 cars so the lids move the way the disc moves them, on 67 cars. They need the cars made again by the setup.
Fixed the tail lights of the Gran Turismo 2 cars at night: the red glow no longer lies over the boot lid like a band, one soft halo sits on each lamp.
Fixed dark tail lamp lenses on the Corvette and many more Gran Turismo 2 cars, and made brake lights clearly brighter than parked lights.

Gave every Gran Turismo car without a sheet of its own on the disc the sheet of its base car: 433 of 456 Gran Turismo 2 cars and 159 of 166 Gran Turismo 1 cars. The sheets are marked ESTIMATE, so a race version is really faster. Cars have to be made again with the setup.
Made the car you chase in the Driver 1 chase missions keep driving as traffic when you come close, so it no longer stops after a few metres.
Gave nearly every Gran Turismo car a top speed and gear sheet. Race versions borrow the sheet of their base car, marked ESTIMATE. The setup has to be run again.
Fixed the tail lamps of the Suzuki Kei S and the lit lens of the Mercedes C43 in Gran Turismo 2. The setup has to be run again.

Fixed the brake lamps of the Rover Mini Cooper: its parking colours are dimmed in the converter so braking shows. The same rule covers any Gran Turismo car whose brake and parking colours are close. The cars must be made again by the setup.

Changed the Driver 1 PC cars to take the light positions of the civilian and police cars from the PC game files (headlights, indicators, brake and reverse lights, smoke, fire). Found how the PC game picks the light record from the car slot. The player cars keep the scaled PlayStation positions because the PC game builds their table inside its protected exe. The converter ran on the French PC disc into a scratch folder and the numbers were read back, I did not look at the lamps in the game.

Made the setup find the exhaust pipe that the texture of a Gran Turismo car draws (a small dark patch low on the rear end), put our pipe on that spot and pick the type of the car (single, dual, corner left or right). Where the texture shows none, the stock stub under the bumper stays. Cars must be made again by the setup. Checked on rear view pictures of 24 cars, The pipe finds 409 of 1073 GT2 cars, some of them on the wrong spot.
Moved the start spot of Newcastle onto a road that carries traffic. The old spot was on a dead end road. Needs the Driver 1 cities made again by the setup.
Fixed the street race job not starting in Newcastle. The race legs were longer than the city has road. The job now tries shorter legs when the long ones do not fit.

Made the chase cars of the Driver 1 missions (Bust Out Jean Paul, Take Out Di'angio's Car, the quick chases and the other chase missions) race away with the racer AI. The car drives off when you come close, ignores lights, picks a road far from you and a new one when you get near, and holds back when it is far ahead so you can still catch it. It always uses the racer policy, whatever the Smart Racer AI option says. Without the policy file it drives as traffic like before. Scripted checks on 1083, 1088 and 1157 pass (60 m and 100 m away in 600 ticks, hold back, no stop).

Fixed the night in the Driver 1 cities: San Francisco, Miami, New York and Newcastle only have day textures on the disc, so they are always day now (Take A Ride lists only the day, no more 5:49 AM dawn that was called night). Los Angeles stays night only. Los Angeles also gets street light pools along its roads at night.

Changed the Driver 1 day cities (San Francisco, Miami, New York, Newcastle) to offer day, dawn and dusk again, with no night, because the disc only has day textures for them. A night request starts the dusk, which lasts about 2 minutes before the clock goes back to the dawn. Los Angeles stays night only.

Added approximate street names for the Driver 1 cities San Francisco, Los Angeles, Miami and New York: about 25 main roads and a few area names, shown in the street popup and on the full screen map. The disc has no street names, so the game's roads were matched to the real cities by shape and position (Great Highway, Geary Blvd, Wilshire Blvd, Collins Ave, the avenues of New York ...). It is a guess, not exact, and roads without a good match have no name. Newcastle has none. Checked by automatic tests at three road points per city,

Fixed the target car of Driver 1 mission 1087 standing still. It was parked beside the road, so it could not pull out. I now put a parked chase car that is off every road piece into a lane of the nearest road. Cars on a road stay where they are.

Made the Driver 1 converters, the Driver 1 PC level reader and the mission and movie readers refuse damaged files that could wrap a size check. The output for good files is the same. The tracker music player was also tried with 16000 damaged copies of the real Driver 2 music file, no crash.

Made the traffic of the five Driver 1 cities use the police cruisers of the city being played. San Francisco, Los Angeles, Miami, New York and Newcastle used to mix in cruisers of the other Driver 1 cities. Now the cruisers are those of the city, as in the original. The first version of this also locked the civilian cars, the cab and the Driver 2 cars out; that part was taken back the same day, see the next entry. Checked by automatic tests in all five cities (no off-city cruiser),

Fixed the cars falling into the sea when they leave the road on a hill in San Francisco and Los Angeles. The cells beside the roads there counted as deep sea and had no ground, so a car that left the road fell and died. They are ground now when they join the slope of the road (a cliff stays sea). Miami and New York are unchanged, the New York deck gap is NOT fixed. Checked by automatic tests (a car put on a hillside in both cities stays on the ground), The levels have to be made again from the discs to get it.

Put the cars of both games back into the traffic of every city. The five Driver 1 cities show Driver 1 cars, Driver 2 cars (the specials from model 8 to 12 too) and the cab again, as the Driver 2 cities always did. Only the police cruisers are the city's own. Newcastle, the smallest city, showed 22 Driver 1 and 15 Driver 2 models in a long test run, New York 52 and 25. The Driver 2 cities did not change. Checked by automatic tests,

Built the Driver 1 training courses. The eight courses (Time trial and Practice 1 to 4) on the Training level now show only their own cone and pole set, count in with 3, 2, 1, GO while the car is locked and the clock stands still, number the laps (Lap 2 of 6), and the time trials end with your time and the best time of the course, which stays in your save. The start of the Training level is no longer moved onto a road (it put course 1 against a wall). The Driver 1 Missions mod has to be made again (setup) to get it. The three films and the two interviews are still plain drives. Checked by automatic tests and pictures, The cones falling over was not run in the game (their model data says smashable).

Added speed traps to the Driver 1 cities (6 each in Frisco, Los Angeles, Miami and New York). The contract board and the night and rain pay already worked there, now tested. City Music rows for Driver 1 cities are not added, the game has no Driver 1 city music.
Corrected two Driver 1 car names after the review: a Chevrolet C10 and a Ford.
Fixed the wheel positions of two more Driver 1 cars (the Newcastle coupe and the Newcastle muscle car).

Fixed the purple glass panes of the storefronts in Driver 1 Miami. The glass key colour of the Driver 1 palettes now becomes a dark blue glass tint when the city loads. The other Driver 1 cities use the same key and get the same tint. Looked at in two Miami pictures,

Checked the 17 Driver 1 missions where you chase or wreck a car with scripts: the car drives off when you come close and the mission ends complete once it is wrecked, in all of them. Checked that no car goes under the ground in the four Driver 1 cities. The known problems in the README say this now.

Puts a street floor under the elevated roads of Driver 1 New York. The deck and the ramp near the road end floated over the sea. The setup now adds the floor when it makes the city, the driving surface is not changed (a car on the deck behaves the same, checked old against new). A new New York level has to be made to see it. Checked by log check and pictures,

Makes the Driver 1 training films 1 to 3 real. A lead car now drives the run the original recorded, the position log of your own disc, with the recorded speed, and you follow it; the film ends when it stops at the last place. Interview 1 gets the same lead car (the interview rules are not in yet). It is a normal car that one new call in the existing car control hook drives with the pad. Made by the setup from your disc, so the mission files have to be made again. Checked by unit tests and a log check,

Adds the Driver 1 credits ride (mission 127). The credits of the original roll up over the Credits level at the original pace while the car drives itself along the road, and the ride ends when the roll is over. The text is read from your own disc by a new setup step (rdcontent d1mission credits) into your own mod folder only, it is not part of the game files. Without that file the mission stays a free drive. The car drives itself on the road lanes, the original played a recorded run that this engine cannot play. The face pictures are not drawn. Checked by unit tests, a log check and pictures,

Adds the rules of the Driver 1 interview (missions 173 and 174). The test keeps a score from 5000, adds points for the weave through the two lanes of cones that the original scored, takes a penalty for a hit (one every second at most, four wreck the test), and judges you when the time is up and the car has stopped: wrecked, out of time, or you get the job. Six parked cars stand on the course. The texts and the scoring data are read from your own disc into your own mod folder, not part of the game files. The lead car of interview 1 drives the recorded run. Not in yet: the dial, the pad display, the voices. The interview level itself still shows water instead of the car park, so it cannot be driven properly yet. Checked by unit tests and a log check,

Fixes the Driver 1 interview level. The car started on the water far from the car park, because the start was moved to the nearest road, 14805 units away over the sea. Now the start stays where the mission puts it, in the car park with the pillars, the low ceiling and the six parked police cars. The new test d1iview_ground checks that the start is kept and that the cars stay on the ground.

Makes the setup write the Driver 1 credits roll and the interview rules from your own disc, in the Driver 1 missions step: the credits ride (mission 127) and the two interview tests (173 and 174) work after a normal install, no extra command. The new line Driver 1 credits and interview is in the setup report, and its texts are in all 21 languages. The interview time limit is now read from the disc too: 30 seconds on the clock, 1800 ticks, instead of a guess. Tested with a game folder made by the setup itself (the logchecks for films, credits and interview pass there).

Changes how the Driver 1 interview is passed, to the rule of the original: you get the job when you have shown all nine driving moves (wheelspin, handbrake, the first and second half of the course, a handbrake turn, hard cornering, a fast reverse turn, a hard stop, braking from speed). Running out of time is a fail, as in the original, and the score does not decide. The speeds and turn rates are the original numbers scaled to the Driver 2 car, they are checked by unit tests only.

Removed five models that are not cars from the Gran Turismo 1 car list: the cup trophy, the GT logo and three licence plates. They showed up as flat slabs on wheels. The setup no longer converts them, an older install loses their files on the next Disc Install, and their pictures are out of the car photos. Setup builds and the GT unit tests pass,
Found the Driver 1 story movies on the European, French, German and Italian discs, so the movie list shows 44 missions with movies on all six discs.
Added the night look of the Gran Turismo 2 cars to their car files: lit lamps and windows, and the night model for the cars whose night model differs. The game does not switch to it yet.

Added pop-up headlights for 22 Gran Turismo 1 cars (RX-7 FC and FD, Eunos Roadster, 180SX, the two Supra A70): the lamp lids tilt up when the lights come on, and the glow and beam show only when the lid is up.

Changed the setup so every Gran Turismo car with a car sheet on the disc carries it in its car file, so the Gran Turismo Car Top Speed option and the 5th and 6th gear work in the install (617 of 1073 Gran Turismo 2 cars, 178 of 344 Gran Turismo 1 cars). The cars need to be made again by the setup.

Moved the head light of the Gran Turismo 2 cars onto the real headlamp glass: it shows dark glass when off and a lit glass with a glow when on (1059 of 1073 cars). The cars must be made again by the setup.
Changed the pop-up headlights so the lid is one solid piece that turns up about a hinge, with a dark pocket under it. The setup has to be run again.
Made the exhaust search of the setup prefer a pipe patch low on the bumper over plate screws and lamp rims.

Centred the wheels of the Driver 1 cars in their wheel openings. The old rule found no opening on most cars, so many wheels stood in a corner of the opening, sat too far forward or showed through the fender. 42 of the 63 cars change and the tyre size follows the opening. The Driver 1 cities are not rebuilt yet.

Named all 63 Driver 1 cars after the real cars they look like (make, model, years), for example Ford Thunderbird (1957) instead of Thunderbird look-alike. The Ferrari 250 SWB keeps its name and every car keeps its id, so saves and mods work as before. The names are best guesses from the pictures and

Changed the Driver 1 car names to the real cars listed in the Internet Game Cars Database; matched by looking at the models, Every name is Make Model (year) with the year as that list shows it, police cars and taxis say so, and the Ferrari 250 SWB and the Thunderbird (1955) keep their names. Many are still best guesses.
Fixed turning on one Gran Turismo car switching off the Gran Turismo traffic; the 1983 cars stay on and picked cars are added
Corrected the readme: all 123 Driver 1 missions import. The training courses are real, the films, the interviews and the credits ride are only approximations.
Changed the Driver 1 car pictures (the lists and the Choose A Ride photos) so the wheels sit in the middle of the openings.

sections.title: Graphics and Lighting
lines: Changed the water to reflect the sky, so the clouds and the sun show in it.
Fixed a black box that showed around a wheel when its hubcap flew off.
Added a flat water reflection to the Driver 1 cities, made from the water tiles of the level.
Added three car options: Exhaust Pipes, Tail Lamp Glow and Handbrake Brake Light (all off by default). View Distance can now go down to 1. All translated.
Changed the flat car shadow to stay still again, it no longer slides with the sun. The Sun Shadows setting is the moving shadow.
Changed the 3D grass patches to follow the slope of the ground.
Changed the grass patches to be a little less regular.

Added a texture manager for car and level textures, so a picture is no longer stuck to a 256 x 256 page or 16 colours. All textures are drawn through it now, and colour cycling and the day and night swap follow the textures.
Changed the GPU cars to use their pages as indexed materials with the texture manager (home city cars, borrowed cars, Driver 1 and Gran Turismo cars).
Changed indexed car pages to follow the bilinear filtering setting.
Changed customizer paint changes and the day to night swap to reach the car materials.
Fixed roads at long view distances losing their lane stripes, kerb edges and crossing marks, the far map now bakes the high detail road and ground tiles.
Fixed far buildings and props losing parts at long view distances. The far map now uses the full detail model of every object.
Changed the normal view to never switch buildings and ground tiles to the lower detail model with distance.
Changed the picture to be smooth in split screen with 2 to 8 players and while the game is paused, every view now moves with the same timing.
Changed the game to keep the city's draw data in a few big memory blocks and draw each pass with far fewer calls.
Changed the background traffic to draw in groups per car model, Draw Calls reduced from 1160 to 406 in rush hour test scenario.
Changed split screen views to draw less far away, with a closer fog and smaller shadow and reflection maps in a small view, so split screen runs faster.
Changed the cars in the shadow maps to draw in groups, and left out cars that cannot shadow anything in that map.
Made the effect streams (background layer, shadow casters, car groups) go to the card through a mapped buffer so the driver stops waiting.
Moved the objects around you (street lamps, barriers, trees, signs, animated objects like traffic lights) to the graphics card, and the city walk now only covers the near ring.
Changed the game to tell the graphics card to start working at the end of every pass, which lifts the rush hour test from about 650 to 750 fps. It can be turned off in display.ini.
Changed the sky to draw after the solid world, so only the open pixels run the sky, and the road reflection redraws every second frame above 250 fps, both for a single view only.
Moved the background cars and the crowd to the graphics card.

Changed the graphics card batch to be the only renderer at every view cells setting, the old 10 cell view is gone. The draw radius is now a fog and cull distance, the original reach is back to 20 cells and the fog starts half way to the draw distance.
Moved smoke, sparks, debris, leaves, birds, tyre tracks, light glows and rain to a new graphics card effect pass and deleted the old processor effect code.
Moved the lens flare, the wet road reflections, the ground light and the round shadows to the graphics card as effect quads.
Fixed the lines between the two stacked views in two player split screen showing old picture bits, they are cleared to black each frame.
Made the game skip graphics calls that set something already set (program, buffers, textures, framebuffer).
Removed the upscaled high quality sky from the game, the vanilla sky stays.
Moved the drawing of pedestrian heads, Tanner, traffic cones, the hubcap, event models and smashed objects to the graphics card. This is faster and the old drawing code is gone.
Moved the flat shadow under a car to the graphics card.
Moved explosions to the graphics card.
Changed pedestrians to use the graphics card limb drawing in split screen too.
Moved the mission target arrows, the stop zone and the helicopter rotor blades to the graphics card.

Added a Render Scale row to the display settings. It draws the 3D world smaller or bigger than the window and scales it to fit while the HUD and minimap stay sharp. 50 to 100 percent runs faster, 125, 150 and 200 percent draw sharper. In all languages.
Changed the sun shadows to work with the original painted sky.
Added six graphics presets (Classic, Classic: Extended, Extended Low, Medium, High, Max) that set the graphics options in one step, also as the console command preset, in all languages.
Fixed the Classic frame limit staying locked after switching to PAL, and a broken fpsfree value now means unlimited.
Removed the wholeMap setting. The whole map is always drawn now, and an old config.ini with the key still loads.
Fixed road markings, crosswalks and kerbs flickering on the road, overlapping ground pieces are now drawn in layers in the same order as the PlayStation game.
Fixed signs flickering, a sign made of a front and a back piece now draws one side.
Fixed the ferris wheel disappearing at a distance, big objects now draw out to the end of the fog.
Lifted the headlight and brake light pools of a car a little off the road, so their far part no longer disappears into the road.
Changed Tanner's shadow on foot to show (the old one was never visible), and the pedestrian sprite fallback moved to the effect pass.
Added a setting for modders, texMgrCompat. The default 0 gives smooth textures in the distance, 1 draws them like the old way.
Moved the painted original sky to the graphics card, so it shows the clouds and skyline again where the old path showed one flat colour.
Changed the sun, the lens flare and the moon of the original sky to effect sprites, and the glare of the sun now depends on how much of the sun disc is really visible.
Made the light trails of lamps and car lights and the full screen flash of lightning, explosions and the sun effect quads on the graphics card, same picture as before.

Fixed the ghost cars at night: headlight beams and red lights showed on the road for cars that are not drawn. The flat back light patch is off with dynamic lights and far cars get lamps only when they have a body.
Changed the night roads of Las Vegas and Rio to be readable, each city has a night ground brightness key (light.nightground).
Changed the brightness of the Driver 1 cities, Los Angeles no longer clips lit shop windows to flat white.
Gave the Driver 1 cities the PlayStation dusk light, flat shading, a dusk sky and nearest texture sampling.
Fixed the fence mosaic at dusk in Vegas, the transparent parts of the day and night textures are mixed now.
Changed dynamic lights to run much faster, every screen tile only uses the lights that reach it, the cost fell by about half at 4K.
Raised the limit of dynamic lights from 256 to 1024 and the car and lamp light caps to 160 and 512.
Changed every near street lamp to be a dynamic light (160 by default), brighter and higher, with a smaller glow sprite.
Fixed the flat headlight patch under cars while dynamic lights are on, and beams fade in at the range edge instead of popping.
Fixed blocky lighting in busy streets and visible tile edges when the camera turns, and added a debug mode that paints tile errors.
Fixed the crosswalks flickering on the road, road pieces that only touch at a seam no longer pile up on top of each other.
Added an optional OpenGL 4.3 drawing route, it is off by default and set with gl43 in config.ini.
Fixed Las Vegas at night, the lamp posts no longer stay pale grey.
Fixed loose pedestrian heads floating around in the free camera. They are not drawn any more.
Fixed a car texture page that no swap wrote: it holds the day set now (Havana started at night).
Changed the texture manager to be the only way the game draws textures. If the graphics card cannot start it, the game says so and stops.
Removed the PGXP Texture Correction and PGXP Z-Buffer options from Developer Options. Both always ran on and still do, so only a player who had turned one off loses that choice.

Rebuilt the photo mode camera panel: Focal Length, Zoom and FOV move together (24 mm is the normal view), with a tracking aim at a target, and a panel with tabs you can use with the keyboard, the pad or the mouse.

Added photo mode image sliders: Exposure, Brightness, Contrast, Colour (black and white at the left end), Sepia and White Temperature, plus a softer vignette with Size, Softness, Shape and Colour rows. The panel itself is never toned.

Added photo mode scene and car settings: Time Of Day, Weather (rain), headlights, high beams and Steering that turns the front wheels. All of it goes back to how the game was when you leave, and the simulation is not changed.
Added photo mode presets: three slots that Save Preset, Load Preset and Reset All keep between games.
Strengthened the photo mode depth of field: the blur discs are five times as large, so aperture, focus and bokeh show clearly even at the default 24 mm lens.
Added a first version of 3D tree shadows: a tree throws a round crown shadow and not a pole. The trees themselves look the same. Off by default.

Added a pedestrian model set that draws civilians as Driv3r character models, made by the setup from your own Driv3r disc. The models are scaled to Tanner and the Driver 2 sprites. Draw only, the simulation is not touched.

Added shadows for the Driv3r pedestrians: a slim volume goes into the sun and moon shadow map the cars and trees use, and the 24 pedestrians nearest to the camera cast the shadow of their real posed shape. Off when the shadow map is off.
Fixed the turbo walk of scared Driv3r pedestrians: a pedestrian that jumps away from a car or runs now plays the run clip, and goes back to the walk clip when it slows down, so it does not flicker.
Made the shader cache build safer: a shader that does not compile is skipped instead of stopping the game, and the build gives up after 120 seconds if a driver hangs.

Changed the ragdoll of a hit pedestrian: a body at rest settles into the Driv3r die pose that lies the same way, the arms no longer pass through the torso, a body thrown at a wall stops at it, and a lying body sinks into the road instead of popping out.

Added street lamp shadows at night (Lamp shadows setting). The two lamps nearest the camera cast shadows of trees, poles, cars and pedestrians on the road and the wall behind. On in Extended Medium, High and Max.
Fixed the light streaks of headlights and street lamps switching themselves off for half of every nine minutes of play.

Made the Driv3r pedestrians the default pedestrian set. With no pedModelSet in config.ini and no console choice, the game uses the Driv3r models when they are converted and falls back to the Driver 2 sprites with one log line when they are not. New value auto (config.ini, console ped set auto) asks for the default again.

Smoothed level textures in the distance. Far walls, windows and road lines are averaged over the pixels they cover, so they shimmer and sparkle less while you drive. Near textures look the same. New setting indexedMips in config.ini under [render], 1 is the default, 0 gives the old look.
Made the lit lamps of the Gran Turismo 2 cars light up at night: headlamp glass, tail lamps and lit windows. The cars have to be made again by the setup.
Added a real rear view mirror to the cockpit view that shows what is behind you, with a Mirror Quality option (Off, Low, High) under Camera Views. (experimental, off by default, not finished)

Changed the pop-up headlight lids to open together with the lamp ramp at dusk, not after it. Checked by automatic tests (lids down by day, up at night), Not done: lit sprites of Havana and Vegas (need a decision first for a third colour table entry) and the cycling neon.

Made the game know what is water: water models are marked now, and the water look uses that mark instead of guessing water from a blue colour. Water reflection and Water Brightness behave as before (8 water, rain and night scenes compared: same picture, only moving boats and lamps differ). Driver 1 cities still find their water by the height of the water plane. Edited water pieces in a Driver 2 city no longer count as water unless they are in a water model.

Added light colours per car in the customizer: headlights, indicators, tail lights, brake lights and reverse lights can be white, warm yellow, cool white, amber, red or any colour you set. The colour changes the glow, the headlight beams and the brake light on the road. The colours were checked only by log and picture.

Fixed the missing 3D tree shadows: the setting stood at off (the old small dark squares) when a config did not name it, so only the presets Medium, High and Max showed them. A new or old tweaks.ini now gets the finest tree shadows, a round crown shadow that follows the sun from morning to dusk. Checked by automatic tests and pictures,

Made the water look (reflection, sky, water drawing) apply only to the texture named water and to the original water of the Driver 2 cities. Driver 1 cities found their water by height, so random surfaces near the sea got the water look; that rule is gone. Water pieces made with the water texture (water.tga, water_blue.tga) now look like water in every city, also in Chicago and Havana where the edit pieces had lost it. Added a default water texture to the Core pack. Checked by test pictures only,

Added colour sliders to photo mode: new Tone and Colour tabs with highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, a three point tone curve, clarity, sharpen, vibrance, tint, hue, saturation and luminance for each of eight colours, split toning and film grain. They work in the live view and in the saved photo and never in normal play. Every row has a small dot when it changed: click it, or press Backspace, Delete or Square, to put that row back; Reset all clears everything. Checked by automatic tests,

Added 30 built in looks to photo mode (Presets tab), several in the style of the late 70s and early 80s: Seventies Print, Drive-In Night, Super 8, Cop Show, Instant Print, Neon Night and more. A look only sets the picture rows, never the lens, depth of field, shutter or size, and you can move any slider after it.
Made the batch cache file refuse counts that promise more data than the file has, so a damaged cache file is baked again instead of aborting the game. Checked by build only,

Drew the street nearest to the camera first, so the graphics card throws hidden wall and road pixels away early. At 1080p it saves about 0.06 ms a frame (day 1.15 to 1.08 ms, night and wet night the same), more on a wide screen. The pictures are the same.

Cut the grass into blocks of 2048 units instead of 8192, so fewer grass patches go to the graphics card just to be thrown away. Saves up to 0.02 ms at 1080p and 0.04 to 0.06 ms at 3440x1440. The pictures are the same.

Took two wasted bits out of the light calculation: a loop over the cars that was multiplied by zero, and the car shadow check on surfaces that face away from the light. About 0.03 ms a frame at 1080p. The pictures are the same.
Made far away textures a little softer for a small speed gain.

Made the picture cheaper to draw by reusing what did not change: the street lamp shadows and the sun and moon shadows are kept while nothing they show moved, the car reflection picture is redrawn at most every 6 ms, the wet road reflection is reused for up to 8 ms while the camera stands still, and the sky of a still view is drawn once and copied for up to 33 ms. At 1920x1080 the frame takes about 0.1 ms less (day street 1.13 to 1.01 ms), and the shadows are exactly the same as a redraw. How the shorter reflection and sky refresh looks in motion, split screen, other cities.

Moved the grass culling to the graphics card, so grass costs less. The picture is the same. It needs OpenGL 4.3 and falls back to the old drawing when the card lacks it. The frame takes 0.07 to 0.10 ms less (1080p day 1.08 to 1.00 ms).

Made far away level textures (distant walls, roads, hedges, trees) use one averaged sample instead of four mixed ones. They look a little softer, and the game runs faster: 0.06 to 0.17 ms less on every frame at 1080p, 5 to 12 percent. Colours, edges and water are the same, no flicker between frames in a driving test. The old look comes back with indexedMips=2 in config.ini. Pictures were compared at 1920x1080.

Fixed the streetlight glow on the road at dusk being far too bright: lamps now fade in as the sun goes down and are at full strength at night, as before. Checked with pictures at five times of the evening and the dusk and dawn scenes, and tried by hand at 19:54 in Chicago.

Fixed the street lamp glow vanishing in the early night: lamps now follow the square of the night amount (7 percent at sunset, 25 percent at -2 degrees of sun, full at night), and cut the traffic light pools on the road to about a third (smaller and weaker, colour kept). Looked at pictures at 19:00, 20:00, 20:45 and 21:00 in a street and at a junction.

Fixed the highway sign boards so the text shows, crisp, with the right arrow, day and night. The plain back of a board was drawn over the text on its front. A sign board model is now drawn as a front and a back, and the text side faces the road. Checked in pictures at four distances by day and night. The Goose Island hall keeps its old rule.

Made the two big halls of the Auto Exchange lighter: red-brown brick with the windows showing instead of near black, every dark wall, end wall and roof face, also when you drive past. At night they look like the original night picture with the lit arches. The lighter pictures are made by the game from your own game data when the level loads, nothing of the disc is shipped, and the halls stay as they were if that fails. Checked with pictures only,

Changed the Miami textured ground at night: the ground pictures use the night picture of the disc and the night class of the other models, so road and ground match at dusk and night. Pictures at 12:00, 20:30 and 22:30 on the dev PC.

Added Anisotropic Filtering (Off, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x) and Mipmaps (on, off) to Options > Graphics. They change at once, no restart. The cars and the level textures that go through the texture manager use them; 8x is the look from before. Checked with pictures and the option tests,

Added a Window Size row to Options > Graphics (1280x720, 1920x1080, 2560x1440, 3840x2160, Borderless) that changes the window at once, and a Car Shine row on the main Graphics page (the same value as Car Reflections: it scales the sky reflection and the sun glint of the car paint, 0 is matte).

Added Anti-Aliasing (MSAA) to Options > Graphics: Off, 2x, 4x, 8x (never more than the graphics card can do). The 3D picture is drawn into a multisampled buffer and resolved before FXAA, photo mode and the screen, so edges of buildings, cars and road lines get smooth. It changes at once, no restart, and is Off by default, so the picture and the game are the same as before. Checked with pictures (day, night, split screen), the tick hash and the picture tests with it Off,

Added a soft warm glow round the light poles on Goose Island and round the lamps in the two halls at night, like the street lamps have. It is gone by day. Only test scene pictures at 23:00 (apron, both halls, seen from outside).

Added a Round Light Glow setting. Street lamps, signals and car lights glow in a round soft shape with a bright core, not a square picture. The glow is wider in rain and fog, and a far light stays a small bright dot. On in Extended Low and up, off in Classic. Only the picture changes. Checked by pictures and the tick hash,

Added a Lamp Light On Trees setting. At night the street lamps and signals now light trees, signs and the grass blades from every side. Before, a tree or the grass next to a lit road stayed black. On in Extended Low and up. Only the picture changes. Checked by pictures and the tick hash,

Lightened the big dark halls west of CatFlip's International Auto Exchange on Goose Island, the same way as the Exchange halls: red-brown brick with visible windows instead of near black, from the road and from far away. It is its own built-in pack (Goose Island Halls West), so the Exchange pack and your edits are not touched. 860 wall and roof faces, same +60 percent brightness set, the picture is made from your own game on the first load. Night not looked at. The dark halls further north (past z 227000) are still dark.

Added an instant style switch: one key (F2, or both sticks on a pad) flips the running game between the Classic look and the Extended look with no loading screen, and back. It changes shadows, light glow, reflections, grass, anti-aliasing, the frame rate lock, how far the world is drawn and the far traffic layer. The simulation stays the same, so online only the picture changes. The HUD, the sky and the dynamic lights do not switch yet. New rows in Options > Graphics: Instant Style Switch and Style Switch Key. Checked by the tick hash tests and by pictures,

Added the HUD, the painted sky, the Dynamic Lights option and the rain streak density to the instant style switch. Classic style shows the original HUD and the original painted sky (dark by the clock at night, it has no sunset colours or stars), your own HUD choice comes back on the next flip. The cause of the phase 1 hash difference was the option writer (it also reset the traffic numbers), not the HUD or the lights.

Calmed the round light glow: one strength setting (glowstrength, default 40 percent), much weaker by day so a traffic light is a small halo hugging the lamp and not a white blob, a modest glow at night and far lights fade out. Classic style and Round Light Glow off look the same as before. Only pictures and automatic tests ran,

Made far lights small points: the glow now shrinks and fades with distance, full inside 18 m, a faint dot at 140 m and nothing past about 250 m, and the smallest glow is 1 pixel and not 3. Two new tweaks glowdistnear and glowdistfar set the distances. Classic style and Round Light Glow off look the same as before.

Split the light glow by light type: stoplights keep the calm new glow, street lamps and other lights are the original glow again, and car headlights glow a little more. New tweaks glowtraffic, glowlamps and glowheadlights (percent) tune each. Classic style and Round Light Glow off look the same as before.

Made the head plate of the Goose Island light poles follow the night: it is a dull lens by day and lights up at night with the street lamps (one new colour table entry, no rebuild of the pole data). Game builds, tick hash quick set 184 ok. Looked at pictures day and night,
Fixed the road grain that showed on the roof and bonnet of a car when Car Reflections was 0.

Added a Sky Picture option (Procedural or Painted original) under the Weather sky options: the original Driver 2 sky pictures can be chosen in the Extended style too, and the day clock keeps running. In 21 languages.

Tuned the day look of the Goose Island pole head plate to a dull brown (the first value matched what the world already shows by day). Pole pictures day and night are in the hub preview folder goose_pole_heads.

Made the exhaust pipes, the tail lamp glow and the Car's Own engine sounds part of the instant Classic / Extended switch: Classic turns them off, Extended brings your own setting back. The simulation does not change.

Lightened the dark halls further north on the west bank of Goose Island, the same way as the Exchange halls and the west halls: red-brown brick with visible windows and roofs instead of near black. It is its own built-in pack (Goose Island Halls North), so the other two packs and your edits are not touched, and removing the folder brings the dark halls back. 3315 wall and roof faces, same +60 percent brightness set, the picture is made from your own game on the first load. Only the picture changes, the tick hash is equal with and without the pack. By day the change is clear from the street, from the east and from above, at night it is small, and from far over the river it is tiny.

I fixed the black world when anti-aliasing (MSAA) is on together with a render scale under 100 percent (50 and 75 with 4x, 75 with 8x). The small world picture is blown up into the window sized scene with a scaling blit, and a scaling blit into the multisampled copy is refused by GL (error 0x502 every frame), so only the HUD showed. Now the blit goes into the plain scene texture and that is copied into the multisampled copy; scale 150 no longer logs the error either, and the cockpit mirror blit goes the same way. With MSAA off and at scale 100 nothing changed: the picture smoke set and the tick hash scenes come out the same as before my change. Checked by the pictures and the log on the second PC,

I fixed the photo mode picture with MSAA 4x or 8x: the screenshot showed the plain world without the warm tone, the panel, the frame, the grid and the vignette. The screenshot read the scene texture before the multisampled copy was resolved into it. Screenshots and pixel probes resolve first now; the window picture itself was never wrong. Pictures with MSAA off, 4x and 8x now show the same overlay. Checked by pictures on the second PC,

Added a new option Far Glass Darken (Weather page, Sky). On it darkens the pale blue glass of far towers by day so they stop looking like a see-through box at the horizon. Off is the default and the picture stays the same as before.

Fixed cars that were drawn plain white or with wrong colours after a long session: the palette texture of the cars held 4095 rows and ran full, now it holds 16384. A car of another city whose page has no palette row is no longer built with the pedestrian palette. No long online session, only a scripted run that fills the texture and parks the buses of Havana and Vegas (pictures before and after).

Fixed online games drawing the world like a 6 player split screen. The draw distance, fog, ambient range and shadow size looked at the seats of the room, not at the one full view you see. Now the view is full detail like single player.

Made the glow and flare of car head, tail and brake lights weaker and smaller by day and far away, so far cars no longer show big red blobs. Night looks the same as before. Checked by automatic tests only,

Cops on foot are drawn as police officers now. The traffic stop officer and the roadblock cops used a civilian model of the Driv3r pedestrians, now they get one of 5 Driv3r police officers (run the setup again with the Driv3r disc to make them), or the Driver 2 officer when there are none. The Driver 2 officer also lost his uniform in a dense crowd, that is fixed too. Tried by pictures and tests,

Redrew the glow of traffic lights, head lamps, tail, brake, reverse and turn signal lamps: the lit lamp fills its whole lens, gets smaller and fainter with the distance, and has only a small soft halo that is much weaker by day. No more tiny pins for traffic lights by day, no star flares, no white hot cores. New option Lamp Lens Glow (Options > Graphics > Lighting, on by default): off gives the old round glow. Checked with before and after pictures (cars at 5, 15 and 40 m, signals at 5, 20 and 60 m, day, night and rain) and a unit test; Tried by hand in Chicago by day and at night: the lamps look good.

Changed the exhaust smoke of cars to a soft grey puff that blends with the light: weaker at night and far away, no white hot spot with a star at the pipe. A new Soft Exhaust Smoke option (Options > Graphics > Lighting) brings the old puff back, and Classic keeps it.
Added depth of field to Photo Mode: set the aperture from f/1.4 to f/22 and what is out of focus blurs like a real lens.
Added focus to Photo Mode: keep your car sharp, focus on the middle of the view, or set the distance from 0.5 m to infinity, with a focus bracket on screen.
Added bokeh shapes to Photo Mode (circle, hexagon, octagon, pentagon, star) and a blur quality setting, the lens settings are saved in the presets.
Added a shutter speed to photo mode, 1/4000 s to 1 s. A slow shutter blurs what moves.
Added Photo Size 1x to 4x and a Sampling Quality that smooths edges in the saved photo. Big photos are drawn in tiles and written piece by piece, so they do not fill the memory.
Changed the bokeh shapes (hexagon, pentagon, star) to be clearly visible on bright lamps, and moved the focus bracket onto your car in car focus mode.
Added translations of the new photo mode texts (Shutter, Exposure Link, Sampling Quality, Photo Size and their tips) in all languages. They are machine translations, shortened so they fit the panel.
Changed the photo mode text in the README: it now describes the six panel tabs, aperture and focus, bokeh shapes, shutter speed, photo size up to 4x and the presets.
Fixed the Centre focus mode of photo mode for photos bigger than 1x: the sharp plane is now taken from the middle of the whole picture, not from each tile.
Fixed dark shapes on the road in photos taken at 3x and 4x size.
Changed the bokeh so lamps keep their shape, even small far lamps and traffic lights.
Shortened four photo preset tab names so they fit the tab (French, Greek, Hungarian, Portuguese) and wrote the photo mode section of the README, with every tab and row and the saved picture size.

Gave roads and sidewalks a fine surface grain from real asphalt and concrete pictures, with a new option Road Surface Grain (0 to 100, off in Classic and Low). Rain drops make a small crown on hard ground and rings on puddles.
Made the 3D grass reach the kerb of the sidewalk, so no blade shows on the sidewalk or the road. Chicago, Havana, Vegas, Rio and the Driver 1 cities.
Brightened the street lamp pools at night, made traffic lights cast red, amber and green light on the road, weakened the moon shadows and darkened tree sprites at night.
Added sidewalk roughness to low concrete and stone walls, like the lake side wall of Michigan Ave.
Added blood for pedestrians that are run over: a few droplets, a pool on the road that grows and fades, and a smear where the body slides. New option Blood (Off, Low, Full, default Low). No gore.
Added FXAA, an edge smoothing of the 3D picture that runs before the HUD, so the map, gauges and text stay sharp. Off in Classic and Low, on from Medium.
Put the particle limits of smoke, sparks, debris, leaves and blood behind the graphics preset: Low 40 percent of the original limits, Medium 70, High and Classic 100, Max 150.
Added a Brightness setting (Graphics, 50 to 150 percent) that makes the whole picture lighter or darker with one post pass, off at 100 percent.

Added a faint glow on the street lamps and the stop lights from the moment the evening sky turns orange (sun about 7 degrees above the horizon), growing smoothly to the full night glow. The evening no longer looks flat at 8 PM.

Changed the gas station zones, and added the same for the repair pad: a flat pad on the ground that follows the road, with a pulsing ring, chevrons, a light pillar and a turning marker. Every player sees it in his own view.

Fixed the sun shadow of cars on ramps below the street, on bridges and on high ground: it lay far to the side or was missing, and now sits under the car. The shadow body used the wrong height and turn.

Changed the car photos: the game takes them in the real Chicago street now, in daylight with a low camera, and the car fills most of the picture, 1024 by 640, with the washed out sepia look on top. All 1522 cars, 53 MB.

I added a cross-fade to the style switch: when you flip between Classic and Extended (F2, both sticks on a pad, or the console), the old picture stays on the screen and fades out over the new look in a quarter of a second. It is a copy of the last picture of the old style that is blended over the new one at the end of the frame, so nothing changes in the game itself (tick hash: city0, night0, rain0 and the six flipping style0 scenarios equal their baselines; the style100 scenarios show the same hash as before my change) and nothing is drawn or allocated while no flip is running. It works with MSAA 4x and with the render scale at 75 and 150 (no GL error). New row Options > Graphics > Effects > Style Switch Fade (on by default, off flips at once), in all 21 languages. I looked at pictures of 0, 60, 120 and 250 ms and ran the log checks; the real feel and the first flip (the shader compiles then) still need a person.

sections.title: Weather and Sky
lines: Changed the fog to fade into the colour of the painted horizon, and the water reflections to show the painted sky.

Changed the day clock to whole milliseconds, it drifted by up to 207 game seconds in 3 days before. The day clock settings (sunrise, sunset, start hour, day length, city dawn and dusk) are whole numbers too and the start hour is exact now.
Fixed rain missing in the Classic, Classic: Extended and Extended Low presets, their rain row is now 15, 15 and 20.
Changed day to turn into night smoothly. There is no Smooth Night setting any more, it is always on.

Changed street lamps, lit signs and lamps of Havana and Vegas, the lighting of the world, pedestrians, car lights, the lamps of other traffic, the traffic light glow and the police lights to come on little by little with the dark.
Gave each city its own night level (light.nightlevel), so the Driver 1 cities keep their bright look and the old light schedule with the smooth night.
Changed rain to fall at about the speed of real rain, new rainSpeed setting, 170 is the default and 100 is the old slower speed.
Added big puffy clouds to the sky, cumulus heaps lit by the sun, orange at dusk and dim at night, and made them a little less bright.
Added dynamic weather, an option Dynamic Weather, storm clouds roll in, it rains, the storm passes and the sky clears, with console commands weather skip and status.
Added banks of fog every third spell, the fog pulls in grey and the sky turns milky.
Added lightning with jagged bolts, the flash lights the clouds, the screen and the street, thunder comes after the delay of the distance, console command weather strike.
Added puddles along both kerbs from kerb data in the level files, with some in the middle of the road and on the sidewalk, and a splash when a wheel drives through.
Added storm fronts and cloud decks, rain that comes in waves, puddles that stay and dry slowly and a dark horizon fog.
Changed the light, the sun and the wet road to follow the clouds gradually.
Added a scripted weather show for testing (console: weather show).
Fixed the clouds and the weather moving on while the game is paused, they stand still and carry on when you resume, and a pause or customizer picture always starts under the same sky.
Fixed lightning and thunder that kept going while the game was paused: a storm no longer strikes or rumbles on the frames drawn in the pause menu.
Replaced the storm sounds: 7 near and 19 far thunder recordings, street rain and made wind loops instead of the old pack.

Changed rain, wind and thunder to play from mp3 and WAV files in stereo on their own voices, so they no longer crush the rain sound or take the engine voices. The wind follows the storm with gusts and is quieter.

Reworked the fog: the sky, clouds, far buildings and far road run into one solid fog colour, the sun fades out in thick fog, and slow fog banks cover wide areas of the city. Lamps and lights get a halo in fog. The level is set with the console command weather fog.
Changed the storm sounds to play the recordings as they are, with near thunder at full volume and no distance fade. Removed the window rain layer, it sounded like a drain.

Reworked the fog banks and the fog scale: the fog level sets a base fog over the whole city and the banks are wide denser areas on top, so there are no more single pockets. The scale 0 to 100 is gradual at the low end: 1 is 8 km of view, 30 is 600 m, 100 is 30 m, and 0 is off.
Made the fog banks cheaper to draw: at 4K the fog 60 cost over a clear sky fell from 0.5 ms to 0.1 ms. The fog pictures stay the same.
Fixed the rain sound being squashed and clipped at heavy rain. The rain stays under full scale and only one rain loop is loud at a time.
Fixed the weather after a restart or a replay. It kept the rain, the wet road, the weather clock and a forced preset of the old game. It now starts like a fresh level.
Made the weather plan the same on every PC, so the rain starts and stops at the same time and the grip matches. The look is the same.
Fixed a memory leak in the weather sound: the rain and thunder voices are freed when a level ends.

Added Weather Changes (Off, Rare, Normal, Often: how many days have storms) and Storm Strength (Light, Normal, Heavy) to the weather plan. Normal and Normal are the plan as it was, any other pair is part of the replay fingerprint. Checked by automatic tests, The other levels were not played.
Added a Rain Visibility slider to the Weather page of the pause menu, from nearly invisible up to the brighter rain of before. The normal setting is the dimmer look you have now.
Rebuilt the light reflections on the wet road like the original game: every tail light, brake light, headlight, street lamp and traffic light gets a thin strip of its own colour running towards you.
Took the narrow streaks of the street lamps off the wet road and gave every street lamp one large soft flood of light instead.

Added rain drops on the windscreen in the hood view and the cockpit view (experimental, off by default, on hold). The drops appear, grow, merge and run down in streaks, the airflow of a fast car pushes the small ones up and out, the wipers sweep by themselves in hard rain, and the glass dries in about ten seconds after the rain. At night the drops catch the headlights and passing lamps. New option Weather > Windscreen Rain (Off, Low, Normal, High, default Off), in all languages. It is only a picture effect, the game itself does not change. The third person and bumper views draw nothing, and there is no snow in the game.

Put the windscreen rain on hold: it is off by default now. In my hand check the drops looked like cartoons and ran into the cabin, and the cockpit view it needs is on hold too. The option stays in Options as an experimental setting.

Made the weather sound follow where you are: the rain is quieter and duller in a closed car (cockpit view) with a soft tap on the roof. The wind now also grows with your speed (more in the open and the chase view, less behind glass). Thunder gets quieter and duller with distance. The dips under a bridge or overpass and in a tunnel are EXPERIMENTAL: no verified tunnel or overpass spot was found in Chicago, so they are not proven. Checked by automatic tests.

Added one wind for the whole picture: it slants the rain, bends trees, bushes and grass in gusts and turns the clouds. Gave every weather its own light (overcast, storm, haze, golden hour, dust, snow, blizzard, smog, freezing fog, tropical) and made weathers blend into each other over game minutes, through light rain where a jump would look wrong. Console: wind, weather look, weather transition. Clear weather and the old presets look the same as before. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.

Added slippery roads: water, snow, packed snow and ice build up and melt with the weather, and the tyres of every car (yours, traffic, cops) grip less on them. Full brake from 50 km/h takes 1.2 times the dry distance on snow, 1.5 on packed snow and 2 on ice (Mild); 1.5, 2 and 3.2 times (Realistic). Traffic drives slower, brakes earlier and follows farther, fewer people walk outside in storms and frost. It stays off while the new weather variety is off, so the old rain stays as it was. Checked by unit test, brake and traffic tests, 5 tick hash scenarios equal to before. Ice may jam the traffic. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.

Added the look of snow: one amount whitens roofs, hoods, boots, ground and grass by the way they face, walls stay clear, car windows stay clear, trees, bushes and grass blades are loaded with snow from the top, flakes fall round the view (light, heavy, blizzard), the light turns a little cool, the night snow glows a little, and your car leaves wheel tracks in it. It costs nothing when no snow lies. Nothing starts it yet (a console command and a test switch only), the weather will drive it later. The snow caps as boxes on cars and roofs are not done. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.

Reworked the look of snow so it has form: the sun lights it (warm on the sunny side, blue in the shade, orange at a low sun), drifts and ridges catch the light, it glints a little, thick snow shades blue and it is never pure white. Dusting, settled and deep snow now look clearly different. Flakes are soft and round, a few big ones drift close to the lens. Trees and grass are loaded in clumps. Every moving car, traffic and cops too, now ploughs a path through the snow, a groove with a ridge of loose snow on both sides. Snow caps on cars and roofs, ruts on busy roads and slush spray are not done. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.

Made snow flakes drift down wind with the weather wind, the same wind that bends the rain, trees and grass. Nothing changes while the wind is calm. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.

Fixed rain in split screen when the players are far apart: every view keeps its own picture of asphalt and concrete (the wet road grain flickered between the views before) and every view decides by itself if a puddle mirrors the world. Tick hash unchanged.

Changed the Classic style sky to the original Driver 2 sky pictures. With the day clock running it now shows the real orange sunset at dusk, the original night sky and the original rain sky, not one darkened day picture. The day and rain looks are unchanged. The picture switches at once when the clock crosses to the next one, no fade. Dawn not looked at.

I moved the light of every weather (flat grey overcast, dark blue storm, warm haze, golden hour, dusty orange dust, grey yellow smog, snow, blizzard, freezing fog, tropical) out of the code into a plain text file, maps/weatherlooks.txt in the Core pack. Modders can edit it, or ship a file of the same name in a mod and list only the looks they change. A missing file or a bad row falls back to the built-in numbers and is logged once. With the shipped file nothing looks different. Tested by machine with a unit test and the tick hash of the weather scenarios,

Made roads and sidewalks wet from the rain history: the water fills while it rains and dries slowly, so a downpour stays wet longer than a shower. Wet surfaces turn darker and richer, show a fine grain, and the nearest lamps and car lights draw streaks on them.
Tuned the drying of wet roads: a short shower dries in about 2.5 minutes, a heavy storm in about 9. The road grain can be turned off, and it is off in the Classic and Low presets.
Made rain splashes on foot the same as in a car, and made the wet road look grow with the water from about 20 percent up.
Gave wet roads and sidewalks a glossy sheen that grows with the wetness: the sky shows in the film of water, more at a low view angle, with sun glare and wider light streaks. Grass and dirt stay dry.
Reworked the light streaks on wet roads at night: the white headlight haze and the long red smears across junctions are gone and the streaks are narrower.

Built weather presets: eight presets (clear, foggy morning, light, medium and heavy rain, light and heavy storm, rolling fog) strung into storms that last hours. Every day starts and ends clear and the weather never jumps from clear to a heavy storm.
Dimmed the rain streaks so the rain is a faint texture in the air and not white lines. The weather sounds are replaced with sounds the project owns.
Added a soft, blurry reflection of the sky and the buildings on wet roads and sidewalks. New option Wet Road Blur, next to Wet Road Reflections.
Took the focused light streaks under the street lamps off the wet road. The lamps keep their big aura and the car lights keep their soft strips.

Added 19 new weathers: partly cloudy, overcast, hazy heat, golden hour, light mist, dense fog, city smog, drizzle, rain showers, after rain, night thunderstorm, tropical downpour, dust storm, light snow, snow, heavy snow, sleet, freezing fog and after snow. Every city got a climate with an air temperature through the day: Chicago and New York snow, Las Vegas gets dust, Havana, Rio and Miami get tropical downpours, Frisco gets fog. The new option Weather Variety plays them (on by default, off keeps the old eight weathers as before). Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.

Connected the new weathers to the road grip: with Weather Variety on, rain, snow, air temperature and fog of the weather feed the road surface model, so snow, ice and slush change how the cars grip. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.

Connected the new weathers to the light, the wind and the snow: with Weather Variety on every weather gets its light grade (overcast, storm, haze, golden, dust, snow, blizzard, smog, freezing fog, tropical), its wind speed and direction, and the snow on the ground and in the air follows the snow of the weather. Snow melts through a slush weather. With Weather Variety off nothing changes. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.

sections.title: Sound and Music
lines: Changed Driver 1 cars to keep the Driver 2 sound for a light hit, the Driver 1 sample was the steel barrier clang.
Changed the Driver 1 crash sounds to play about 10 dB louder, they were too quiet next to Driver 2.
Fixed far away sounds wrapping around to loud and near, they are quiet or silent now.
Added music to the main menu, it plays in a loop until a game starts.
Changed the menu music to fade out by itself while a game loads.
Raised the sound to 32 voices and gave the effects 24 channels instead of 16, so more sounds can play at once. The music moved to the upper voices.
Fixed players 5 to 8 driving without engine sound and engines in games with more than 4 players.
Fixed the tyre skid sound of players 3 and 4 missing.
Changed the sound code to decode each sample once instead of at every key-on, which removes the 5 to 6 ms hitches when a long engine loop starts (checked by ear: the sounds are unchanged).

Fixed damaged tracker music files making the player read past its 24 channel states, past the data of a pattern, or behind an instrument cut short by the end of a song, so a damaged song can no longer read outside its tables.
Changed a song whose order list names a missing pattern to stop instead of crashing.
Fixed far away sounds going silent from a long way off, they now fade out slowly with the distance.
Fixed short looping sounds clicking at high pitch.
Added rain, wind and thunder recordings mixed by the weather intensity, near and far thunder. They are placeholders, they will be swapped for sounds with a cleared licence.

Added Options > Sound > Output Device. The sound follows the Windows default device when it changes (headphones, Bluetooth) and moves to another device without a restart. Each run gets its own entry in the Windows Volume Mixer.
Made the weather sound lighter: the rain and gale loops load when first needed, the next thunder loads only while it storms, and after 45 seconds of calm they are released.

Changed the rain to play the sound clips as they are again. The tamed rain copy dipped the whole sound 13 times a second by 3 dB and more, and the low cut took the body out of it. Low cut and drop softening now default to off, and a loud mix lowers the gain by one flat factor.
Fixed car engine and crash sounds not loading when no mod has its own sound list. The game now also reads the one in its base content, below all mods.
Changed the Sound tab of the customizer to show the car behind each engine sound, and the find box finds a sound by its cars.
Put the engine sounds of the customizer into folders (Gran Turismo 1, Gran Turismo 2, Driver 1, Driver 2, one per mod), closed until you open them.
Fixed the tracker music player reading past its instrument tables when a note comes before any instrument.
Made the slow weather sound timers (gusts, release of unused sounds, preview storm) run in real seconds at the 25 Hz PAL option too. At 30 Hz nothing changes.

Gave the planes and the helicopter their own engine sounds, made by the program itself (no recordings). The plane has a propeller engine that rises in pitch and volume with the throttle, a wind rush that grows with speed and a stall beep. The helicopter has a rotor thump that speeds up with the rotor and a turbine whine. They fade out when you bail out, leave or crash, and a plane that flies on without you is heard from far away, quieter the further it goes.
Fixed the car sound names list: a file whose size cannot be read no longer leads to a huge read. Checked by building the game only,

Fixed the wait when a mission or level ends: the game stopped the 24 sound channels one at a time and waited a screen refresh after each, about 0.37 seconds every time. Now it stops them all and waits once, 0.01 ms. A voice that does not stop at once is asked again once per refresh and not in a tight loop. Checked by automatic tests,
The package and the setup now carry the pre-made radio station reD2ex Radio (20 mp3 files, about 121 MB), and the radio readme says so. The package itself is not built yet.

Set the Your Engine volume to start at 120 percent (it was 180). A saved setting is kept. The slider goes to 250 and the sound can not go above full level. Checked by a console test of the default and the limits.

Lowered the near thunder claps by 4.4 dB (gain 1.0 to 0.6) so the rain mix no longer clips at 100 percent master volume. Two near claps on top of the rain and engine reached full scale (peak 32767) before; the sound check now peaks at about 29000 at 100 percent. Far claps, rain, wind and the skid loop are unchanged. Checked by the automatic sound level test only, The thunder may now feel a bit softer.

Added Options > Sound > Engine Sounds: City Default (as before) or Car's Own. With Car's Own a car from another city (a Havana car in Chicago traffic) plays the engine of its own make, read from the game's sound file when it first shows up. Mod cars, Driver 1 cars and Gran Turismo cars keep their own sounds. Checked in the log,
Made the helicopter turbine whine softer: the thin high tones are weaker, the pitch tops out lower and the loop is about 4 dB quieter at full rotor speed.
Added the song title under the station name on a station with DJs and ads, shown for a few seconds when each new song starts.

Removed the driver1music option from config.ini and the game. The Driver 1 cities already play their own songs, and there is no Driver 1 music file on the disc that Disc Install could convert. Built, the release config check passes,

Added music for the Driver 1 cities (Frisco, LA, Miami, New York): they play the CD audio tracks that Disc Install made from the Driver 1 PC disc, one after the other, instead of Driver 2 songs. No new option: City Music = Default plays the tracks, a song picked in City Music still plays that song, and the Driver 2 cities are unchanged. Which city starts on which track is a first guess in music/d1music.txt. Checked by a hidden run that moved on from track to track;

Added a Weather Mixer page to the pause menu (Options, Sound) with sliders for rain, wind, thunder, how far rain quiets engines and traffic, the mission music and a master weather volume, plus Reset To Defaults. The main menu does not have it yet.
Fixed the rain, wind and radio sounds going on in the main menu after you quit a game.
Lowered the click sounds of the main menu so they are no louder than the menu music.
Added a Master Volume (Sound) that scales the sound effects, the music, the radio and the weather sounds together, 100 percent keeps the old mix. The Weather Mixer lost its double Music row.
Changed the main menu music to my new track (main_menu_music_4). The game plays it from the menu folder and falls back to the old track if it is missing; the release package ships the new one.
Fixed the engine sound of a car staying the old one after a car swap in the customizer. A Driver 2 car no longer keeps a Gran Turismo engine.

Added radio station scheduling for modders. A station folder with a station.txt plays a live format clock: songs, station idents, DJ talk over the song intro or the end (the song gets quieter and comes back), ad breaks with a sting, call-ins, news and weather lines that fit the hour, the weather, the city and a police chase. A rain or chase starting pulls a matching line to the next gap, never in the middle of speech. The shipped station stays a plain random playlist for now; DJs and ads for it come later. Only the automatic tests ran, with beeps instead of real voices.

Added the texts of the radio station options (Talk Segments, Ads, Call-ins, Lots and their help lines) in all 21 languages. The options show up only when a scheduled radio station is installed. Machine translated,

Added programme blocks to the radio station scheduling for modders. A station.txt can set dayparts by game hour (morning show, drive time, night), each with its own clock, preferred voices and ad density, and specials that switch on with the weather or a police chase and bring more weather and bulletin lines. The radio never goes silent: when no talk line fits it plays a song, then an ident, and a file it cannot read is skipped. The same voice does not repeat a kind of line. Console: radio why and radio why silence explain a choice or a silent radio. The shipped station stays a plain random playlist for now. Unit tests and one game run with beeps only.

Changed the radio station options on Options > Sound to three rows without a heading of their own: Radio: Talk Segments, Radio: Ads, Radio: Call-ins (Ads and Call-ins show in the Advanced view), so the Sound page stays inside its row limit. They show only when a scheduled radio station is installed.
Stopped the log from warning about Driver 1 sounds when Driver 1 is not installed.
Switched the sound output limiter on in every case, so a mix that goes past full scale (engine, rain and thunder together) is squeezed softly instead of cut hard. Quiet sound is not changed.

Added a short click when the style flips between Classic and Extended. It is the game's own door close sound, a bit lower for Classic, played through the normal sound path so the master volume applies and it is silent when the sound is off. New row Options > Sound > Style Switch Sound (on by default), in all 21 languages. The simulation does not change: the 7 style tick hash scenarios stay equal.

sections.title: Menus and Interface
lines: Changed Take A Ride in the main menu into one list of all eight cities, with a time of day to pick. Added the texts in all languages.
Added a Camera Views option to choose which of the 12 views the camera button cycles, default 3rd person, bumper and hood.
Fixed the on-foot camera view being kept as the car's view when you get in, and a saved view that is not on your list now moves on to one that is.
Gave photo mode and the customizer a mouse pointer, and fixed the photo mode strafe going the wrong way.
Fixed backslashes lost in some texts: the mission translation file name and the console and editor help texts.

Added a Minimap Style row to Options, Display: Round (the default) or Square like the original map box. The square style has straight damage and felony bars and is also used in the split screen minimaps.
Fixed the picture of the square minimap not filling the whole frame, a pale gap showed on the left.
Added a Minimap Size % row (50 to 120, default 85) that scales the square minimap with its labels, markers and bars.
Fixed choosing a game mode in the pause menu. Added a Game Modes submenu to the pause menu for this.
Changed the popup messages to show up for players 3 and up too.
Added Players to the pause menu Game Modes, it restarts the game with the number of players you pick.
Changed Take A Ride to let you choose the number of players with Square.
Fixed the Controls list so it shows the 12 local play sources with the right labels.
Changed the pause menu in 3 and 4 player games to a modern menu over the whole window, with Game Modes and Options in the multiplayer pause menu.
Added a car row to Take A Ride that you change with L1 and R1.
Added a new main menu background, an ultrawide picture.
Changed the idle demo to start after 3 minutes 15 seconds so the menu music plays through.
Added Demos: you can record a drive from the pause menu and play it back.
Added Watch A Demo, it plays recorded drives without running the simulation, your own demos are picked up from the demos folder.
Added five demo drives (Chicago day and night, Havana, Rio, Las Vegas) that play when the main menu sits idle.
Changed the split screen HUD text to be readable at 720p and below, small labels are left out when the view is tiny.
Added a profile row for every local player to the Multiplayer menu, and Options > Controls > Local Players > Profile for player 1.
Added a profile manage screen where you rename and delete a profile and pick the start car of a player seat.
Changed the HUD to draw faster: the shapes and text are remembered between frames and the HUD goes to the card without copies.
Made the fuel HUD stop looking for the nearest station on every frame.
Added a Water Brightness option (Options, Display, 25 to 200 percent, also the console command water) that scales the sea and the water shine, in all languages.
Fixed the console text being drawn with the minimap picture.
Changed the Start button in the car picker to choose the last used car, then the car of each player who is ready (Same as player N).
Added a find box to the customizer Car and Sound lists.
Changed the customizer scroll bar to be draggable.
Changed the Lights and Exhaust tabs of the customizer to take mouse clicks.
Fixed the classic and square minimap drawing the map picture over your dot, the target pointer and the cop and waypoint markers.
Changed the classic minimap to follow the Minimap Size % setting, with the bottom right corner kept, and it keeps the original Driver 2 size at the default 85.
Fixed a crash when typing a key that the name entry list does not have.
Fixed the console text being cut off on the left in a wide window, the panel now sits in the 4:3 picture.
Fixed the version line of the classic pause menu running off the screen.
Added the Driver Madness community to the credits as playtesters.
Added a list to Watch A Demo with your recorded demos, newest first, and removed the Open Demos Folder row.
Changed the colours of the modern 70s HUD to yellow, orange, cream and walnut brown.
Fixed recording a demo a second time, with a reminder and unique file names.
Changed the Demos, Record Demo, Watch A Demo and No demos found texts to be translatable in all languages.
Added a Traffic Headlights option, traffic beams are 40 percent of yours by default, and 120 cars get dynamic beams.
Changed the Multiplayer menu so it only has the Local row open for now, the Online row is greyed out and says coming until online play comes back.
Changed the free ride city select so it scrolls through every installed city.

Added Show Unfinished Cars to Options > Gameplay Settings (under Start Car). It shows the Driver 1 cars that are not approved yet from the next level load, so it needs no settings file any more. The text is in all 14 languages.
