Fixed the waypoint on the full screen map: Square (Q on the keyboard) sets and clears it again.
Fixed the Take A Ride background sticking. Going back from the car select no longer leaves the city picture on the screen, and the main menu keeps its own picture.

Added a typing filter to the car picker of the local multiplayer. A pad keeps working as before. The hint line is translated in all 14 languages. The picker text is still hard to read and the Ready button still starts the game at once (both planned). Tested In-Game: Functioning
Removed the bonus gallery from the game, with its pictures, viewer and menu entries. It was not our gallery. The mini cars cheat stays.

Added one line to Extras > Credits: reDriver 2: Extended by EMGBLOOD (CatFlip), built on REDRIVER2 by SoapyMan. The original Reflections credits roll is untouched. The line is English in all languages for now.
Fixed Alt+Return full screen: it only worked with the right Alt key, now the left Alt works too.

Made the main menu text sit on one line again, and the same for every other front end page and the in-game text (HUD messages, credits). The letters were cut and shifted by up to 5 pixels each, because the position of a letter in the font picture only had whole units. Accents on the font test pages are whole now. Checked by automatic tests and by looking at old and new pictures, Greek and Russian use the same code and were not looked at on their own.

Added the last rows of the options overhaul. Every options page ends with Reset This Page, which puts the rows of the page in the current view back to their default values, in the pause menu and the main menu. New rows: Field Of View (Graphics, 50 to 100 degrees), Weather Now and Wet Roads (Weather, Advanced, pause menu only) and Weather Sounds (Sound, Advanced). Texts in all 14 languages (machine translation).

Added the Pedestrian Ring row to Options > People & Traffic (Advanced, pause menu and main menu). It sets how far from you new pedestrians appear, 20 to 100 percent in steps of 5, saved, and it starts at 30 percent like before, so nothing changes until it is moved. Reset This Page puts it back. Texts in all languages (machine translation). There is no Weather Mixer Music row: the weather mixer has no music layer, music keeps its volume on the Sound page.

Changed the credits: the main line now says reDriver 2: Extended by EMGBLOOD (CatFlip), on top of the REDRIVER2 source port by SoapyMan, in all languages. Added the Noto Sans CJK font credit for the Japanese and Chinese letters.

Fixed a crash when opening Developer Options in the Advanced options. A hidden row without text made the page width measure read a null text. Checked by automatic tests that open the page and its three sub pages,
Added a new car list to the customizer: type to search, maker headings, filters, sorting, favourites, recent cars and one row per car with its versions behind it.
Gave the car customizer one panel size on every tab, with tabs as buttons, a key bar at the bottom and bigger paint squares and wheel designs.
Merged the livery and prize versions of a car into its Paint tab as amber swatches that put that car on in place.
Fixed three things in the customizer: the search bar only types after you click it or press / or F3, My Cars has a Customizer button, and the extra mouse arrow is gone.
Fixed the scroll bar of the Car tab in the customizer, which did nothing.
Made the side panel of the car customizer take the whole height of the screen, with more rows and bigger paint swatches and wheel pictures.
Gave the car customizer a new look: a car header, a tab bar with pictures, bigger rows, a paint card and a short slide when the tab changes.
Added a Reset button to the Paint, Wheels and Sound tabs of the customizer, a rim size slider, camera views on the keys 1 to 4 and zoom with the right stick.
Fixed the red highlight of the customizer lists not being centred on the entry.
Fixed the missing mouse cursor in the customizer and My Cars, also after an alt-tab or a window mode change.
Added the console command reload hud that reads the HUD theme files and picture again without a restart.
Added the R3 pad button to the camera line of the customizer key bar (R3 / 1-4: views), in all languages. Looked at in the Car tab,

Added a filter sheet to the multiplayer car picker: Select (or L1 + R1, or the right stick) opens it in your own cell, pick the game, the kind or a maker tile and the list of 1800 cars shrinks. Each player's game, kind and maker are saved in his profile. Keyboards 2 to 4 now drive a picker too, and the Driver 2 kinds (Street / Special) follow the real vehicle of each slot. Looked at the pictures at 2 and 8 players, 4:3, 21:9, German, Russian, Greek.

Added sliders for paint finish (Paint tab) and lamp intensity (Lights tab) to the customizer, also on keys - and + and the right stick. The renderer got one finish factor with default 1, so no picture changes until you move a slider. Saved per car in the carfx file with Save car effects or Ctrl+S. The finish also applies to traffic cars while your car has it.

Re-organised the options of the main menu and the pause menu: the Advanced and Developer Options folders are gone, every setting sits on the page it belongs to (new Display page, Jobs & Money, Lighting & Shadows and Reflections open from Game and Graphics, fog and sky moved to Weather) and only shows in the Advanced view, marked adv. Search in the Simple view now also finds the Advanced settings and lets you change them in place without switching the view. Language is on the root of the pause menu, the Options root and the main menu, a list in each language's own name with the current one starred, applied at once. Checked by automatic tests and pictures at 4:3 and 16:9,

Changed the credits to thank Polyphony Digital for Gran Turismo and Reflections Interactive for Driv3r (the setup makes the cars and the pedestrians from your own discs, nothing is shipped), credit the open source Gran Turismo 2 PC port as a reference, and write Nikkichan92 the same way everywhere.
Changed Take A Ride to single player only: the Players row and the Square key are gone, split screen games start from Multiplayer > Local.

Moved the everyday gamepad options to the Simple view of the Controls page: Gamepad Control Mode (analog or digital), steering sensitivity, vibration, swap D-pad, on-foot camera speed and invert look, and Camera Views. A new gamepad now starts in Analog unless you picked Digital before, and the choice is saved. Checked by automatic tests and a picture,

Added Options > Controls > Show Keys: the keys of the WASD, IJKL and Original layouts side by side, in the main menu and the pause menu, in all languages. Also translated the pause menu row Play and the Back label where they were English, and the profile name on the controller screen is no longer cut in German.

Made players 2 to 4 keep the story of a passenger that goes on in their own profile, like player 1. The save file has a version now, old files load as they are, and a cut or damaged file is repaired or moved aside instead of breaking. Added a tank option (options.ini fuelcarry, off by default) that carries the fuel level of each player's last car into the next level. Active jobs are still not saved for anybody. Checked by automatic tests,

Added a Carry Fuel Over row to Options (Advanced view, Jobs & Money page, off by default). When it is on, each player's tank level goes with them to the next level. The row and its help text are translated by hand in all languages.

Gave the pause menu a mouse: hover to move the selection, click a row to choose it, click the small arrows to change a value, scroll the wheel and right click to go back. The 2 player pause menu with the classic HUD now uses the same 70s panel as the other menus, and the split screen minimap follows the Minimap Size setting.

Changed the classic HUD in split screen with 2 players: each strip now shows its own minimap (sized by the Minimap Size setting), its own damage bar and its own wanted bar, and nothing sits across both strips any more. Took the white MPH, gear, RPM and FUEL text out of the classic HUD (1 and 2 players); the fuel warnings stay. Looked at pictures in 16:9, 4:3 and 21:9,

Reworked the main menu look, and kept the original one. Same picture, red bar, column on the right and sounds. The seven items (Undercover to Language) are now one even column. The text is a little larger, has a dark outline so it reads on the beige picture, and the wide spaces are tighter. A long translation (German, Hungarian, Greek, Russian, Japanese) shrinks all items together to fit the bar, so nothing is cut off or runs over the picture. The mouse works on every item: move over one to light it, click to open it. Looked at pictures in 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 and six languages,

Fixed the Controller Assignment screen: a gamepad name is no longer cut in the middle of a word (reDriver virtual pad) and the Greek and Hungarian profile name texts show all their letters. Checked on the picture,

Lined up the arrows of the Players row with the profile rows on the Multiplayer Players page, and the city names of the Multiplayer map list are translated in the Multiplayer rows too (Greek showed Havana in English). Checked on the picture,

Fixed long texts in the pause menu: a row longer than 63 bytes (Russian, Greek, Japanese, Chinese sentences, for example the Show Keys intro) was cut in the middle of a letter. The limit is 128 bytes now. Checked on the picture,

Added the window mode names (Windowed, Fullscreen Borderless, Fullscreen Exclusive) and the two gamepad preset names to all languages. The Graphics page showed Windowed in English in every language. Checked in the files,

Added the missing Take A Ride hint line in all languages (it was English in Japanese, German and the rest) and took the guillemets out of the Russian Show Keys texts, the font draws a question mark for them. Checked in the files,

Moved the dark panel of the sub pages (Options and its pages, Credits, Custom Missions, Take A Ride, Multiplayer and its steps) down under the Driver logo, so the logo is whole at 4:3, 16:9 and 21:9. The page title and the Back label sit in a small tab right of the logo. Fewer rows show at once, the lists scroll. The Multiplayer page is now as tall as its rows: Local, and Online greyed with 'coming'. Pause menu > Show Keys starts on the first key row and skips the sentences. The 'adv' tag is bigger and brighter, and long key hints of the multiplayer pages break into two lines instead of shrinking. Looked at the pictures at 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 and in German and Japanese.

Replaced the guillemets in the Russian texts of jobs, tutorial, subtitles, editor and options by plain quotes, because the game fonts have no glyph for them and showed a question mark. The same was done for the same texts in French, German, Italian, Spanish, Greek and Turkish.
Made the game safe against a damaged map picture, credits file, ini file and font file (no huge memory request, no read of unset values).
Made a start car paint number in startcar.ini that is out of range fall back to the default paint instead of reading outside the car's paint rows. Checked by build only,
Made a profile or progress save file bigger than 2 GB get refused instead of being read into the game's buffer. Checked by build only,
Made the front end font loader survive a font file that is too short or has a broken range count, the same way the main font loader already did. Checked by build only,
Shortened the Smart Cop option help to "Chase cops use a test network that plays like the normal police. Experimental." in all languages, so it fits the option page. Checked by automatic tests,

Made the auto drive show the next turn of its route line: a plate with an arrow and 'Turn left in 40 m' (or right, or around) above the clock of the HUD, up to 80 m ahead, in all languages. Checked by automatic tests and pictures in 16:9 and 4:3,
Changed the main menu background to the new ultrawide picture.

Changed the Options menu and its pages (Graphics, Sound, Weather, People & Traffic, Police, Interface, Mods, Credits and the others) to use the full height of the window at 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 and 32:9. The sidebar stays on the right, its title is now one slim line instead of the big tab, and the stray dots and the lone Options label under the picture are gone. More rows fit on a tall window. Checked with pictures at all four shapes,

Changed the main menu text back to the original size, centered it on the red bar at every window shape and made the dark outline thinner and softer, because it was a bit much. Checked with pictures only,

Fixed the mouse stopping after the main menu: hover and click now work on the Options page and every page under it (a click on the left or right half of a value changes it, the wheel over the values changes it, the right button goes back), on Credits, Conflicts and on the plain button screens such as Extras and Driving Games. Tried by hand in the Options menu; the mouse wheel over the values and the Credits, Conflicts and Extras screens were

Gave every Driver 1 city its own high score tables. San Francisco, Los Angeles, Miami and New York used to share the tables of Rio. Rio keeps the scores it has now, the four Driver 1 cities start empty, and an old save loads as it was. Checked by automatic tests, The Hi-Scores menu of each city was not looked at.
Fixed a job offer on the radio wiping the waypoint you set on the map. Your waypoint stays until you say yes to the job; the job then takes over. Checked by automatic tests,

Added the option Speed Unit (Options, Interface): mph or km/h. The speed number of the HUD, the split screen HUD, the cockpit dials, the car lines of the customizer, the mission speed limit lines and the mission maker follow it. Only what you read changes, the game and the missions count as before. 0-60 mph shows as 0-97 km/h. Written by hand in all languages. Checked by automatic tests and pictures of both units,

Added a Stats page under Pause, Play, Stats. Take a Ride now counts distance driven, drive time, top speed, money earned, jobs by kind, highest felony, busts, cops shaken, cars taken and races won for every player, and saves them in the profile. How the pages look. The 21 languages are machine translated.

Added switches for Driver 2 cars, Driver 1 cars, GT1 cars, GT2 cars and every car pack under Options, People and Traffic, Traffic Cars. GT1 and GT2 each get a Choose Cars list with the name and year of every car, plus GT Traffic up to 1983, All Off and All On. The text is in all languages. Traffic Cars shows in the Simple view too. Checked by automatic tests,

Built the heat level into the felony bar. The bar gets tick marks at the chase, roadblock and top limits, its colour steps up with the heat (blue, mustard, orange, red), and a small text under it says NOTICED, COPS SEE YOU or LOST YOU. A HOT CAR tag shows while you drive a hot car. Draining the bar is the cool down. BUSTED, FINED and ESCAPED show as small messages like the other messages. It works per player in split screen, on the felony bar of each strip. Checked by automatic tests and pictures, Only player 1 is chased by the police today, so only he gets the sees you or lost you text.

Made every main menu screen follow the same rules. Right click, Esc and Backspace go back, Enter selects and the mouse wheel moves the list. The main menu text no longer has the heavy outline and looks like the Driving Games list. The hint line at the bottom is now separate chips that show keys or the buttons of your pad (the last device you used), and it wraps instead of overlapping. Take A Ride scrolls and shows every city, so Newcastle is back. The main menu is Undercover, Take A Ride, Driving Games, Multiplayer, Options, Replays and High Scores. Custom Missions moved under Undercover, Language is in Options and the cheats are one menu in Options (Extras and Secrets are gone). Pad buttons on a real PlayStation, Xbox or Switch pad, the mouse on a real desk, and the new hint words in every language by eye.
Made the Pick List page of the Auto Exchange menu work with the mouse: the rows light up under the pointer, a click takes the order, the wheel moves the highlight and a right click goes back.

Added five options from the community wishes, all off by default so nothing changes unless you switch them on: City Music (a song per city or one song everywhere), a Stilts cheat (tall wheels, looks only), Jericho In Every City, All Cars In Every City in the customizer, and Police Cars Mixed (patrol cars from other cities with their own sirens and light bars). Mini Cars was already a cheat. Not done: Driver 1 city music table, police that chase you still use the city's own cars.
Added Events won to the Stats page, in all languages. The translations are machine made and not checked by native speakers.

Made the heat display on the felony bar easy to read: the status word sits on a dark plate, it no longer runs off the screen with the square minimap, and the classic HUD now shows the tier marks, the status and the busted / fined / escaped plate too. Looked at pictures only,

Fixed Choose A Ride on a 4:3 screen: the tab line no longer sits on the big 2 of the logo. Added a Type find hint when the keyboard is used (all languages, written by hand). Picking a GT car and starting is checked by an automatic test now.

Fixed the Driver 2 tab of Choose A Ride to list every Driver 2 car of all four cities (39 cars, buses, vans, police and cabs too) in every city, and to start in a car of another city like a Gran Turismo car.

Rebuilt the High Scores menu as one page with four tabs. High Scores shows every game mode and every city with rank, name, items and time, and your own entries stand out in yellow. Career shows distance, time driven, money, jobs, favourite car and longest chase. Undercover shows how much of the story is done, in total and per city. Records shows best times, stunts and contracts. Left and Right change the tab, Up and Down the game mode, L1 and R1 (PgUp and PgDn) the city, Square brings back the old table. The main menu entry goes straight to it. Checked with scripted menu walks and pictures at 16:9, 4:3 and 21:9,
Added the option Weather Grip (Off, Mild, Realistic) on the Weather page, with a help line in all 21 languages (written by hand, not reviewed by native speakers). Default is Mild.

Added a Custom colour to the Paint tab of the customizer: red, green and blue sliders (mouse, or R G B keys with - and + / right stick), a hex entry (F3 or the Hex button) and a live preview. It repaints the body of the car in that colour with the shading of the texture, and is saved with the look of the car. Seen on three colours in pictures, A version swap and the My Cars list do not carry it yet.
Added an option, Classic HUD Speed (Options, Interface, HUD, off by default): the classic HUD shows your speed as a number over the clock, in mph or km/h like the Speed Unit option.

Added a character panel like the car customizer: pause menu > Play > Customize Character, and Options > People & Traffic > Player Character in a game. The game stays paused and the chosen character turns on the spot while you look: Tanner of Driver 2, Tanner of Driv3r, his black suit, VortexLeStuntman and the Driv3r pedestrians, with an idle, walk and run view. Tabs Character, Outfit and Animation, Left Right change the character, Cross / Enter applies, Esc cancels. Texts in all 21 languages. Checked by automatic tests and by looking at the pictures, No keyboard, mouse or pad was used, and the main menu has no panel yet (no 3D scene there).

Put the account on the launcher window itself: a button at the top left shows your account name, or Sign in / Sign up. The window is now called reDriver 2: Extended Launcher in every language. Layout checked in all 21 languages by the automatic test,

Made the white bar at the bottom of the launcher shorter and put the gear, the progress bar, the status text and the button in the middle of it. There is only one button now: it says Play, switches to Update when an update is ready and to Install when the game is not there. The progress bar always runs up to that button. Checked by the automatic layout test in all 21 languages at 100, 125, 150 and 200 percent,
Fixed the Car row of the Take A Ride screen doing nothing when there are no extra cars: it now opens Choose A Ride (L1 / R1, a click or the arrows).

Fixed the letters of the menu font running into each other at small sizes: the text printer lost the fraction of every letter width, now it keeps it. Every menu text that uses the font gets its natural spacing back (checked with a font metrics test over 21 languages). Menu pictures that use small text will look different.

Polished the launcher look without moving anything: one font family with ClearType, one button style with squarer corners, a border and hover and pressed states, a dark chip for the Sign in button, a warm white bottom bar with a thin dark line, a recessed progress bar, a crisp gear and one side margin.

Changed the Style: Classic / Style: Extended message of the style switch to the 70s look: a walnut panel with the yellow edge and the three stripes, Cooper Black title, and it fades out at the end. The text is translated in all languages.

Changed the Style Switch Key row in Options, Graphics to a real key capture: select the row, press the key you want (Esc cancels, Delete or Backspace gives F2 back). It was a list of seven keys before. Your saved key still works.
Marked Ashland, London (The Italian Job) and Driv3r Miami as experimental in the Take a Ride city list and in the online screens (host, lobby, Browse games). Built,
Changed the car picker so a profile with no last car starts on a plain Driver 2 car, not on the first car of the list (that was an experimental Ashland police car). Built,

Renamed the Ash tab of the car picker to EXT (Extras) and moved the Driv3r Miami and Italian Job London cars there with the Ashland cars. Every name starts with its set (Ashland, Driv3r, Italian Job), so the three can be told apart. All 68 cars have a picture now. Tried by the tests (the Choose A Ride list in English and German, unit tests) and by hand in Take a Ride: the EXT picker works. The multiplayer picker and the other languages.

Changed the starting settings of a new install to the tuned feel of the developer game: quieter tyre, crash, ambience, voice and footstep mix, dimmer rain streaks, square minimap, side panel menu, Xbox pad icons, rumble on, 6 chasing cars, more patrols, smart cops and racers, flyable planes, two more camera views. The own engine stays at the original 100 percent. The Extended: Max graphics preset, rain, lights and the 60 minute day stay as before. Players who already have saved settings keep them. Checked by the unit tests and the release config check,

Marked the Destruction Derby cars as experimental in the car picker: the EXT tab lists them as 'Destruction Derby (experimental)' (6 player cars of the first game) and 'Destruction Derby 2 (experimental)' (19 drivers). They are made by the setup from your own Destruction Derby discs, without a disc there are no cars. The first game's cars have flat colours on the body, roof and windows.

Added Pedestrian Detail and 3D Tree Shadows to the Graphics page of the pause menu and main menu, moved Rain Streaks there from Developer Options, and added the Output Device row to the main menu Sound page.
Added Lamp Shadows, FXAA Smoothing and Particle Limits rows (10 to 150 percent) to the Graphics options in the pause menu and the main menu.

Gave the options a Simple and an Advanced view. Simple shows the main sliders on ten pages (Game, Controls, Graphics, Sound, Weather, People and Traffic, Police, Interface, Mods, Advanced), Advanced shows every setting and marks the extra rows with a small adv tag. A new install starts Simple, a player who already has saved options starts Advanced, and the pause menu and the main menu now list the same pages and rows.

Added a search to the options. At the root of the options (also in Simple) type a part of a setting name and the rows that match appear, change them right there. The page says how many more rows the Advanced view has.
Added one line of help under the highlighted row of every options page, in the pause menu (window, side panel and classic style) and in the main menu.

Cut the pause menu down to nine rows: Continue, Show Map, Photo Mode, Play (Game Modes, Travel, Customize Car, Demos), Options, Mods, Replay (Film Director, Quick Replay), Restart and Quit (Exit To Main Menu, Exit To Windows). The classic pause menu now scrolls a long list instead of running off the screen.
Fixed the Take a Drive car list: the secret car, the police car and the standard sedans of every city can be picked now.
Made a version swap in the customizer keep your engine sound and your wheel positions when the body is the same.
Added Cockpit and Mirror Quality to the Camera Views options, translated in all languages. (experimental, off by default, not finished)

Merged the Display page into Graphics and cut it into sections: Quality, Screen (window, resolution, VSync, field of view, brightness) and, in Advanced, More with the pages Lighting & Shadows, Reflections, Effects and Performance. Made Music and Radio Volume one row: the radio follows the music volume, old configs end up at the music value and keep both keys. Put the rows you need most first on every page and on the root (Game, Controls, Graphics, Sound, Weather, People & Traffic, Police, Interface, Mods, Credits), the rare ones last. Renamed Difficulty to Cop Difficulty, took Language off the Interface page (it is on the root). Same in the main menu and the pause menu, texts in all languages.

Fixed the Japanese and Chinese language names showing as ???? in the pause menu Language list while the game is in another language. The three native names now get their glyphs in the HUD atlas when the list opens (one extra row of cells, loaded the first time only).

Fixed the frame rate dropping when the game window is not in front. The game now turns off the Windows power throttling for its process and asks for the 1 ms timer, so a pad or tool can keep driving it in the background.

Changed the car choice for a single player game: the main menu picture is the background now, the car sits in a sepia photo of the city, held like the photo of the vanilla screen, and the list on the right has the car name, the year and class and Previous, Select and Next. Works with keys, pad, mouse and the wheel, and fits 16:9, 21:9 and 4:3.

Added a car list to the car choice of Take A Ride: tabs for All, Driver 2, Driver 1, GT1, GT2 and Mods, the cars of a tab on the red bar with a scroll bar, a Default entry on top. Up and Down, Page Up and Down, Home and End, Left and Right for the tabs, the wheel and the mouse work, and typing letters jumps to the first car with that name (Ctrl+F filters). The photo follows the highlight. A car that is not a Driver 2 car becomes the start car.

Added Weather Variety (on or off), Weather Mode (Dynamic or Fixed) and a Weather Now list of every weather to the weather options. Weather Now blends the new weather in over a few seconds and holds it. Snow is left out of the list in cities that do not have snow. All texts are in the 21 languages. Snow is built but kept out of the automatic weather for now: you can pick it by hand, it comes in 0.5.0.

Fixed Hide HUD being on after the first start, and set one standard default configuration. A demo no longer leaves the HUD hidden, an old tweaks.ini with Hide HUD on is put right once, and Reset All Options now asks first and really resets the options.

Moved the voice chat settings to their own Voice Chat page, opened from one row on the Sound page, so Sound is short again. The help lines of Voice Mode and Voice Position are shorter in all 21 languages. The Room tools page of an online room scrolls with Up and Down when the window is too short for its 15 rows (4:3), in 16:9 it looks as before. Only the options unit test, the picture scenes and the automatic checks ran.

Brought the Replays page into the current game. It works with every replay file the game writes now (older ones and the newer ones with the key and tyre trailers), and Rename and Delete only touch plain .D2RP files of the replays folder, never a path or another kind of file.

sections.title: Multiplayer and Controllers
lines: Changed the radio buttons to come only from your bindings, so the shoulder buttons no longer change the station when they are bound to something else.

Changed the keyboard to be able to be player 2 again, and a keyboard now counts as a connected pad, so the Multiplayer menu works without two pads. The first version was a Keyboard Plays As row, the pause menu Controllers below replaced it.
Changed every split screen view to draw the whole modern world: the whole map, the sky and the cars. This fixed the freeze when players drive far apart.
Put traffic in every split screen game.
Changed every key set and gamepad to be givable to player 1, player 2 or nobody from the pause menu Controllers, with a second WASD key set so two people can share a keyboard.
Gave every split screen player the modern HUD with a P1 or P2 tag, speed, rev arc, gear and damage.
Gave every split screen view its own minimap, and one player missions in the multiplayer region use the round map picture.
Fixed split screen frames being stretched like menu frames on a wide window, and split screen cutting off the HUD and the sides of the world.
Fixed the game only looking at the first three players when it works out which car belongs to which player, and players without a car no longer count.
Changed the police to work with several players: the cops chase the nearest wanted player, pick a new one when he is no longer wanted, and every cop locks onto one player.
Gave every player his own fuel tank, every car burns fuel and can run dry.
Changed the split screen HUD to show each player's own wanted bar and fuel gauge, and moved the clock to the divider.
Gave every player his own wallet, mission pay goes to every human player.
Changed the controller layer to handle 8 pads and four keyboard sets (arrows, WASD, IJKL, numpad), any player's pad can open the pause menu.
Added 3 and 4 player split screen: players 3 and 4 start in rows behind the first two cars and every player gets a quarter of the window, traffic is built around every player in turn.
Gave players 3 and 4 their own HUD in their quarter: tag, minimap with the other players, speed, damage, wanted bar, fuel and clock.
Added bot players: any player slot can be driven by the traffic AI and still counts as a normal player with cops, fuel and money.
Added a panel at the top of each quarter that shows the officer, CB or job offer of that player to accept or decline.
Added the Checkpoint Race game mode for several players, with a waypoint arrow in every view and a pause menu entry that starts and stops it.
Added the Survival game mode with its own pause menu entry.
Fixed the cars of players 3 and 4 holding the handbrake.
Added the Cops 'n' Robbers game mode: two rounds, the teams swap, points count.
Added the Capture the Flag game mode: two teams, bases on the roads, first to 3 captures.
Added the Gate Race and Trail Blazer game modes.
Changed every game mode to pay prize money and end with a results panel.
Fixed vibration so it works on every pad, not only the first two.
Fixed 3 and 4 player games showing the original health bars in every quarter when the classic HUD option was off, they always get the split HUD now.
Changed the empty fourth quarter of a three player game to show the standings of the running game mode and the clock.
Added a Face Buttons setting (by label or by position) for Nintendo style pads, in Pause, Controllers and in Options, Controls.

Added Players and Game Mode rows to the Multiplayer menu, so you choose how many players and which mode before the game starts. The menu opens with just one pad or the keyboard, it no longer needs two pads.

Changed the Multiplayer menu to a Local page for 2 to 8 players, where the car picker shows for every player at once with a ready flag and a 15 second start. The Online row is shown greyed out and says coming in this version.
Fixed the second player not being able to get out of the car in a multiplayer game; a running game mode still keeps the doors locked.
Fixed the players a mission start leaves behind (players 3 and 4 started from the Take A Ride menu), they are put beside player 1.
Added split screen for 5 to 8 players, the views are laid out in a grid and the HUD scales to fit.
Added a car picker with filters, a letter jump, Random and favourites for each profile, it works with a long list of cars.
Added profiles for each local player: you can list, create, rename and delete them, pick one per player seat, or play as Guest.
Changed money and career (respect) to belong to each player's profile, switching a profile loads its own.
Added tyre tracks, tyre smoke and car effects for the players 3 to 8 of a split screen.
Changed the car picker to wrap around at the ends of the list, and Random picks evenly among the cars shown.
Changed the car picker to work for up to 8 players at once, with ready flags, a 15 second start, bots, a brand quick key and a choice of which sources the cars come from.
Changed deleting a profile to move its folder to saves/_deleted instead of erasing it, a profile another player uses can't be deleted.
Changed volumes, sound and police settings and high scores to belong to the machine, not to the profile.
Changed the start car to belong to each profile, every player seat starts in the car of its own profile.

Added the first online play code: a check that both games match, Host game and Join by address with a lobby (room, seats, car picker, ready, START), and an online wallet. The Online row is shown greyed out and says coming in this version, it is early test code.
Added a shared CB radio package run for 2 or more players. The private CB package offers are gone when two players or more are in the city.
Changed the shared package offer to show up on the CB radio of every player with their own distance and direction, and the offer popup goes away when somebody takes the package.
Added message lines for the shared package (joined, loading, too late, carries, lost, stolen, delivered, failed).
Added a panel line for the shared package for every view (distance and time, loading, deliver with the pay, who has the package, package down).

Added the Courier game mode, shared package runs back to back for eight minutes for 2 to 8 players, scored by dollars delivered, in the pause menu Game Modes and the Multiplayer mode list; the CB radio has to be on.
Fixed the minimap of a split screen view that was never drawn, so the minimaps of the 5 player split screen look right.
Changed profiles to 8 slots, one for every local player, players 5 to 8 were guests before.
Added a Nintendo Switch Pro pad profile, the face buttons are picked automatically and the hints show the printed letters. Only tried with a virtual pad, no real Switch Pro pad has been used.
Fixed the pause menu of players 3 to 8, it is now only driven by the pad of the player who opened it.
Fixed unplugging pad 1 handing player 1 to pad 2, the pad slots now stay where they were.
Changed replays and online rooms to refuse cars with different physics sheets or another realism setting.
Fixed the two player split screen: the top view could lose its road and its car and show only the sky, because the picture of the bottom view was not cut off at its edge.
Changed the multiplayer car picker screen to a solid dark background with a black title bar and a blue footer bar for the help text, and hid the version text on it. Tested In-Game: Functioning

Fixed the start of 3 to 8 local players in split screen: every player gets a spot of his own along the road, two cars side by side, the next rows behind, and a spot too far from the road or too close to another car moves on.
Added a car picture to the multiplayer car picker: every player's cell shows the highlighted car on top.
Changed the car choice of local multiplayer to the same list as the customizer: one row per car family, no hidden cars.

Added a MODERN control for walking on foot in the third person view: the left stick walks the way the camera looks (a light push walks, a full push runs, circle sprints), the character turns round in about a third of a second, the right stick turns the camera, the camera swings softly behind you when you leave it alone, and L1 held makes you face the camera and strafe. New options On-Foot Control Style (Automatic, Modern, Classic), On-Foot Camera Speed and Invert Look Up/Down in Options > Controls, in all languages. Automatic uses MODERN with a gamepad and keeps the old tank control with the keyboard; Classic is exactly as before; the first person view is unchanged. Checked by automatic tests,

Changed Multiplayer > Local into a walk of screens: players with one profile row per player, game mode, map (city and time of day), a new Controller Assignment screen, then the car select. Triangle goes back one step and keeps your choices. Only player 1 operates the assignment screen, so it works with the keyboard or any gamepad: pick a player, press Cross or Enter, then press any button or key on the device you want that player to use. Left and Right pick a device by hand, Square shows the keys of a keyboard layout, Auto assign fills the pads and then the keyboards, and Continue only works when every player has a device. A gamepad that is unplugged on the screen is unassigned with a message. Only the automatic tests with virtual pads and injected keys ran, real pads and two real keyboards are not tried. The mouse does not work on these screens yet.

Added full keyboard layouts for two players on one keyboard: WASD on the left and IJKL on the right, each with steering, gas, brake and reverse, handbrake, burnout, fast steering, the three look keys, get in and out, pause, map, change view and the accept and decline keys of the CB, jobs and taxi. No key is shared between the layouts or with the keys every player uses (Esc, T, M, the radio keys). The numeric keypad layout is not offered any more. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed the keyboard going dead in one player when a gamepad was plugged in after a split screen game: the saved Controllers choices (keyboard Off, pad on Player 2) now only count with two or more players, so the keyboard and the gamepad both drive player 1 at all times, in the menus too. The button pictures switch to the device you used last, a fifth of a second after the other one went quiet. Checked with virtual gamepads and injected keys;

Added a Bot choice to the Controller Assignment screen: a player from 2 to 8 can be a computer driver, so you no longer need a device for every player. Left and Right on a player row end on Bot, Auto assign gives it to the players that are left over, and Continue works when everybody has a device or is a Bot and player 1 has a real device. Added the mouse to the Local multiplayer screens: click a row, the small arrows, Auto assign, Continue or Back, move over a row to select it, right click goes back. Only the automatic tests with a virtual mouse and virtual pads ran.

Changed bots in local multiplayer: a Bot gets a random street car at once (no police car, no taxi or other special vehicle), is not shown on the car select (only the human players are), and drives by itself in the game with the traffic AI. Added Bot to the Profile row too (Left from not set, or Right after Guest); it is the same choice as Bot on the device row. Only the automatic tests ran.

Changed the Map step of Multiplayer > Local to list every city (the Driver 2 cities, the Driver 1 cities and the extra cities), with scrolling, the same list as Take A Ride. Added the mouse to the car select screen: click a car, click it again or the header to get ready, click the tab line, the wheel scrolls the list of the cell under the pointer, right click goes back. The filter sheet, the maker tiles and dragging the scroll bar do not take the mouse yet. Only a virtual mouse ran.

Added the mouse to the rest of the car select screen: the filter sheet (click a maker, click the Game or Kind row, right click closes it) and the scroll bar (click and drag). Works at 16:9, 4:3 and 21:9. Only a virtual mouse ran.

Made the help lines on the Choose Your Cars page follow the device each player really uses. A keyboard player sees the real keys of his layout (Original, WASD or IJKL), a mouse player sees what clicks, the wheel and the right button do, and a pad player sees the buttons of his pad family (PlayStation, Xbox A B X Y LB RB, Switch). The panel follows the player who pressed something last and shows his P number when more than one plays. The filter sheet lines follow the same device. 11 new texts in all languages, written by hand. Checked by automatic tests and pictures (keyboard, WASD seat, pad, mouse, German, Greek, 4:3, 21:9),

Fixed the car select for two people on one keyboard. The WASD and IJKL seats can scroll the car list now with their own keys (W S / I K), and get ready, star a car and go back with keys that are no pedals: E and 2 / O and 8 for ready and star, R / U for back. One key table feeds both the picker and the help lines, so the lines show the keys that really work. Original (arrows) is unchanged. Checked by automatic tests,

Made the online lobby step through every installed city, not only the four Driver 2 cities. The room still carries the old city number and the string id, so the protocol is the same. Checked by automatic tests, The lobby itself was never opened with two players.

Fixed missions with 3 to 8 local players: the mission timer and the mission message wrote past their two player slots over other mission data. Players 3 and up keep using their own messages. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed replays of split screen games with 3 to 8 players: a replay now keeps the car of every player, not only players 1 and 2, so the replay plays the game that was recorded. Replay files get a small trailer (file layout 4); older replays still load. Added the replay self test with several players.

Made the CB radio one system for all players when two or more play: one offer for everybody, shown on every view. When anybody accepts, every player in a car is on that job together and everybody on it gets the full pay. A player who passes, sits in a taxi fare or leaves loses nothing, and a failed job costs nobody anything. The package run is cooperative now (any player picks up and delivers); hit, shake and tail jobs are team jobs too, with one shared target. The old first-to-the-pickup run stays as the option CB Package Run: Competitive. One player plays the CB as before. Checked by automatic tests,

Added a start grid to the races. When the joining window ends, two or more racers are set side by side on the pad, facing the first checkpoint, the handbrake holds them and a message counts 3, 2, 1, GO. A lone player still starts a time trial at once. Added a respawn: a car that is wrecked, on its roof or has not moved for 5 seconds, or a press of Backspace, puts it back on the road at the last checkpoint facing the next one, repaired and with no penalty (last one standing has none). Race times now feed the best times of the stats page (sprint, race, best lap) and the winner of a race of 2 or more counts a race won. New texts GET READY and BACK ON THE ROAD are in all languages, written by hand, not read by native speakers. Checked by automatic tests,

Added race courses for Havana, Las Vegas and Rio, a sprint and a lap race in each. Every course of the four cities was driven end to end by a test car. Two Chicago courses had a spot where the car could not get through, so they were redrawn: the checkpoint race now runs round Dearborn, Madison, State and Adams, the Lincoln Park laps run the other way round. The Rio sprint moved from Avenida Brasil to Avenida Rio Branco and the Las Vegas sprint to the northern stretch of the Boulevard for the same reason. Checked by automatic tests,

Added two games for friends on one screen in Take a Ride: Hot Potato (one driver is IT and passes it on by bumping another car, the least time as IT wins) and Demolition Derby (the last car running wins, the circle shrinks in the last minute). Stop in a pad to join, it needs 2 or more players, there is a count in, a results screen and a prize. One pad pair for each of the four cities. Checked by automatic tests with 2, 4 and 8 players. The look of the ring, the IT marker and the real crashes.

Made 5 and 6 player split screen fill the whole window: the six cells are 3 by 2 and the picture follows the shape of its cell, so cars are not squeezed and the black bars above and below are gone. 7 and 8 players stay 3 by 3. Looked at 6 players in a picture,

Made replays of split screen games show every player in a view of his own, like in the game, instead of one full window view of player 1. Checked with 2 and 4 players in pictures. The split HUD is not drawn in replays.

Made the launcher start the game with the account ticket also when it is started with --play and no window. If Stay signed in is on, it uses the stored key, asks the account server for a fresh ticket (3 seconds at most) and hands it to the game, then wipes the key. Not signed in, wrong key or no answer: the game starts without a ticket and one line goes into the launcher log. Tested by the unit test with a loopback server (stored key, no key, refused key, silent server, wiped key),

Fixed the online lobby page running off the bottom of the screen in 4:3. The page now shrinks to fit, so the seats, Start, Chat, Room tools and Leave all stay on screen with up to 8 players and a long chat line. 16:9 and 16:10 look as before.

Added a small amber star in front of the players who are signed in to an account, in the online lobby list and in the player list during a round, with a Signed in note (21 languages). The room browser does not show it yet.

Added a small amber star to Browse games for rooms whose host checks account tickets, with the legend Accounts checked in all 21 languages. It is only a sign: it never decides who can join. A room on an older game or an older master server shows no star, and the older ones keep working. Only the automatic tests ran and I looked at the pictures in 16:9 and 4:3.

I added a game pad button for voice chat push to talk (Select by default, other buttons to choose, also on the Controls page) and an echo suppressor for people who use speakers (off by default, switch in the Voice Chat page). Checked with unit tests on made-up sounds. No real microphone or speakers here.
Added a config option, [online] menu=1, that opens the greyed Online row in the Multiplayer menu for testers,

Made the Browse games screen easy to read: bigger text, five filter buttons with the current value, clear column headers, a bar on the chosen row, a darker plate behind the list so text never sits on the picture, a scroll bar for long lists, an empty state that says how to refresh, and a status line with the reason when the master server is not set or not reachable. Fixed the refresh key (it did nothing when the list socket was closed and showed nothing when it worked, now it reopens and shows Updating). Added mouse: click a row, click again to join, click a filter button, wheel to scroll, right click to go back. The key hints now list every button (filter, star, join last) with real key names. 21 languages (machine translation). Keys and mouse tried with the automatic browse test,

Added a Host on a server screen under Multiplayer, Online with room name, city, time of day, players, start with one player, join while it plays and round, plus a line in the lobby that says Start works alone too and others can join while it plays, texts in 21 languages, the Online row is still greyed out in 0.4.0,

I fixed the text fields of the online menus: Enter now saves what you typed and goes on to the next row, Esc cancels, on the keyboard and with Cross / Triangle. Before, the room name field saved and then opened itself again. The Host on a server screen also stopped showing the address of the server. Checked by automatic tests of the room name and the address field (Enter and Esc);

I reworked the online lobby after the hand test on the room server: the chat is a panel at the bottom left (messages and an input line, Enter sends, Esc clears, Square starts a message on a pad), the Chat row is gone, picking a car returns to the lobby at once without the ready countdown, a room on the room server has a Start row (it sets you ready, the server starts the room), the Room tools stop on every row and say why a grey one is grey, and no screen shows the address of a server any more. A real Start button and room tools for the creator of a room on the server still need a protocol change. Checked by automatic tests on this PC (two games, typed chat line, server room flag);

Fixed four room bugs found in the code review of the room extras. A player kicked or banned from a room that is playing is now told so and stays out: before, the host's kick was answered like a dropped connection and the player could ask for the log back and take the seat again. A spectator can no longer write chat lines that show up under the host's name. The host's voice mute of a seat ends when that player leaves, so the next person in the seat is heard. A typed room password is wiped from the text field when the page closes, and a chat line of only spaces is cleared instead of saying wait a moment. Checked by the room unit test (kick while playing, spectator chat, voice mute).

I gave a room on a room server an owner. The player who asks the server for the room is its owner, bound to a secret that only travels inside the encrypted join, not to a name. The server runs Start, room changes, kick, ban, voice mute, password, ready check, roles and closing only when they come from the owner, and drops the same commands from anybody else. When the owner leaves the room goes to the next player, and the creator can take it back within a minute. Protocol number is now 8, so the room server on the box must be updated with the game. Only checked by unit tests and the room server test with fake players,

I made the online lobby use the room owner. The owner sees a real Start row, the city and time rows and the room tools, and the tools got Start mode (everybody ready, or the owner presses Start) and Close the room. Everybody else sees Waiting for the owner and the reason Only the owner of the room can change this. The seat list marks the owner. New texts are in all languages (machine translated). Checked by tests and looking at pictures only,

I fixed the online lobby for a room with an owner that the player joined by a typed address: the Start row and the owner tools now show for the owner and Waiting for the owner for everybody else, not only when the room was joined through Host on a server. Seen on pictures of two games against the room server on the second PC,
Fixed hosting a room on a room server with a room name that has a space at the start or the end: the server refused it, now the spaces are cut off first. Only compiled,
Fixed the Join game address page: Enter now connects like Cross, as in every other text field. Found by the new online screens test, only automatic tests ran,

Added community nodes to the Browse games screen: a small N marks a room on a node, the line under the list names the node and its region (and says when it is new), a Nodes chip hides every node room, and the first time you pick a node room it says the volunteer host can see your IP address. 15 new texts in all 21 languages (machine translated).

I added three quiet checks to the room server: a score for input that looks like a macro or a bot, a mark for a seat that has not moved its controls for two minutes, and a count of which buttons and stick positions the players really send. They only write to the server log and count, nobody is kicked or punished and the network protocol did not change. Tested by machine with the unit tests,

I added Mute My Microphone to voice chat. There is a row on Options > Voice Chat (Off by default), a key (Pause or Scroll Lock, set in Mute Key) and an optional gamepad button (Off by default, so no button you use is taken) that switch it live in a room. While it is on, the microphone is closed: nothing is captured or sent, push to talk and voice activation do nothing, and the others see no talking mark for you. You still hear them. A red Mic Muted mark shows in the lobby chat panel and in the voice list in game. Nothing changes on the network, so older builds are not affected. The tests I ran: a unit test of the send rule, and a three machine room on the second PC where the muted one sent no voice at all and still heard the others. A real microphone, the key, the gamepad button, or the in-game mark. The 20 translations are machine made.

I gave the room server three more checks against bots and macros. A player whose input flips buttons and steering every tick for a long time gets strike points, and so does one whose analogue stick only ever has a few positions. When every player in a round has been away for a while the round now ends like an empty room. A removed player now sees 'The room server removed you: your input looked like a macro or a bot'. The limits can be set in the server options (--ac-bot-strike, --ac-hist-min, --ac-hist-values, --away-ends-round) and everything is logged with the reason. Tried by machine only: 400 seeds of a human like pad and 6 full rooms were never flagged, a macro and a two position stick were removed in the test rooms on the second PC.

I took the IP address and port off the online screens. The host lobby line now says only Room open, and the Connecting page says Connecting to the room with no address. The address is only visible while you type it on the Join game page. The 21 languages got the new line. The automatic screen test passes with the strict address check.
Changed the Community node line in Browse to say the volunteer host can see your IP address, name and chat, in 21 languages. Added the Community Node operator agreement text; no node is listed yet.
Fixed the online lobby sending you back to the car select screen after you took a car: the Enter that took the car was counted a second time. The online menu test follows it now.

Fixed the pause menu of a hosted online game: the seats of the other players counted as missing pads, so the pause menu could turn into the pad error menu that the keyboard cannot close. New automatic test: keyboard opens, moves and closes the pause menu in a room of two.

Added speed, rev arc, fuel, money, damage and heat to the online game, they were missing. The map in an online game is now the Take a Ride map (M, Tab or the Show Map row in the pause menu), with the other players as named dots in their colour. The old room map is gone.

Fixed hosting and joining an online game saying the game version is wrong. The version check used a build counter that goes up at every build on each PC, so two copies of the same release never matched. It now uses the release version text, so every copy of one release matches. Checked by the net unit tests (8 of 8),

I made the city level files the same bytes on every PC when they are built from the same discs and patches. They used to carry the build time of each part inside, so two installs never matched and online rooms refused players (the city is not the same as on the host). Checked by building a city twice at different times: identical.

I made the game decide if a city level file is current by a stamp of everything it was built from (discs, Core patches, city descriptor files, builder version), not only the importer version. The launcher now runs the level build in the background after an update, so the new Core patches reach the levels. Without the discs the levels stay as they are. Checked on scratch copies: an old level is rebuilt after a patch change and equals a fresh build.

Changed Host on a server so the room server in config.ini can be a name (rooms.toclink.com:28300) as well as an IP. The name is looked up in the background, the menu never waits, and the row says to try again if the answer is not there yet.

Fixed the Browse games screen in a 4:3 window. The line of the chosen room is drawn again and shows the community node name and region. The note that a node host can see the IP address no longer sits on the Games listed line. The list keeps five rows by smaller steps. The note was cut short in Hungarian and other long languages, that is fixed too. 3 and 16:9) and the unit test.

Made one standard set of rules for every online game: Hard cops, the release traffic and pedestrian numbers, the same police view radius and about 100 more sim settings are fixed while you are in the Online screens, a room or an online game, whatever your own options say. Your own values come back when you leave, and the options files never save the online ones. The Online screens say 'Online rules: standard (Hard cops)'. Your draw distance stays free. The room server identity file is made with the same rules, so it no longer depends on the PC that makes it. Checked with a unit test and a room of two games with different options (equal hashes for 1800 ticks).

Changed the online game to use the same HUD as single player Take a Ride: street name box, round minimap with the other players as dots, analog speedometer, money, toasts like New contracts today, the controls panel and the CB, fare, stop and pump panels, all for the player you play. The chat, the player list and the other players on the map stay. Looked at two pictures (host and guest) from two hidden games,

Fixed the online pause menu and keyboard splitting the room. The reverse key, the keyboard state and the accept and decline buttons of the CB radio, taxi and traffic stops were read from your own PC inside the game, so one Down arrow or one key in the pause menu made the two games differ. They now travel with the input of the room. Auto drive, the race reset key and the keyboard in the garage menu are off in a room. The test nettest --roompause went from 21 of 23 lines different to 0. The room server needs the new version.

Fixed the CB radio accept in an online room: the button of the second player now works from that player's own PC and both games stay equal. A second filter in the room code still cut the new input bits. Added test switches REDRIVER_NETANSWER and REDRIVER_CBSHARE=noans: the second player accepts a CB package job, 49 hash lines equal over 1500 ticks.

Added competed CB jobs to online games: the offer goes to every player at the same moment, the first to accept has the job alone, the others see Taken by NAME and lose nothing, and only the winner is paid. Local split screen keeps the team jobs. Both players pressed accept on the same tick in two hidden games over 2400 ticks with 79 equal hash lines. The new text Taken by is not translated yet.

Changed the online CB jobs into a race. Everybody who accepts is on the job; for a package the first one at the pickup carries it, another player who accepted can steal it by ramming the carrier hard (4 seconds of safety for the new carrier), and the one who delivers is paid alone. For hit, shake and tail only the first one done is paid, the others just end with no loss. Two hidden games, 2400 ticks, the second player rammed and delivered, 79 equal hash lines. The real ramming by driving and the hit strength are

Changed the police car of the cops in online Cops n Robbers and Chase rounds in the car store cities (Driver 1 cities, Ashland, Driv3r Miami): it is chosen from the car list and the region table of the city, not from what happens to be loaded, so every machine gets the same cruiser. Checked with two games in Driv3r Miami and Ashland (same cruiser, same slot, hash lines equal).

Added the round view for spectators in online Cops n Robbers and Chase: a line with Watching, the clock and how many robbers are free while the round runs, and the scoreboard at the end. A spectator has no car and no input, so it cannot touch the round. Checked with a second game as spectator (hash lines equal to the host, same round lines).

Fixed an online desync: the traffic and pedestrian rules that look at where the view is (where new cars appear, which cars may be removed, the pedestrian cone, the event lists) read the camera of the machine they ran on, so two players with different camera views got different cars and different random numbers and the round ended. They now follow the position and heading of a player car, the same on every machine. Checked with two games whose cameras were forced to different views (the old build desynced at tick 90, the new one had 79 hash lines equal over 2400 ticks) and tick hash (offline play unchanged).
Online rooms are Take a Ride only for 0.4.0: the room tools can no longer switch a room to Chase or Cops n Robbers. Those return later as events you start inside the world.

Added the second two player arena of every Driver 2 city to the local multiplayer map list: a row "<city> (Multiplayer 2)" after the Multiplayer row, for Chicago, Havana, Las Vegas and Rio, day and night. The arenas were in the mission file all along (missions 498 to 505) and no menu started them. Checked by pictures of all 8 and by a menu test of the Havana row.

Raised the size of an online room from 8 to 16 players. A room starts with 8 seats and the host can set it up to 16 in the room tools. Every seat that is free from the start takes a player who comes in later, at any time (before only 4 seats were kept free). The lobby shows 16 seats in smaller rows, the player list scrolls and the map has 16 colours. The online protocol changed (version 9), so every player has to update. Tried by two real games with a 16 seat room, 1800 ticks, equal hashes. Real players on more than two machines.

Fixed the Online row staying greyed out on installs made by an older launcher: when config.ini has no [online] section (or misses menu, master or room_server) the game now uses the release addresses. A value in the player's config.ini always wins, menu=0 still switches the row off. Unit test and the net unit tests ran.

I added race events to the online Take a Ride room. Any player starts a checkpoint race from the pause menu (Race Event, pick the course, Left and Right change the laps), the others get a prompt and answer with J or N, two or more make a race. The racers are put on a grid, counted in, race with position, lap, checkpoint and time on screen, get places and prizes, and are put back where they were. The police leave the racers alone, a wrecked car is out of the race. Every city has more circuits and sprints now. Only tested by script on 3 machines,

I built Cops n Robbers as an event inside the online Take a Ride room. Anybody opens Events in the pause menu, the others get a prompt to join (J, C or R on the keyboard, L1 on a pad, N or R1 to say no), and the ones who join are put together on a road with a robber car or a police car of any city. Three rounds, a score board, then everybody gets the own car back and the room is free roam again. Only real players: no robbers and no cops from the computer, and the police leaves the players of the event alone. At most three robbers and always more cops than robbers. Tried only by automatic tests with 2 to 4 players and a player who says no. How it looks, the sound, the pad keys, the car pick (the car is a random allowed one).

I fixed a desync in online races: the reset key (Backspace) and the test console respawn of a race are switched off in a room, because one machine put a car back and the others did not. A racer who is out of a race is not counted as racing any more. Checked by script on 3 machines,

I made the world follow the racers of an online race event. The map is only loaded around the first player of a room, so a start grid somewhere else in the city showed no streets. While an event runs the map now follows the first racer, and goes back to the first player when the cars are put back. Players who decline and stand far from the racers lose their map while the event runs (engine limit, not fixed). Checked with pictures from a script run,

Changed the online race events to be one more kind of the room events, like Cops 'n' Robbers: the same invitation (J joins, N says no), the same wait, the same results time and the same pause between two events. Race Event is a row of the Events page of the pause menu now. The online protocol changed (version 10), so every player has to update. Checked by automatic tests with equal hashes: 3 racers, 2 rounds, one who says no, a wrecked racer with the police after everybody, a racer who leaves, laps, and a room server. The course list, the invitation and the results on screen.

Changed the wreck recovery in an online room: a player who plays a running event (a race or Cops 'n' Robbers) is out for the round when his car is wrecked, and gets his new car when the event is over. A player who said no to the event is in free roam and gets his new car as always, also while the others race.

Fixed the pause menu of an online room: the keyboard now drives the menu with the menu keys (before, Up arrow selected a row and Down did nothing), the car gets no input while the menu, the big map or the player list is open, and the mouse is free and visible there. The mouse is let go when the window loses focus and when the room ends. The menu says that the game keeps running. Checked with a two game room test and a unit test,

Fixed the desync when a controller is plugged in during an online round. The right stick and the trigger axes of a pad were only known to the machine that had the pad, so the on foot look, the camera and the thrust of every car could differ between machines. They now travel with the input of the round, the on foot options are fixed to the standard in a room, and a desync writes the state words of the machine into log.txt. Online protocol 11: everybody must update, old builds cannot join.

Fixed an online room drifting apart when one player changed any option in the pause menu: the sunrise and sunset of the game clock, the traffic and pedestrian limits of the day clock and the empty city of a room were put back to the standard on that PC only. The room now keeps them. Also the procedural sky setting is the same for everybody now. Tested by an automatic 3 player room with a client that changes options all the time,

Held more settings at the same value in an online room so that no PC reads its own: the traffic lights programme, parking and ambient limits, the taxi share, chase traffic, the car packs of traffic_cars.ini, the camera view list, wreck recovery and unfinished cars. The tyre compound of a saved car look, the Auto Exchange shop and customizer, the console commands that change the game (tp, hour, spawn, mission, weather ...) and the level editor are off while a room plays.

Checked the data files of the content packs when joining a room. Before, only the names of the pack folders were compared, so two PCs with the same packs but another jobs.txt, tyres.txt, economy, car or weather file joined and the round died at the first hash check. Now the economy, jobs, fares, car lists and the handling part of car files, city descriptions, collision, aircraft, driver weights, weather and mission files go into the join check, and the host refuses the guest at the door with the mods reason. The room identity file of the room server needs a new mods word. Tested by the program only (unit test, a refused guest in nettest, a normal join),

Stopped the one player game over in a room. A car that sank faded the screen and opened the Game Over menu on every PC of the room, and a mission over could stop the pad of one PC only. The modes of the pause menu already could not start in a room. Offline nothing changes. Tested by the program only (unit test),

I fixed a crash in Rio: after about 15 minutes in a room with 3 players, a pad race could start with a race slot that held no car, and every machine crashed on the same tick. The bridge check now skips an empty slot. The online soak found it; a 30 minute Rio run now passes with equal hashes.

Fixed online rooms refusing a good install with 'the installed mods is not the same as on the host'. The list of car pictures differs on every install (Disc Install adds rows for the pictures it makes) and was counted as game data; it is not any more. Checked on the install that was refused: only that file differed.

Changed the multiplayer car picker to be easier to read: bigger, brighter lists and tabs, and the help lines on a dark panel at the bottom. Tested with picture evidence at 720p, 1080p and 4k with 2, 5 and 8 players.

Changed Ready in the car picker: it no longer starts the game at once. The first Ready starts a 2 minute clock, when everybody is ready it drops to 10 seconds, taking Ready back starts it over. The time shows large on screen.

Changed the Map step of Multiplayer > Local: every Driver 2 city is listed twice, as its single player map (for example Chicago) and as the smaller split screen map (Chicago (Multiplayer)); only the multiplayer one carries the label. Driver 1 and extra cities have their single map only. The game modes run on either one.

Added race events to Take a Ride. Stop in a start pad in the city to join: alone it is a time trial, with 2 or more players it is a race with live places (a car that only drives across a pad does not join). Four kinds (sprint, checkpoint race, lap race, last one standing), an arrow and ring per player, a lap counter, results with times, best times saved per profile and a prize for the winner. Four courses in Chicago; a course is a few lines in maps/races_<city>.txt of a pack.

Opened Online in the release build: the shipped config now has the Online row on and the master and room server addresses. The release check requires it. The room content check against a disc built install is not proven yet.
Online rooms in the four Driver 2 cities now load the whole single player Take A Ride map. Before, they loaded the smaller split screen map. Built,

sections.title: Discord Bot
lines: Added the Discord bot: players can get account help and manage their reDriver account from Discord.

sections.title: Missions and Story
lines: Added scenes for fan made stories: comic panels with a caption, voice and music, title cards and avi clips, played from Extras > Custom Missions or with the console command scene.
Let a mission have an intro scene before it starts and an outro scene when it is completed.
Added dialogue captions over the recorded cutscenes of a mission, with the modern HUD subtitle.
Let scene panels be held until a button is pressed, Left or L1 goes one panel back, and a damaged jpg no longer closes the game.
Added camera moves over a picture, fades and chaining one scene into the next.
Let a custom mission continue with another mission, so you can build a story chain.
Changed the job system to keep its own state for every player, every player's jobs run side by side.
Changed fares to work per player, every player accepts or declines his own fare.
Fixed restarts keeping the old jobs: the job, waypoint and job generator reset when a level loads.
Fixed a story mission restart drawing different random numbers from a fresh start, the city of the mission is now read before the seed.
Fixed the cops batter trigger and the fuel tank values keeping the numbers of the game before after a restart.
Fixed Las Vegas events starting differently after a restart, the parked trains lose their path and the event list starts clean.
Fixed the player idle watch animation freeze carrying over into a restart, and event objects not starting fresh after a restart: path speed, helicopter rotor, door stages and detonator.
Fixed a restart in mission 30 freezing the game for good.
Let the mission maker open an original mission as a template, move a target, change the time limit and the cars, and save it as a new mission of your pack.
Added a tool that shows any original mission as readable steps and can make a copy with one target moved; all 137 original missions can be read.
Added a reader for the Driver 1 missions on your disc (list, check, dump, extract) with the instruction table and its Driver 2 meaning, then list, plan, import and verify.
Changed the game to start a Driver 1 mission in its own Driver 1 city, and a mod mission keeps its own start.
Changed the setup to also convert the Driver 1 training, driving school and credits levels as hidden cities so more Driver 1 missions can import.
Fixed the Custom Missions list showing Rio for every Driver 1 mission, the small line now names the real city.
Changed story mission restarts to start like a fresh start, checked for twelve missions by the automatic tests.
Fixed the destination of the imported Driver 1 missions. Needs a new import of the missions.
Added loading of a mission from a level file that carries it, so a level pack can ship its own missions.

Added loading of the missions a level file carries. A city file that has missions in it hands them to the mission list. Checked with the Driver 1 bank job stored in the Rio file: it loads from the file and starts. Driver 1 city files can not carry the Driver 1 missions yet.
Fixed the Driver 1 bank job showing no marker at the bank. The arrow shows from about 8 blocks away, the bank is 100 blocks from the garage. Needs the Driver 1 missions imported again.
Fixed the police stops (pull-overs) happening in the middle of a custom mission, like the timed Driver 1 jobs.

Changed the Driver 1 bank pickup cutscene: three men in dark suits now come out of the bank door and run to your car, with black bars and a camera that follows them. The scene length follows the walk.
Fixed cutscene cameras in the streamed Driver 1 cities being thrown back to the in-car view on the first tick, and cutscene actors that started where the level has no ground falling out of the world.
Changed the cutscene camera fix and the cutscene actor ground fix to apply only to imported Driver 1 missions, so Driver 2 mission 23 plays as before.

Added reading of the Driver 1 movie tables on the European, French, German and Italian discs too (they boot SLES_018.16, not SLUS_008.42). All seven dumps list the same 44 missions with 36 movie links. The European discs hold fewer movie files, so their movies are still left out.
Fixed the follow-the-car distance of custom missions: a small distance no longer wraps around. Story missions behave as before.
Changed scene files so that pictures, voices, music and clips can only come from the scene folder.

Fixed the chase route of a mission: it was picked from the frame counter, so two starts of the same mission (found with mission 26) could play another route and the traffic then ran differently. Now it comes from the mission and the last route, so a start is the same every time. A fresh start of a chase mission now picks a fixed first route instead of a random one.
Changed the CB radio chatter, job offers, cab dispatcher calls and passenger talk to new lines with characters of their own.

Gave missions room for more than 16 places (up to 256) and made the WAIT step a real step of the mission engine. A long mission carries a small TGTX block after its header; missions with 16 places or less are written exactly as before, so old and original missions are untouched. The mission tools (dump, build, explain) and the in game text editor read and write it. The wait counts logic ticks in the target itself, so two waits never share a counter. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed Driver 1 Trail Blazer missions to keep all 100 checkpoints after a new import, and made WaitSeconds of the Driver 1 scripts a wait step wherever there is room. Added a new step WAIT (3, 5, 10 or 30 seconds) to the mission maker. The two new texts are translated in all languages by hand. The imported missions on disk must be imported again to get this. Checked by automatic tests,

Added two mission maker steps, PICKUP and DROP OFF. A person waits at the marker, you stop, he walks to the car and gets in. At DROP OFF he gets out and walks away. It uses the taxi passenger. Checked by automatic tests,

Added the mission maker step TIME LIMIT. A countdown runs for the rest of the mission and shows the seconds left. When it runs out the mission fails, goes on, or sends the police. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed the mission text reader being very slow with a script of 100000 jumps, and made the mission text dump safe for jump distances near the largest number. Added a fuzz test with truncated, huge and damaged texts.

Added mission maker conditions: MAX SPEED, STEALTH and MAX DAMAGE. The mission fails when you go over the speed cap, the police notice you, or the car takes too much damage. The rules show on the message line. RULES OFF ends them. Checked by automatic tests,

Added mission maker steps TRAFFIC and COP WAVE. TRAFFIC makes the streets empty or full for a while and then gives the normal traffic back. COP WAVE sends one to four patrol cars after you. The cars come the usual way behind you, so there is no place to set. Checked by automatic tests,

Made the mission maker place up to 40 steps (it was 15). A mission with more than 16 steps is written with the TGTX block, so it needs 0.4.0 or newer; a RACE keeps its 14 checkpoints. A 20 step mission builds and plays to the end in the scripted test.

Fixed the TAIL step picking a car the player was already too far from (the mission failed in the first second). Added scripted drives of the maker mission types TAIL, ESCAPE, DELIVERY, REC CHASE and RACE and of the MAX DAMAGE condition (the bot rams until the rule breaks).

Made scenes play more sound formats. A voice or music line in a scene can now be an mp3, m4a, aac, wma or flac file, and a wav that is not plain PCM (ADPCM, 24 bit, float). They go through the Windows decoder the menu music already uses, so no new library came in. Dropping a sound on the scene tab checks it first: a damaged file or an ogg is refused with a message and is not copied. Ogg Vorbis is still not supported, the game has no decoder for it. Checked by automatic tests with generated sound files, The new texts are machine translated in all languages.

Added story chains. Custom missions that follow each other (the THEN MISSION row of the mission maker, next= in M<n>.scenes.txt) now show as one Story row at the top of Extras > Custom Missions. It opens a chapter menu with Cleared, Up next and Locked marks. A cleared chapter can be played again, the next one is the first not cleared, later ones are locked in that menu. It works with the mouse, the keys and the pad, in the 70s menu style. Finishing a custom mission is saved per profile in saves\<profile>\chains.sav, a new small file, so old saves load as before. The story still goes on by itself to the next mission after an outro. A chain is named like its first mission. There is no best result, custom missions have no score. All new texts are in all languages (machine translated, native review owed). Checked by automatic tests and pictures,
Fixed the Custom Missions list: a mission in a mod city now shows the name of that city, not the engine level of its header. Checked by automatic tests, The list on screen.
