Fixed a crash on the first frame of a mission with an event target that has no place: the map and marker drawing now skip it. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed the cone counting of Gate Race and Trailblazer with more than 2 players (it wrote past the 2 timers), a bad player number of a mission thread and a lap number past the lap table. Each logs one line. Checked by game run tests only,

Fixed a crash when the first mission of a game is refused (damaged file): the player car now falls back to slot 0 with a log line. Car target models outside 0 to 249 are reset. Found by the value fuzzer. Game run checks added for the thread player, the list title of a mission with more than 16 targets, and Trailblazer with 3 players.

Fixed Gate Race and Survival with 2 or more players: the game data has no 2 player mission for them (it showed an error box and then crashed), so the 1 player mission is played now, with a log line. Game run checks for 2 and 3 players.

Added the Speed Bomb job to the shared CB radio. The car of the player who takes it carries a bomb that arms above 50 mph and blows up when the speed stays under that for 5 seconds. Drive 3 minutes or reach 8 checkpoints for 400 to 800 dollars. After a blast the player is put back on the road after 5 seconds. Only automatic tests ran, Solo play has no radio offer yet.

Made a race stop putting the car back at the last checkpoint while it waits in front of a raised Chicago bridge. Before, standing there for 5 seconds counted as stuck, and the bridge can stay up for 40 seconds. Checked by automatic tests,

Added a CAMERA step to the mission maker. It plays a camera path you made with the Film Director: the placed cameras of a recording become a small file next to the mission, so you can share the mission without the replay. The step can wait for the end, can be skipped with Cross or Enter, and can lock your controls or let you keep driving. The editor lists your recordings, plays a preview in the editor view and saves the file with the mission. Old missions load as before, a mission with the step needs 0.5.0 or newer. Black bars and the lens of the recording are saved but not drawn yet. Checked by unit tests, two scripted game runs (the path plays, the mission ends; a missing file is skipped) and the tick hash (184 ok).

Fixed the cars you have to follow in the story chases (and in the Ram the car games) crashing into walls and wrecking themselves in nearly every try. The chased car now drives past building corners, takes no damage and is put back on its wheels if it rolls over, so it drives its whole route; it still plows through the traffic. New option chaseSafeTraffic in config.ini (1 on, 0 = the old behaviour). Tested only by automatic runs of every chase,
Fixed the Driver 1 chase mission 1157, whose target car stood off the roads of the Miami level and could not pull out: it is put in a lane of the nearest road now.

Marked restarting a mission from the pause menu as experimental in this beta: it resets traffic, police, jobs, the camera and the random numbers to a fresh start, but only one mission restart (mission 33) has been played through by hand, so report any mission that hangs or starts wrong after a restart.

Rewrote the CB small talk, the passenger stories and story series, the taxi passenger remarks and the boss lines in the same late 70s voice as the CB chatter, and translated all 161 changed or new CB, job and taxi texts by hand into the other languages. Old translations of replaced lines are gone.

Added the Pick List order: five cars the Auto Exchange needs in 25 minutes, offered at the shop and on the CB radio. Every car you turn in is paid with a rush price, and a finished list pays a bonus and a time bonus to everyone who helped.
Added your standing with the boss to the Jobs page of the stats. The game now says when you gain reputation or get promoted, and the Pick List adds reputation.

Added a daily contract board to Take a Ride. Every game day has three contracts (deliveries, taxi fares, hidden packages, distance, losing the police, winning a race). All players see the same three and count their own progress. A finished contract pays a bonus and gives respect with the boss. There is a Contracts page in the Stats screen and a message when a new day starts.

sections.title: Level Editor
lines: Polished the look of the classic level editor: plates behind the panels, little triangles on the sections, an underline on the active tab, soft shadows and a small axes widget.
Fixed the editor menu dropdown clicking through to the buttons below it.
Changed box select over original faces to be instant, it used to cast 600 rays three times.
Changed the green selection highlight to show every selected face, tinted and outlined, not only the first 40.
Put all the editor shortcuts in one list that feeds HELP > Keyboard shortcuts, and it is checked for clashes at start.
Changed F1 to open the editor manual, and moved the polygon keys to F2 and F3.
Stopped the renderer's own debug keys (F3, F5, F6, Backspace) from firing while the editor is open.
Changed the editor to follow the HUD theme (70s, PlayStation, Driver Menu and mod themes), with THEME buttons on the VIEW tab and VIEW > Next theme.
Added a small thumbnail of its texture to every row of the piece list.
Changed a piece whose outline passes close to the cursor to be pickable even when the ray misses it, like thin slivers and edge-on pieces.
Added import from inside the editor: an OBJ MODELS section on the CREATE tab, files dropped on the window are copied into the library, and png, jpg and tga pictures work as custom textures.
Added INTRO SCENE and OUTRO SCENE rows to the mission maker.
Changed the mission maker to draw the start, goals, targets and destinations of the draft as labelled rings in the editor view.
Added NEW, COPY and DELETE buttons for mission slots and a line that says what the draft still lacks.
Changed lamps, signs and barriers of the level to light up under the cursor, and a click turns one into a piece you can move, turn, scale, copy or delete.
Added a SCENES tab to the editor, a scene composer that builds scenes with buttons.
Added STOP, SPEED and POLICE steps, a CAR DAMAGE row and slot titles to the mission maker.
Stopped browsing mission slots from leaving empty drafts behind.
Changed the level editor to hitch less in New York, picking a hidden original face went from up to 810 ms to about 1 ms.
Changed every text in the level editor to go through the translation files (423 new texts), and the Greek capital Omega now shows.
Changed the editor reading of its files to be safer: lines are whole or skipped, counts are capped, bad numbers are refused and names cannot carry a folder.
Fixed sample OBJ files importing as a dot in the editor (a scale reference in the header gave scale 0), and the lap text no longer points at freed memory.

Changed the editor to save through a temp file, so a failed save is reported and keeps your work. The clipboard, object, pack and editor pack files are written the same way, so a crash while saving can no longer leave a half written file.
Added T and Shift+T in the level editor to cycle through everything under the cursor, and an M collision view where a click deletes the solid under the cursor.
Changed a big solid in the collision view to need a second click to delete, and the texts for picking and the collision view are in all languages.
Added a TO PATCH button that writes your editor edits as a level patch into the open .level file, with texts in all languages.
Fixed the mission maker START and GOAL buttons aiming through the cursor that sits on the button, they now place at the middle of the view and warn when nothing is hit.

Changed BAKE in the level editor to write your edits into your own copy of the level, on top of the installed level with the Core edits. The button now says which file it writes, for example BAKE INTO chicago.level, it keeps your copy from before as a backup, and the city restarts by itself.
Stopped the editor loading the Core edits twice when the level already carries them.
Changed marker add, paste and object place to aim through the middle of the view when the mouse is over the menu, with a No Surface In View message.
Added an undo history list in the VIEW tab, click a step to jump back or forward.
Added a file browser panel to the editor (packs, edit files, textures, objects).
Fixed BAKE in the editor, the restart opens the baked level copy and your edits stay if the game would not load it.
Changed switching packs in the editor to keep patch pieces and hidden faces, switching packs drops the old pack's deleted objects, and the PACK button names the next pack and the save target.
Changed every piece, face and object of a layer to be editable, and edits are saved into the working pack.
Added UNDO BAKE, it brings back the level copy from before the last bake.
Added SHARE LEVEL, it copies the whole baked level to a share folder with the date in the name and shows you the path.

Changed RESET LEVEL to keep your copy as a backup instead of deleting it, so UNDO BAKE can bring it back, and the city restarts by itself like BAKE and UNDO BAKE, so the pieces you baked are gone at once.
Added a new level editor look with a SIMPLE and an ADVANCED mode, a tool palette, a top bar, a right panel and a hint bar. SIMPLE is the default.
Added first time help cards to the SIMPLE editor mode.
Added Ctrl+K in the editor, it searches every menu entry and tool, and Ctrl+Shift+A switches between SIMPLE and ADVANCED.
Added a switch in the editor settings to go back to the classic editor look.
Changed the game to draw things a level patch adds and retextures, an added object stands in the city and is solid, a retextured face shows its new texture.
Changed the editor click to take the nearest visible thing instead of the water behind a fence, and to take original faces by default.
Fixed a held T key running through every candidate in the editor.
Changed the editor collision view so a click goes to the solid first.
Fixed M and T reaching the game while the editor is open (the map screen smeared the collision view), and made a click take a whole solid object.
Fixed clicking a concrete barrier in the editor, one click takes the whole level object (both sides and the top) with its collision, and no hidden copy stays.
Changed leaving the editor to put your car at the camera on the ground and leave the free camera.
Updated the editor manual with the bake buttons, box select of 1500 faces, undo depth and browse files.
Fixed the level editor crashing when placing the mission start and goal markers.

Fixed the RESET LEVEL button text in the editor: it said it deletes your copy, but it keeps a backup and UNDO BAKE brings the copy back, in all 14 languages. Wrote the editor manual pages for the SIMPLE and ADVANCED modes, the tool palette, tool search, the first-time cards, the Saving to panel and the bake buttons.

Fixed the Saving to chip in the ADVANCED editor bar cutting the pack name, and gave the tool palette short labels that fit the column in German, French, Hungarian and Spanish. The Ctrl+K tool search now also finds a tool by its English name in every language.
Added a CAR tab to the editor ADD panel: click a car of the level and it is parked at the cursor and stays in the level. TURN, MOVE HERE, NEXT CAR and DELETE work on it and Ctrl+Z undoes every step.

Replaced the arrow buttons of the editor LEVEL tab with a picture chooser: a grid of previews of every level object and car, a search box, kind chips (lamp, sign, fence, road, prop) and a big picture of the picked one. Double click or PLACE puts it down.

Opened the CAR tab of the editor to the whole car catalog, about 1380 cars (Driver 2, Driver 1, Gran Turismo 1 and 2, mod cars), with a search box and kind chips. A parked car is saved by its catalog key and old saved cars still work.
Gave the cars of the editor CAR tab real pictures (1377 of 1383 cars).
Added the Driver 2 cars of all four cities to the editor CAR tab and made them droppable. Cars the customizer cannot load (the police car, some specials) stay empty.

Made a new install start the editor in its own pack called My Edits. The release config ships it and the first F6 makes the folder and says so. The Core pack stays in the pack row (NEXT PACK). Test runs never make the folder.
Added .fbx, .glb and .gltf models to the level editor drop, next to .obj, with their pictures found next to the model.
Raised the triangle limit of the level editor to 100000 for one dropped model and 300000 for the whole level.
Added a car builder: a dropped 3D model becomes a car with Driver 2 driving, ready to pick in the game.
Added a model wizard to the level editor: after you drop a model a form asks name, maker and body type, and SAVE THE CAR puts the car into your pack.

Made the model wizard find the wheels, front, unit and top of a car by itself and ask in the form when it is not sure, with wizard texts in all 16 languages. Machine translated, not read by a native speaker.
Fixed the model wizard drawing the collision box and the driver eye of a model as a black box around the car.
Fixed models that are painted only in colours (OBJ and FBX) coming out grey in the car wizard.
Added a 3D preview to the model wizard: the car with its colours, its size, the wheel rings and the front arrow. You can turn it with the mouse.
Fixed a dropped 3D model that could not be moved with the Move tool.
Added a building and prop path to the model wizard: buildings, scenery, street furniture and figures are placed upright with a solid box so cars hit them.
Added a physics page to the model wizard: type a top speed and set mass, grip and suspension as a percent of a stock car, and see the 0 to 60 time.
Added a tweak page to the model wizard to make the wheels wider, move an axle, lift the body and move the lamps and exhaust.
Added a full colour option to the model wizard so a car keeps the pictures of its model in their own colours.
Added a traffic page to the model wizard: the car can be in the traffic or not, rare or common, and marked as a cab.
Added a WHERE row to the traffic page of the model wizard to limit a car to one city or a group of cities.
Added a row SAVE IN THE OBJECTS LIBRARY (on by default) and a 3D preview of the model to the building and prop page of the model wizard, so the placed pieces can be placed again in any level.
Updated the editor manual and the modding guide for the model wizard: every page and the car.txt lines it writes.
Added a CANCEL button to every page of the model wizard that throws the dropped model away, asking first if you changed something.
Fixed a car saved by the model wizard looking missing in the customizer: it now shows first in the Recent list.
Made a car saved by the model wizard show up in the customizer and the car picker at once, without restarting the level.
Gave wizard cars a maker (My Cars) and a NEW chip in the Car tab list for 7 days.
Changed the level editor pack share to write the zip file itself, so no helper program is started.
Fixed the editor help saying 18000 triangles per placement and 20000 per level, the editor takes 100000 per placed model and 300000 in all, in all languages.
Made a dropped model find its pictures even when the MTL file is missing or names other files.
Fixed the model wizard rows and arrows that did not react to the mouse.
Added a SCALE slider to the model wizard car page and an outline of the stock Chicago car next to the model in the preview.
Changed every row of the wizard tweak page into a slider with a large range, and made the wheels, lamps and exhaust draggable in the 3D preview.

Redrew the X Y Z orientation gizmo in the editor corner: soft round backdrop, coloured arms with lettered caps, small dots for the negative ends, far arms dimmer, and a smooth glow with a tooltip when the mouse is over it.

Made the editor crosshair always visible: two tones so it shows on a bright wall, the road and the sky, drawn on top of the panels, at the mouse when the cursor is free. View > Crosshair switches it off.
Added scaling of the editor interface from 75 to 200 percent with Ctrl+= and Ctrl+-, reset with Ctrl+0 or from the View menu; the size is kept between sessions.
Added a compact editor size for mouse and keyboard, so the 3D view gets far more room.

Collapse the right panel, the tool strip and the texture strip with a click on the tab at their edge or with Ctrl+B, Ctrl+L and Ctrl+J, and switch on optional auto-hide so panels slide away until the mouse touches the screen edge.
Add a dark and a light theme to the editor, switched from the View menu or with Ctrl+Shift+T and kept between sessions.

Added a way to open the model wizard without dragging a file: a MODEL WIZARD... button in the CREATE tab (and in SIMPLE under ADD > MODEL), FILE > Import 3D model... and Ctrl+M. Each opens the file browser on your models, Downloads, Desktop and Documents folders, showing only folders and 3D model files; the file you pick goes the same way as a dropped one. Esc does nothing. Checked by automatic tests,

Added an editor settings window (Ctrl+,) with six tabs for the interface, camera, editing, saving and a searchable list of keys. Every setting works at once and is kept after a restart. The menus got Open pack folder, Next grid step, Reset layout, Screenshot and About.
Gave the texture strip at the bottom of the editor its own background bar over the whole screen width, bigger numbers, a frame on the current texture and a size setting.

Added a guided tour of the level editor that darkens the screen and lights up what it explains, starts the first time you open the editor, can be skipped at any step and can be started again from Help.
Fixed the editor tour: on the crosshair step the card ran away from the mouse, now it stays where it is, and the arrow keys and Backspace go on and back.
Replaced the four first-time cards of the level editor with the guided tour, added a TOUR button to the simple view that starts it again, and made the Tutorial row of the editor settings start it.

Fixed the editor tour so a click can no longer skip or break a step: a step goes on only for the real action, a wrong click is ignored with a hint, a double click is one click, and the texture step now lays a texture on the box. When the editor starts in advanced mode the tour is offered in one line.

Changed the DETAIL row of the car wizard to steps of the model itself: TRAFFIC keeps a quarter of its triangles, DETAILED half, HIGH three quarters and ORIGINAL all of them (up to the car limit). The row shows the real numbers, for example 170 of 342 triangles, and the preview changes at once. The reduction keeps the texture seams, the window rims and the wheel arches. Checked by automatic tests and pictures of the real Suspicious Car 01 model,

Changed the car wizard preview to draw the model with its picture like a 3D viewer: perspective correct, smooth light, filtered texture at the size of the picture, and the 16 colour palette of the game when that is chosen. The old preview was blocky, smeared and noisy. The TEXTURES row and a line under the preview now say which picture mode the preview shows.
Fixed the texture strip: the thumbnails are drawn flat now, in true colours. The wet road and wall grain shader no longer darkens or roughens them. Checked with a rain picture before and after,

Fixed PLAY in the scene composer: the scene is read from its own folder, so a new scene plays (cards, panels, captions) and after it the level starts again with the editor still on, not the main menu. A scene without items or a missing file now says so in the log. Checked by automatic tests; the look of the scene and the return were

Changed the MISSION tab: the crosshair stays in the middle of the screen and is always shown, and a placed point (start, goal, checkpoint, target, destination) can be moved afterwards: pointer over its ring, hold the right mouse button, drag, let go. It lights up, UNDO takes the move back. New help line and status text in all languages by hand. Checked by automatic tests at 75, 100 and 200 percent; the feel with a real mouse was

Fixed the model wizard cars coming out dark. The game lights a wizard car like a Driver 2 car (0.55 of the picture in the shade, 0.65 to 0.69 on average), so a model painted for a plain viewer looked grey in the game. Every picture and colour is now 40 percent brighter when the car is built (white stays white, the hue stays), and the preview now uses the same light as the game, so what the preview shows is what drives. Measured on the Suspicious Car 01 in the customizer: the car is 21 percent brighter, preview and game within 3 percent.

Made the full colour cars of the model wizard small and correct. The paint pictures go to the game as the right paint (the customizer's second colour is the first paint), the pictures are compressed (51 KB instead of 4 MB, a car with five paints 190 KB instead of 24 MB), and the swatches in the Paint tab show the body colour instead of a lamp colour. The wizard log tells how much of the model is wound inward.

Changed the level editor manual to be easy to read: numbered pages with one line on top, a quick start, and new pages for settings, saving, the model wizard and troubleshooting. The text file has a contents list and 78 columns.
Fixed the editor panel buttons showing over the manual, the settings window and the model wizard, and clicks reaching the editor buttons behind them.

Changed the level editor manual to the format of old Windows help files: chapters with numbered topics, back and forward, one readable text size, full paragraphs with steps, notes and links, a full model wizard section and a glossary. The manual is English only for now.

Rewrote every topic of the level editor manual as full text: settings, menus, selecting and moving, copy, textures, missions, scenes, saving, the guided tour and troubleshooting. The manual is English only for now.

Made water tiles easy to select in the editor: a WATER ONLY button (also in Ctrl+K) makes clicks, hover and box select see water and nothing else, and SELECT WATER takes every water tile in view. Delete and undo work on them. Added a SURFACE row (sidewalk, grass, gravel, sand, shallow water, deep water) so a piece can set what the ground under it is made of: grip, tyre sound and drowning follow it, and it is saved in the edits file. Checked by automatic tests in Chicago, Havana, Las Vegas and Rio, The Hide water toggle is not done.

Added a search to the level editor manual: type while it is open and the page shows the matching places, a click goes there. Back, forward and close are plain arrow and cross buttons in a bar under the title, with arrows for the previous and next topic. Added a glossary of 115 words, an alphabetical INDEX topic, and index words in the text that are underlined links to the exact heading. The text manual has the same glossary and index. The new bar texts are translated in all languages, the glossary and index are English only. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed the editor light marker. It was 12 times fainter than a street lamp, so it left no pool of light on the road. It now lights like a lamp at night, also after you leave the editor. The marker is a handle in the world now: you can click it, box it, drag it with the move tool, nudge it with the arrow keys, delete it and undo all of it. It also shows by day while the editor is open. Checked by automatic tests,

Added a TEXTURE TOOLS section to the TEXTURE tab of the level editor. LOAD PICTURE takes the picture of the selected pieces (a picture of the pack or a texture of the game). Sliders for hue, saturation, brightness, contrast, levels and a three point curve, buttons for invert, grey and flips, a reduction to the 16 colours of a car texture with dither, a tile check that moves the picture by half so a seam shows, a seam score and the UV triangles over the picture. APPLY ADJUST saves the result as a new picture in the textures folder of the pack and puts the selected pieces on it, so Ctrl+Z brings the old picture back, the original and the disc data are never touched. Keys: Alt+Enter, Alt+Arrows, Alt+Delete. Texts in all languages. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed the box select in WATER ONLY: a drag now always makes a box (also with the Move tool, which grabbed the tile before) and takes every water tile the box touches, not only the ones fully inside. SELECT WATER used a box 0 to 320 wide and missed the sides of a wide window, it covers the whole view now. Added ALL WATER (every water tile of the level, up to 3000 original faces), CONNECTED (the whole bay from the selected water) and HIDE WATER, and WATER ONLY draws everything that is not water dark. Added the keys Ctrl+W (water only), Ctrl+Shift+W (select water in view) and Ctrl+E (next surface), the buttons in the View tab, and texts in all languages. Water tiles of a Driver 2 city are a few big faces (Havana: about 4 in view), so the count can be small. Checked by automatic tests in Chicago, Havana, Vegas, Rio and Miami,

Fixed the editor settings window (Ctrl+,): its tabs and buttons could not be clicked any more since the windows that own the pointer came in, the click was held back from it. It gets the click again. Checked by automatic tests,

Clipped the scrolling editor panel to its own area: when the Mission tab (or any tab) is scrolled, the lines no longer draw over the tab rows and the top bar, and a click above the area no longer hits a hidden button. The ITEM list also no longer grows when the panel is scrolled.

Added SELECT SAME TEXTURE: click one face, press SAME TEXTURE (Ctrl+T) and every flat face you can see with that texture is selected, so one click takes the whole water of a bay and the same works for a road or a floor. SAME: LEVEL takes the faces of the whole level (up to 6000 original faces) and SAME: TOUCHING grows from the selected face through the touching faces with that texture. FLAT ONLY keeps the faces within 15 degrees of level and can be switched off. The count shows on the status bar. Texts in all languages. Checked by automatic tests in Chicago, Havana, Vegas, Rio and Miami,

Changed SAME TEXTURE (button and Ctrl+T) to select every face of that texture in the whole level, not only what you see. The old 6000 face limit is gone: only a full editor (300000 triangles) stops it, and the status bar then says so. SAME: VIEW (Ctrl+Alt+T) keeps the small case. SAME: TOUCHING now follows faces whose boxes meet, because big water and ground tiles meet in the middle of an edge: in Miami it takes 12221 of the 13152 water faces from one click instead of 5. Texts changed in all languages. Checked by automatic tests,

Added a TEXTURE TOOLS topic to the editor manual: the sliders, the switches, the buttons, the four Alt keys and where the new picture file goes. The SELECT + MOVE topic now explains SAME TEXTURE, WATER ONLY, ALL WATER, CONNECTED, HIDE WATER and the SURFACE chips. Added 8 glossary words and 23 index rows. Checked by automatic tests,

Changed SHARE LEVEL in the level editor to share only your own work. It zips your pack with your edits, also the ones a bake put aside, and your pictures and models, with no level data from your discs. The other player unpacks it into mods and it goes on their own copy of the city. The whole level moved to a new button, SHARE FULL LEVEL, which asks you to type YES and warns that it holds game data from your discs. rdcontent pack install now says which city a pack belongs to. Checked by automatic tests,

Added exact moves to the level editor. Press C to move, V to turn or Z to change the size of the selection. The mouse moves it live, or you type a number (12.5, or 3,0,-2 for three directions) and Enter keeps it exactly. Esc or the right mouse button puts everything back. If you type a number while you drag, the drag turns into the typed move. The status bar shows the numbers. The keys are in the shortcut list and in Ctrl+K. Checked by automatic tests,

Added axis locks to the exact transforms of the level editor. While C, V or Z is going, press X (east), Y (up) or Z (north) to lock to that axis, or Shift with the key to lock to the plane without it. A line shows the axis, the same key unlocks, and a typed number follows the lock. Ctrl+K has three entries that start a move already locked. Checked by automatic tests,

Added soft selection to the exact transforms of the level editor. Press O while moving, turning or sizing: pieces near the selection follow with a smooth falloff. The mouse wheel sets the radius and a ring on the ground shows it. Ctrl+K has an entry that starts a move with it on. Checked by automatic tests,

Added more ways to select in the level editor. Ctrl+Numpad + grows the selection by one step and Ctrl+Numpad - shrinks it by one step. Shift+C turns on a circle brush that paints the selection (Ctrl takes pieces away, the wheel sets the size, Esc ends it) and a circle follows the mouse. Ctrl+K has entries for all of them and for select linked (the old key 5). Select all, none, invert, box select and same texture were there before. Checked by automatic tests,

Added an outliner and view modes to the level editor. The piece list now has a search (FIND..., a name, a number like #5 or a group name) and H and L buttons on every row: H hides a piece or a whole group while you edit (it is not drawn, picked or selected, and it is not saved), L locks it (drawn, but cannot be picked). Ctrl+H hides the selection, Ctrl+Alt+H shows everything. Shift+Z switches between the textured and a wireframe view, and Numpad 1, 3 and 7 (with Ctrl the other side) look along an axis at the selection as a flat view. There is no flat solid mode yet. Checked by automatic tests and pictures,

Extended the ruler of the level editor and the typed numbers. A measure click now snaps to a corner of a piece or of the original face near the cursor. Two points show distance, slope and heading, a third point shows the angle at the second point, a fourth starts again. In every typed number you can calculate (2*3, 12.5+4, (10-2)/4), also in the entry bars like type the X position, and an unfinished sum moves nothing. While a mouse transform runs, Shift makes the mouse ten times finer and Ctrl turns the grid snap the other way. The typed numbers are checked by automatic tests, the ruler numbers and the snap not yet.

Added six editing tools to the level editor. Shift+X is a lasso: drag a free outline round pieces, it replaces the selection, Shift adds, Ctrl takes away, and the outline is drawn. Numpad 1, 3 and 7 give a flat view with no perspective, the wheel zooms, the middle button pans, a grid is drawn, and Numpad 5 switches back. The axis ball in the corner is clickable: a cap looks from that side, the centre from the opposite side, a drag turns the view. Numpad / is a local view that keeps only the selection until you press it again (it only hides pieces, not the original level, and your own hide and lock stay). The X, H and Z fields and DEGREES and SIZE can be dragged left and right (Shift finer, Ctrl coarser, one undo step), a click still types a number. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V over a field copy and paste its value. Known: in the flat view cars, people and rain are not flat and sit in the wrong place, and a front view at road level shows the water plane over the lower half. Checked by automatic tests and pictures,

Made the step list of the mission maker wrap over up to 4 lines so all steps show and no name is cut in the middle, named the rows of MAX SPEED, STEALTH, MAX DAMAGE and LIMIT TIME like their steps (all 21 languages had the names already), and put two close world labels (PICKUP and DROP OFF) one above the other.

Translated the new level editor buttons into all 20 languages: SAME TEXTURE, SAME: VIEW, SAME: TOUCHING, FLAT ONLY, ALL WATER, CONNECTED, HIDE WATER, SHARE FULL LEVEL, NEXT CAR, INVERT, BRIGHTNESS, CONTRAST and MISSION STEPS, plus the manual page names and the WATER tab (machine quality, Only the editor pictures in German, Greek, Japanese and Serbian were looked at).

Hardened the geometry bake of the level editor. A bake of a patch over the same level file now writes beside it and moves it over, so a kill or a full disk leaves the old level whole. More than 32 patch files are refused with a message instead of dropping the rest. The list of rewritten geometry files cannot run over its end any more. The .bak copy for UNDO BAKE is written beside and renamed, a stale one is removed first, and UNDO BAKE only removes your baked copy once the kept one is in place. RESET LEVEL keeps the old .bak when there is no baked copy. Checked by automatic tests,

Wrote the missing manual topic BLENDER STYLE TOOLS for the level editor (also the F1 help in the game). It explains the typed moves C, V and Z with sums, the X Y Z and Shift axis locks, soft selection with O, circle and lasso select, select linked, grow and shrink, the piece list with search, hide and lock, the flat Numpad views and the local view, draggable number fields with copy and paste of values, and the ruler. Every key was checked in the code first. Added glossary words and index rows, shortened the long labels of the shortcut table, and made the text manual new from the sources, so the shortcut page now lists the new keys too. The topic is English only like the rest of the manual.
Fixed the deleted level objects of your edits and of installed packs being added a second time every time the city restarts. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed a custom mission text that is longer in another language (German, French) than the file: the next level data overwrote the end of the texts. The game now keeps the longer size. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed the mission maker steps ESCAPE, TAIL, STOP, SPEED and POLICE after a restart: they kept the state of the first try (ESCAPE ended without any police, STOP kept its old count). Their state now starts fresh with every mission load. Checked by automatic tests,
Added a yellow box around everything that is selected in the editor, with the piece count over it, so you can see what the move tool will move.
Fixed the axis gizmo in the level editor showing and taking clicks under an open window (manual, entry bar, file browser, wizard, settings). Checked by automatic tests,
Fixed the yellow selection box around a turned ramp: it now turns with the selection and fits it, not a big straight box with long lines running off the screen.

Fixed the editor markers that could be picked but not moved (the lamps of the Goose Island pack). Moving, resizing, renaming or deleting a marker of another pack now copies it into your own pack and hides the original there, so the other pack is never changed. Added a legend, a hover plate that says what a marker is, rings and names only for the picked marker (VIEW tab can show all), a marker list that flies to the marker, and duplicate and rename. Texts in all languages, machine translated. Checked by automatic tests and pictures,

Rebuilt how the editor takes a mouse click: one fixed order (panels, handles, markers, pieces, empty space) and one drag state. Esc now cancels a drag and puts the pieces back, and a lost mouse release no longer leaves a drag or the look mode stuck. The move arrows, plane squares, turn rings and a new scale cube also work on the picked marker (arrows only) and sit at the centre of the selection box; the key ' changes the pivot. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed the editor manual generator. It now reads the marker panel again, no longer misses the pivot key rows and the light pools, and makes the button page sizes itself. The manual and the button help are regenerated.

Made hover, click and the T cycle agree in the editor: one pick service now answers pieces, original faces, level objects and water, and walks the level once per ray. Mission points can be picked with a click and moved with the arrows and the ground square like markers; Esc puts one back.

Added a race course tool to the editor. The checkpoints you place become a course: set the name, kind, laps, prize and the start pad, save it into your pack (courses of the game stay) and test drive it from the pad. Help topic added, 20 languages by hand.

Fixed the car moving when you leave the level editor: it now stays where it was when you opened the editor, same turn and same speed. Shift+F6 still puts it at the camera. Also switched off a stuck mouse capture, so the pointer stays free over the editor panels.

Added SLICE SOLID: cuts the selected collision box in two at the cursor (button, Edit menu, Ctrl+Shift+X, one undo step). The picture stays the same. 8 new texts in 21 languages. Also added two test beds: Duplicate copies every field of every face (vertices byte for byte) and select, deselect and the edits file text change nothing.

Added two more pivot choices to the level editor, the active piece and each piece on its own (turn and scale then work about the middle of every piece), and a 3D cursor you can see: a click puts it (Ctrl+'), it jumps to the selection (Alt+') or to the world origin (Alt+Shift+'). The help screen, the tool search and 20 languages have the new keys.

Added snapping to the level editor: hold the key left of 1 while you drag a piece on the ground and its nearest corner jumps onto a corner of another piece (Shift: the middle of a face), with a ring on the target. Added nine saved selection sets: Ctrl+Shift+1 to 9 saves the selection, Alt+1 to 9 selects it again. The sets live while the editor runs, they are not written to the edits file.

Added merge by distance to the level editor (Alt+M): corners of the selected pieces that lie within a quarter of the step size of each other become one, so seams between hand placed pieces close, and triangles that lose their area are dropped. One undo step. Mirror, array and turning the faces around were already there.

Added resize handles and a size field for solid collision boxes. With the SCALE tool a selected solid box shows a square on every face; drag one to move that face, the opposite face stays, and the grid step snaps it. The panel has a BOX row (X, height, Z) you can drag or type into, and Ctrl+Alt with the arrow and Page keys resizes by the step. One undo step per change, saved in the edits file and baked like any piece. Texts are in 20 languages (the manual paragraphs are English only). Tested by automatic checks only,

Changed the level editor to say how many triangles a dropped 3D model placed, and that it was cut at 18000 when it was bigger. A drop only adds pieces and never hides or deletes anything of the level.
Fixed FBX models painted in the modeller without pictures coming out flat grey in the car wizard, the plain colour of each material is read now.
Fixed the outlines of a selected object showing through the texture strip at the bottom of the editor, they stop at the edge of the 3D view now.

Changed the model wizard defaults and the paints after the second dark car report. The car now starts at the highest detail and in full colour (before it was 25 percent of the triangles and a 256 pixel picture of 15 colours). Full colour cars now have paints too, one picture per paint. A paint picture that is much darker than the base picture (the Red variant of the Suspicious Car) is lifted so it does not give a muddy car. The wizard checks the winding of the model and turns it when it is wrong.

Fixed picking in the level editor: a piece that lies behind the ground (like the water under a shore) is not lit or picked any more, so what is under the crosshair is what you get. A click on a gizmo arrow or ring always grabs it before anything else is picked, nothing is lit while the pointer is on a handle, and the crosshair is always drawn, in the middle of the view when the pointer is on a panel.

Fixed the editor view washing out white and grainy by day when light markers were placed (the Auto Exchange lot). The editor now lights the scene like the game: lamps only at dusk and night. A new LIGHT POOLS switch in the VIEW tab shows the marker pools by day if you want to see them, off by default. Fixed the small texture square that stayed on the 3D view after the texture strip was closed.

Reworked the editor overlays: one colour table now, so hover, selection, markers, places, water and collision each have their own colour. Added a legend, WATER ONLY and FLAT ONLY chips, and a status line with what is under the pointer and how much is selected. The TEXTURE panel shows the sampled texture. Lights can be warm, white, cool, red or green, with a strength and a by-day switch, and the ring of a marker can be dragged. The places of the Auto Exchange (repair pad, showroom door, lot stalls) show up as markers and can be moved and saved in your pack.

Added to the level editor: frame the selection (Numpad . or Ctrl+F) or everything (Shift+Numpad . or Ctrl+Shift+F), nine camera views (Ctrl+1 to 9 go there, Ctrl+Shift+1 to 9 save), TO GROUND (Ctrl+Shift+D), TO FACE, TO GRID, SPREAD Y and SAME HEIGHT for the selection, and PLAY HERE that drives from the selection and comes back with Esc or F6 to the same view. After a crash the editor asks RECOVER or DISCARD when the autosave is newer than your saved edits, the status line says how long ago it was written, and REVERT throws away everything since the last save (Ctrl+Z brings it back). The OBJECTS tab has a search box, a double click places the object at the crosshair and TURN lets you place it turned. Fixed the autosave file path being cut in a long game folder, and a hover that could point past the end of the piece list after a delete or undo. Texts are in all languages.

Added LOAD COURSE to the race course tool: pick a saved course by its id and its checkpoints come back as CHECKPT markers in the same order, with name, kind, laps, prize and start pad. Checkpoints can now carry names (optional pname lines in the races file, old files load as before), and saving a course no longer adds an empty line to the file each time.

sections.title: Modding and Tools for Modders
lines: Fixed mods with a DRIVER2 folder (like BetterCars) doing nothing, because the shipped settings switched them off. They are switched on now.
Added the whole editor manual as a text file in the package.
Updated the modding guide for car packs, traffic cars, the new option keys and how damaged files are handled.
Added the Driver 1 cities folder and the gas station file to the README.
Wrote down the formats of jobs.txt and fares.txt in the modding guide.
Added a level file reader to the test tools that dumps the contents of Driver 1 and Driver 2 level files.
Replaced the old mission tool with a new one that can extract, dump, build and check missions. It makes the same files as before for all 137 missions of the game.
Replaced the old mod pack tool with a new one that can make, check, pack, install and list mods. The zip files are a bit bigger but hold the same files.
Moved the chase and cutscene tool to C. It can turn recorded replays into chase and cutscene bundles, with the same result as before.
Moved the car sound tool to C. It makes the looped engine sound files for a car, byte for byte what the old tool made.
Moved the road and city label tool to C. It writes the street names for Chicago, Havana, Las Vegas and Rio, the same files as before.
Updated the modder guides for the new mission, pack and chase tools, and the package now ships the content tool.

Moved the translation tools to C. They can export the language texts, pull the subtitles and credits headings from the discs, write the editor help list and build the setup language table, and they check the setup keys.
Moved the Driver 1 car and level viewers to C.
Moved the disc tools to C. They read files from a disc image and open a PlayStation program (Gran Turismo too).
Changed an unknown command line option to get logged instead of opening a help window, the help opens for -help, -h and -?.
Added a check to the translation tool that finds a text key translated two different ways in two language files.
Added a test tool command that finds the gas stations of a Driver 2 city in the level data.
Added a content tool option that lists the lumps and chunk sizes of a level file.
Added replacing the pages of a car with a PNG (cars/name.png).
Changed BetterCars style PAGE_n TIM files to reach the borrowed cars of other cities.
Added a car modding handbook (scale, axes, names, textures, performance sheet and the Car Creator flow); imported cars use their real performance by default.
Added car templates for modders: scale reference boxes per vehicle class and a low poly sedan as OBJ files in metres.
Added a test tool command that prints car model sizes in game units and metres for Driver 2, Driver 1 and Gran Turismo cars.
Added a performance sheet for a car to the content tool.
Added pinned performance sheets for the Driver 2 and Driver 1 cars.
Added a Gran Turismo car record to sheet mapping to the test tools.
Added a test tool command that writes Driver 2 level textures as PNG in the override layout.
Added a test tool command that turns edited PNGs back into 4 bit TIM files.
Updated the modding guide and tools list, added a chapter on dumping textures with a road texture template, and wrote down the rules for mods on borrowed cars.
Added a car model builder that turns an OBJ model and a PNG texture into a game car, with wheel position, centre of gravity and collision points filled in.
Added the Car Creator, a window (reDriver_CarCreator.exe) where you fill in a car sheet, see a preview, run the checks and build the car, and made it keep game folder paths out of its messages.
Added a content tool command that prints the car catalog of a game or mod folder without starting the game.
Added commands to the content tool to import and check content packages, and a city can be read from its level file. This is on by default now (contentLoader=1 in config.ini).
Changed the Car Creator quick test to also switch the performance sheet on, and to put your own settings files back when the game exits.
Added usage help for the sheet, car, package, screenshot test and release check tool commands.
Changed the release build to ship reDriver_CarCreator.exe next to the game and in the ModTools zip.
Fixed the test tool reading past the end of a file in a damaged level lump.
Fixed the test tool reading a disc image folder past the image, and following a folder that lists itself.
Fixed the test tool crashing on a damaged JPEG, the segment length is checked first.
Fixed the test tool checking texture counts in 32 bit, a huge count read far past the lump.
Fixed the test tool reading the Driver 1 car view table out of the lump with a bad texture count.
Put the cars handbook into the tools folder of the game package and into the ModTools zip.
Added the level file (.level), one zip with the whole city, with a tool to pack, unpack, list and check it, and the game reads a .level directly.
Added a list of every object in a city with a stable number, and level patch files, so a level can have things removed from it and the game removes them (picture and collision).
Added a tool that turns the objects you deleted in the editor into a level patch.

Gave level patches a second format with hidden faces and added pieces, one shared library for the tools and the game, and a level rebuild. The editor opens the hidden faces and piece layers so you can edit them.

Changed a .level to be able to carry the missions of its city (a missions folder with a checked list). The game cannot start them from there yet, it still loads the mission files from the MISSIONS folder.
Added the car file (.car), one zip per car, with a tool to pack, unpack, list, check, hash, export and convert old car files into it.
Wrote a docs pass for the game folder, car and level files, patches, mission tools and the installer, and added MODDING_files.txt.
Changed city files to carry the whole city, the roads, cell lists, models and pages, and added a compare command that checks them against the discs byte for byte.
Added a tool that reads the Driver 1 PC levels and compares them with the PlayStation ones, the PC Newcastle level is the PC version of the credits level.
Changed the Driver 2 car mod tool to write a car file with its flags, no .d1c and no index line.
Changed the car convert command to also take a mod's cars folder, so a mod with .d1c cars turns into car files.
Added a second route that builds the Driver 1 city level files with the player start taken from the original game table, and a compare command, Miami looks the same.
Updated the README and the modding guide with the light presets, dynamic weather, police patrols, shader cache, profile slots, console commands and tweak keys.
Fixed the car handbook, the modding files and the Car Creator quick test. The quick test now only turns the performance sheet on.

Changed the README and the modding guides to match the game today: the Driver 1 disc and its missions mod, the multiplayer picker, Switch Pro pads, Portuguese in the language list, and the real game mode names.

Moved BetterCars and Driver2TextureFixes by Commando52Colton into the game as built in packs. They are always on, load right after the core pack and no longer show in the mod list. How the game looks with the packs.

Split the game log in two: a small player log with what a bug report needs (your Windows user name is cut from its paths) and a developer log that is off by default and testers can switch on. Lines about a damaged or refused file are warnings in the player log.

Changed the 26 binary subtitle files of the speech into one plain text file (DRIVER2/XA/XA_SUBTITLES.TXT): per speech a track line, then one line per cue with start frame, end frame and the English text (130 cues). The game reads it with a range checked parser. Other languages work as before, the cue text is still the key in localizations/*/subtitles.txt.
Fixed a damaged level file crashing the game on load.
Fixed a changed progress.sav with a car model or paint that does not exist crashing the continue point.
Fixed a sound file with a loop point past its data making the game crash or hang on that sound.
Added extra physics values to the car sheet for modders, all set to the Driver 2 numbers by default.
Extended the level checks so a damaged level cannot make the game read outside its data. A damaged .level in a mod no longer takes the city away: the game falls back to the level of the base game.
Added a cockpit line to the car effects file so a car can set where the driver eye sits. (experimental, off by default, not finished)

Changed the model wizard so a dropped car is fitted to the length of the Chicago car of its body type by default (5.0 m for a sedan), whatever unit the finder guessed. The SCALE slider adjusts by hand from there, a typed length or unit still wins, and the car page says FITTED TO THE CHICAGO CAR or OWN SIZE. A model that came out 3.97 m next to the 5.0 m outline now comes out 5.0 m, and 4.0 m at 80 percent. Checked by automatic tests,

Added solid wheels to the model wizard 3D preview (car page and tweak page): the game's wheel face on a dark tyre at each wheel, with a WHEELS button and the R key to switch back to the wire rings. Textured wheels are the default and the choice is kept while the game runs; outside a level the rings are shown. New texts in all languages. Pictures looked at (low resolution),

Changed the model wizard window so it opens in the middle of the screen on every page and screen shape, and you can drag it by its title bar. It stays inside the screen and keeps its place until the wizard is opened again. All buttons, rows, sliders and the 3D view follow the moved window. Checked by automatic tests for 4:3, 16:9 and 21:9,

Fixed the model wizard not finding a texture when the folder holds colour variants. A model that wants 'Texture.png' next to 'Texture White.png', 'Texture Black.png' and more now takes the white (else grey, else first) one as the picture and the others as paints, and a mask picture is left out. The car page and the log say which files were used.

Fixed the model wizard car looking wrong with a texture sheet. The 3D preview now cuts big triangles into small ones so the picture can be read, and flat sheet art is cut to 16 colours without dither dots. The saved car was looked at in the game from the side.
Fixed the editor side panel scrolling the mission parameters first. The wheel now scrolls the list under the mouse, and the whole panel everywhere else and when the list is at its end.

Added undo and redo to the mission maker and the scene tab (Ctrl+Z on the tab), and a DELETE SCENE button. A scene without items no longer plays, a clip needs an avi file first, and line breaks in mission and scene texts no longer break the saved files.

Added a picture naming rule for imported models: texture.png is the base picture and texture_<paint>.png is one paint each (up to 18), looked for in the model's folder and in its textures folder, any letter case. Other names still work as before. Checked by automatic tests,

Added a PICTURES page to the model wizard. It lists every picture found next to the model and in its textures folder, suggests a role (base, paint or ignore) and a name from the file names, lets you change both, and checks the names as you type. CONTINUE stays grey until they are right. The PICTURES... button on the car page opens it any time. The model's folder is never renamed. Checked by automatic tests,

Changed the model wizard DETAIL row to four steps: 400, 500, 700 and ORIGINAL (up to the 1000 vertices and 1000 triangles the car format takes), with the model's own triangle count shown next to it and a warning only over the limit. The 3D preview now follows the TEXTURES row, so full colour shows all colours of the picture smoothly, and it cuts texture sheet triangles finer.

Added config/keyboard_layouts.ini: it changes keys of the WASD and IJKL layouts or adds a fourth keyboard layout for split screen. A file with a mistake is ignored and says so in the log. Written up in MODDING_files.txt part 9.

Updated the modder guides: car files with up to 19 paints, car effects files, pop-up lids, cars from the model wizard, the new traffic and camera settings, the mod pack layout and one list of the tool commands.

Fixed the modder guides and the tool help text where they did not match the code: the rdcontent help had a broken line and left out the level, car and mission commands, the guides listed a console command and a tool (FontTool) that do not exist, the keyboard layouts file is shipped as a sample, RESET LEVEL keeps a backup now, and the translation list was missing four languages. Added a recipes section (car pack, level pack, translation, music and sound, mission) and a description of the edits file lines, including water and ground material. The sample car and mission commands were run to check the steps; the game was not started.

Hardened two mod text readers. A very long line in an ini or text file no longer turns its tail into a second setting, and a mod job file can no longer set a negative or huge pay or time limit. Checked by automatic tests,
Fixed the texture page unpacker so a damaged level or car texture can no longer write up to 127 bytes in front of its page. Checked by automatic tests,
Fixed a hang in the car sound loader: a damaged .wav in a mod with a huge chunk size made the game read the same chunk for ever. It now stops and the sound is skipped.
Hardened the zip reader of rdcontent pack install against damaged zips (offsets and sizes near 4 GB). Checked by automatic tests,

Brought the modder guides up to date with the work of 2026-11-08. Wrote down the per profile save files (slotstate.sav, fare_serial.ini format 2, damaged files moved to .bad), what SHARE LEVEL zips (a patch pack, no level data) and what SHARE FULL LEVEL is, the water file name rule and the replaces water line, collision shape 3, the _adj texture files, the keys of keyboard seats in the car picker, and the newest options (Smart Racer AI, Windscreen Rain, Carry Fuel Over). Fixed the Driver 1 import notes (all 100 Trail Blazer checkpoints, WaitSeconds as a WAIT step) and added the STOP, SPEED and POLICE targets to the mission guide. Checked each claim against the code and the tool output.

Made the zip reader of the game (levels, cars, share patches) read zip64 files, and refuse password protected zips with a clear message instead of garbage. The rdcontent reader refuses them too. Plain zips read the same as before. Checked with 1441 generated zips (zip64, encrypted, cut and damaged records).

Added look files and .cube LUT import to photo mode: Save Look File writes your sliders as a small text file in photo_looks, and any .cube colour table you put in photo_luts can be picked and mixed in with a strength slider. A damaged file is skipped with a line in the log. The formats are in MODDING_files.txt. LightCraft by the ArtCraft Team (MIT) is credited in the credits and the third party notices.

Let a mod pack bring its own driving network. A file ai/racer_neural_v2.rdpol or ai/cop_neural_v1.rdpol in a pack replaces the one of the Core pack. The last pack in load order with a good file wins. A damaged file is skipped with a line in the log and the next pack below is used, down to Core, and then the normal AI. It is written down in MODDING_files. Checked by automatic tests,

Made the level loader and the event setup safer against damaged data. A level pack with a huge sector number, a negative file offset or a bad bridge and train table is now cut off at the end of the file or table (with one line in the log) instead of reading or writing past it. Valid levels load as before. Checked by automatic tests,

Fixed rdcontent pack install so a pack zip cannot write over the files of an installed mod (the level edits of the Core pack, for example) with a member name like x:reDriver 2 Extended Core/edits_0.txt. Names with a colon, dot dot parts, an absolute path, control characters or a Windows device name (CON, NUL, COM1) are refused before anything is written. Checked by automatic tests, and a crafted zip was refused when tried by hand against a scratch mods folder.

Added the pictures of every car to the game: 1522 thumbnails and 1522 sepia photos, 102 MB, made by one command (rdcontent car photos) with a manifest and a check. They ship with the game, also the ones of the Driver 1 and Gran Turismo cars, so the setup does not draw them again. Only the cars of mods still get drawn on install.

Fixed small things in the content tool for modders: checking a .car file no longer warns about its own temp folder, a mission written as text no longer names an old Python tool in its first line, and the help texts no longer point at internal notes. Checked by running the commands on a sample car and the sample mission.

Added reDriver_ModTools.exe, one program for mod makers. Double click it for a numbered menu: make a new mod from a starter, check a mod, show what a mod changes, pack it into a zip, install a zip, list mods, make a car from a 3D model, turn a mission into text and back. A mod folder or a zip dropped on it is checked or installed and the window stays open. 13 starters with remarks in every file (options, HUD colours, a car with a working sample, a mission that plays, story scene, city changes, translation, sounds, jobs, weather, road textures, radio station, empty). The check names the file, the line and what to do, for mod.json, options, themes, cars, missions, translations, jobs, weather, tyres and more. Unit test with 98 checks: every starter passes its own check and 27 broken mods get the right message. Nobody has double clicked it or dropped a folder on it yet, and no mod maker has tried it.

Rewrote the modding docs for people who are not programmers. New: MODDING_START_HERE.txt (a first mod in 10 minutes, step by step) and one short page per job: a car, a mission, city changes, a translation, sounds, a radio station, textures, options and HUD colours, sharing and installing. MODDING_tools.txt now starts with the new program and its menu. The big reference MODDING_files.txt got a table of contents and its section numbers are in order again (tyres is section 30). Removed a stale line that said level files need a config switch. Every command in the new pages was run. No mod maker has followed the pages yet.

Raised the car model limit from 1024 to 4096 vertices and polygons for the main model of a car. The two small levels of detail keep 1024, so far away traffic stays cheap. Cars with more than 1024 vertices make a car file of version 4. Cars up to 1024 load exactly as before. Unit tests and the second PC ran it,

Taught the mod check to catch typing slips. A misspelt option in tweaks.ini or an entry in mod.json now says 'Did you mean ambcar?', an option set twice is named, and texture pictures (.TIM) are checked for damage and for the right PAGE folder. Only the automatic test of the tool ran.

Added a mod doctor to the mod tools (menu 10, or the command doctor). It looks at all your mods together: the order the game loads them in, one line per mod, and every place where two mods bring the same file, a needed mod is missing, or one mod is there twice. Only the automatic test and one run on the dev mods folder.

Added a Make a mod tab to the project page. It walks through a first mod step by step with the real commands: make it, change it, check it, try it, look at all mods together, share it. The page was built and leak scanned, not looked at in a browser.

Added Check Mods and Open Mods Folder to Options > Mods (main menu and pause menu). Check Mods says in plain words what is wrong: load order, a mod that needs another that is missing, off or loads later, two folders for one mod, mods.ini lines with no folder, and mistyped names with Did you mean. Under the selected mod the list shows a line like Two mods change the same file: x.txt: Beta wins over Alpha. All texts are in the 21 languages. Tick hash 184 ok, screenshots looked at with 3 test mods. Open Mods Folder, pad control.
Added the night light options (round light glow, lamp light on trees) to the list of known options of the mod check, so they are no longer reported as mistyped.

sections.title: Install and Setup
lines: Changed the setup to accept disc images inside .zip and .7z archives, and .rar gets a plain message to unpack it first.
Changed the Gran Turismo 2 row and the summary of the setup to say that the engine sounds are made too, in all languages.
Added Gran Turismo and Gran Turismo 2 disc rows to the setup wizard, and the welcome page lists the Gran Turismo discs.
Changed the setup to make the wheel designs for the customizer from the Driver 1, Driver 2 and Gran Turismo 2 discs.
Changed the setup to convert the four Driver 1 cities itself.
Changed the setup to make the loading pictures of the Driver 1 cities.
Changed the setup to let the game build the city maps at the end of the install, in a hidden window, and put them behind the Driver 1 loading pictures.
Put the version 0.3.1-beta in the game log, the pause menu and the setup.
Changed the game to run silent while the setup builds the city maps.
Moved the Gran Turismo 1 wheel designs into the setup. They are off by default because the Gran Turismo 1 rims looked bad at the Driver 2 wheel size.
Made the setup convert the Driver 2 car mod to .d1c files itself, so the setup is the only converter you need.
Changed Linux to run through Proton (Steam Play) and added a new Linux readme. The old Linux installer is gone.
Fixed the README files so they name the right profile folders for the files the game creates.
Removed the upscaled high quality sky from the setup (the Sharper skies step from 2026-10-15) and from the release checks.

Changed the game to look for its files in a new GAME_DATA folder sorted by type (cars, sounds, HUD, maps, textures, objects, demos, translations, Driver 1 cities, radio, profiles), the old places are only a fallback.
Moved the yellow cab repaint, the car effects and the editor textures of the Core pack into the GAME_DATA folder.
Changed the setup and the release to write the new GAME_DATA folders, the discs go to GAME_DISCS, screenshots go to your profile, and a tool moves an old game folder to the new layout.
Changed the setup into a real installer with the game inside the exe: you pick the folder, it makes the shortcuts, an uninstaller and an Apps and features entry, and it checks the runtime.

Gave the installer an old school look: a welcome page with a picture, a license page, white pages with a red header line and a grey button bar. A progress page with red bars and a big step title, and a last page with the picture and a coloured result list.
Changed the installer to ask for the Driver 2 discs on their own page, then one disc page with a tick box per extra, an extra that is ticked without a disc is refused.
Changed the setup to write every converted Driver 1 and Gran Turismo car as one .car file and to remove the plain file.
Changed the release package to carry the Core edits as one patch file per city, with loud warnings for anything a patch cannot express.
Changed the setup to build the city files for installs and updates (buildLevels), with a dry run and a levels-only mode.
Turned on content loader, texture manager, Driver 2 car files, car scan, Smooth Night and level build by default, every key can be set back.
Changed updates to move old defaults to the new ones once, a changed value stays, and the old file is kept as config.ini.before_flip.
Changed the setup to make only car files. The car list order, flags and pop-up lights are inside each car file now.
Fixed the language key in the shipped config, it is spelled languageId now so the setup can set the language.
Fixed a fresh install logging a car called # when the start car line only held a comment.
Changed a level rebuild to keep the old city file once as .level.old.
Added a warning in the game log and the setup result when a city file is outdated and is not rebuilt.

Added the shared game files to the setup: cars, city pictures, cutscene replays, trails and multiplayer arena maps (120 files, about 28 MB) are taken from the Driver 2 disc next to the game, so the game no longer reads them from the disc image. If the game is already installed, run the setup once (repair) to add them. Files you changed are kept.
Removed the -cdimage option and the [cdfs] image key of config.ini. The game never reads a disc image any more, the discs are only used by the setup. An old config.ini with the section still loads.
Changed the setup to build the Driver 1 Missions mod by itself when the Driver 1 disc is given, no command is needed any more. The Driver 1 movies option follows the movies checkbox.

Fixed the release package: the main menu music and the five attract demos were missing from a clean install and are packed now. The setup also no longer deletes the shipped Gran Turismo 2 lamp and exhaust files when it converts the Gran Turismo cars.
Removed the Chicago Caprice mod from the game, so the package carries two bundled mods, BetterCars and Driver2TextureFixes. It is gone from the release list, the readmes and the credits screen.

Added credits for Commando52Colton (BetterCars and Driver2TextureFixes) and Nikkichan92 (Vegas and Rio night road textures) to the third-party notices and to the package list. The files are used and updated with their permission.

Changed the credit for the platform layer: Psynapse is our own platform layer, started from PsyCross and rewritten, with no PsyCross code left and the MIT notices kept. The same wording stands in the readme, licence and package list. Removed the PsyCross banner picture.

Fixed the Miami level edits not applying on a fresh install. The Miami patch was made from an old Driver 1 Miami level and failed on every item. The test install now builds all 11 levels and bakes the Miami and New York patches.
Changed the uninstaller so it no longer starts ping.exe to wait before it deletes itself. Some security tools treat ping.exe as suspicious.
Fixed the setup loading its files only from the Windows folder and refusing odd archive names, and fixed the path of the runtime installer.
Added version information to the game exe and took two debugging parts out of it, so virus scanners have less reason to flag it. The uninstaller no longer starts a hidden command window.
Fixed the setup crashing on a damaged .7z archive, and added tests for the zip and 7z readers of the setup.
Made the setup cut the semi truck out of the Chicago level of Driver 2 disc 1: a Semi Truck, a Semi Truck with Trailer and the trailer as a hidden part.

Made the game start in the language you picked in the setup: a fresh install writes it into config\language.ini, and a game with no saved language now follows the language of Windows (English if there is no match). An update never changes a language you saved. The setup window itself still has 13 languages, so Portuguese, Japanese and Chinese Windows get their language only through the Windows fallback. Checked by automatic tests,

Added a Driv3r step to the setup: it makes the 39 Driv3r pedestrians (models and walk, run and idle animations) from your own PlayStation 2 Driv3r disc into cache\driv3r_peds, which the game reads for Pedestrian Models. New disc row Driv3r (PlayStation 2) in the setup, or --driv3r <.iso> on the command line. A disc that is not found is skipped, a wrong disc is explained, a failed run keeps the old set. Tried by the tests and a real run into a scratch folder with the game seeing the people. The setup window with the new row.

Fixed the setup window at 125, 150 and 200 percent screen scaling and in long languages: the text was not scaled with the window, rows touched by a pixel, the status lines under the disc rows and the extras note were cut off with all five extras ticked, the movies tick box sat on the button bar, the buttons of the last page were too narrow in Greek, Spanish, Romanian and Hungarian, and two Greek Gran Turismo lines were too long. Found by the new automatic layout test, checked by pictures at 100 and 150 percent in English, German and Russian.
Changed the README to a short front part with what is in the game, the install steps, config, known problems and how to report a bug. The long reference follows it.

Fixed the setup window at 125 and 200 percent screen scaling: the Back button now follows the chosen language, the word column of the result list is wide enough for long words like fehlgeschlagen, and the result list rows grow with the scale so letters are no longer cut. Looked at every page in all languages by automatic screenshots,

Added Slovene (Slovenscina): the game texts, the options, the pause menu, jobs, CB radio, subtitles and the level editor labels, and the setup window. Machine quality translation, reviewers welcome. The long level editor manual stays English.

Added Serbian (Latin script, Srpski) to the game and the setup window: menus, options, HUD, jobs, CB radio, subtitles, editor labels and all setup texts. Machine quality translation, written by hand but not checked by a native speaker, reviewers welcome. The editor manual paragraphs stay English. The loc check ran, the pictures were not tried by hand. A Cyrillic version could follow later.

Added the Ukrainian language (??????????) to the game and the setup window: every game text, the options, menus, radio, jobs and the editor, and the setup pages. It is a machine quality translation, reviewers are welcome.

Added Croatian (Hrvatski) as a new language: the game texts, the editor labels, the CB radio and job texts, the subtitles and the setup window are translated by hand. Machine quality translation, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English.
Updated the language count in the README: the game now has 21 languages with Ukrainian, Croatian, Slovene and Serbian. The four new ones are machine quality translations and reviewers are welcome.

Translated the texts that were added after the first Ukrainian round: window mode names, controls presets, the car select hint line, the mission maker steps (pickup, drop off, time limit, max speed, stealth, max damage, rules off, traffic, cop wave), and the typed transform, lasso, local view and flat view texts of the editor. Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English.

Translated the texts that were added after the first Croatian round: window mode names, controls presets, the car select hint line, the mission maker steps (pickup, drop off, time limit, max speed, stealth, max damage, rules off, traffic, cop wave), and the typed transform, lasso, local view and flat view texts of the editor. Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English.

Translated the texts that were added after the first Slovene round: window mode names, controls presets, the car select hint line, the mission maker steps (pickup, drop off, time limit, max speed, stealth, max damage, rules off, traffic, cop wave), and the typed transform, lasso, local view and flat view texts of the editor. Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English.

Translated the texts that were added after the first Serbian (Latin) round: window mode names, controls presets, the car select hint line, the mission maker steps (pickup, drop off, time limit, max speed, stealth, max damage, rules off, traffic, cop wave), the typed transform, lasso, local view and flat view texts, and about 190 editor tool tips and labels that were still English. Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English.

Translated more of the later texts into Ukrainian: the credits headings and lines, the key names of the controls pages, quality options, the police stop ticket text and the editor screen (tool names, hints, mission maker and water tool buttons, car and object lists). Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English.

Translated more of the later texts into Croatian: the credits headings and lines, the key names of the controls pages, quality options, the police stop ticket text and the editor screen (tool names, hints, mission maker and water tool buttons, car and object lists). Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English.

Translated more of the later texts into Slovene: the credits headings and lines, the key names of the controls pages, quality options, the police stop ticket text and the editor screen (tool names, hints, mission maker and water tool buttons, car and object lists). Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English.

Translated more of the later texts into Serbian (Latin): the credits headings and lines, the key names of the controls pages, quality options, the police stop ticket text and the editor screen (tool names, hints, mission maker and water tool buttons, car and object lists). Machine quality, translated by hand, reviewers welcome. The editor manual stays English.
Added the Smart Cop and Smart Racer AI policy files (ai folder of the Core pack) to the package, so a clean install finds them. Checked by automatic tests,
Changed the README: red2ex is the home of the project (project page and release downloads), and the source snapshot follows there after the release. The red2ex link in the third party notices stays.

Went through the setup code for the uninstaller, the registry entry, the path and disc handling. The install folder from the registry is cut cleanly when the value has no end mark, the temp folder of the uninstall is checked, the runtime installer messages show the right path (a backslash v was printed as a tab), a damaged Nero disc image with a huge chunk length no longer reads past its data in the 32 bit setup, and a disc image whose folders point back at themselves stops with an error instead of running for ever.

Hardened the Gran Turismo 2 disc reader of the setup. A damaged GT2.VOL whose folders point back at each other is refused at once instead of running for ever, a car archive index outside the entry count is refused, and a car model cut off in the middle of a polygon is refused before it is read. Checked by automatic tests,

Hardened the wheel reader of the setup. A damaged Driver 1 or Driver 2 level file on a disc image with wild counts, offsets or sizes is refused instead of read out of bounds, and a wheel picture that leaves its texture page is skipped. Checked by automatic tests,

Hardened the zip reader of the setup. A zip whose data inflates to far more than the size it announces is stopped after 64 KB with an error instead of filling the temp folder, failed seeks and a failed name allocation are checked now. Checked by automatic tests,

Hardened the disc reader of the setup. File names of a disc image that are empty, are dots, or hold a slash, a backslash, a colon or a control character are skipped, so a damaged or hostile image cannot make the setup create folders or video files outside the game data folder. Checked by automatic tests,
Fixed two small leaks in the setup: the shared disc data step left the disc image open, and the Gran Turismo 1 chrome texture read kept a buffer when it failed. Checked by automatic tests,

Made the setup's level step tell you why a level was not made. Before, the reason (for example a missing city description file) was only written to a developer log line that the release build drops, so the setup just said 0 levels. Now it is in the log as a warning.

Rewrote the texts of the setup to say what it really does now: the first screen names Driver 1 for the PlayStation and the PC, Gran Turismo 1 and 2 and the Driv3r pedestrians, the summary lists the Driver 1 missions and the level data, maps and car pictures the game makes, and the end screen tells about the reD2ex Radio station. All the other languages of the setup are translated by hand. Looked at the pages in pictures in English and German,

Fixed the moving progress bar of the setup turning green when a step has no number: it has the red of the other bars now. Added a clock line (this step / all together) that counts every second, and the car pictures and the city level data show a count or the time, so no long step looks stuck.

Updated the license text of the setup: Driv3r and Gran Turismo 2 in the disc and trademark lines, and a short list of the work of other people (REDRIVER2, Psynapse and PsyCross, SDL2, OpenAL Soft, libjpeg, fonts, BetterCars and Driver2TextureFixes, the Gran Turismo 2 PC port contributors) taken from THIRD_PARTY.txt. Some legal questions are still open.

Added Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified) and Chinese (Traditional) to the setup, so it has every language of the game; the East Asian languages use their own Windows UI font. The licence page is translated in every language (the MIT text, copyright lines and third party notices stay English as the binding original, with a note), shows the full THIRD_PARTY.txt (built into the setup, so it cannot differ from the file) and credits the logos of Gector Nathan. Also translated the log lines that were still English. Looked at the pages in pictures in English, German, Portuguese, Japanese and both Chinese. A real install in a Japanese or Chinese Windows, and the translations were not read by native speakers.
Gave the installer a side banner with the reDriver 2 Extended artwork on the first screen. The other pages use the full width.
Rewrote the install steps in the README for the single installer file. There is no zip to unpack any more.
